221.title: Wedding Photography Website
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
WEDDING VENDOR SAAS & PHOTOGRAPHY BUSINESS MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Vendor Subscriptions, Revenue, Packages, Support, AI & Client-Facing Portfolio Website

A centralized SaaS and business-management platform designed for wedding-industry vendors and creative service businesses. It combines a premium client-facing photography website with vendor account access, subscription management, recurring revenue visibility, packages, feature controls, support and AI-assisted workflows in one connected solution.

The platform can support photographers and other wedding-service vendors while giving the business a polished public presence for showcasing weddings, pre-wedding work, events, recent stories, service quality and booking calls-to-action.
1. Public Wedding Photography & Client Experience
Premium Portfolio Website - Present wedding photography and creative services through a high-end public website designed to build trust and generate enquiries.
Weddings - Showcase wedding photography coverage, featured stories and visual work for prospective clients.
Pre-Wedding - Present pre-wedding photography services and selected portfolio content.
Events - Promote event photography coverage alongside wedding-focused services.
Recent Stories - Highlight selected recent work and visual stories to keep the portfolio fresh and engaging.
Client Section - Provide a dedicated client-facing section where the business can direct existing customers according to the configured workflow.
Book Your Date - Use clear booking calls-to-action to encourage prospective clients to start an enquiry or reservation conversation.
View Our Work - Guide visitors directly into portfolio content and visual examples of completed work.
Why Us - Present quality-focused differentiators, service approach and business strengths to prospective customers.
Journal / Blog - Publish wedding stories, planning advice, pre-wedding guidance and other useful content to support marketing and search visibility.
Vendor Login - Connect the public website with the SaaS vendor portal for approved vendor account access.
2. Vendor SaaS & Subscription Management Platform
Vendor Sign In & Registration - Allow vendors to sign in or create an account through a dedicated SaaS portal.
Active Vendors - Track the number of active vendor accounts from the management dashboard.
Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) - Monitor recurring subscription revenue and its month-over-month movement.
Total Subscriptions - Review active subscription volume across the platform.
Churn Risk - Surface accounts that may require retention attention or subscription follow-up.
Revenue Trend - Review recurring revenue performance over multiple months from a visual dashboard.
Plan Mix - Understand how active subscriptions are distributed across available packages and trials.
Recent Vendors - Review newly added or recently active vendors together with vendor type, plan, status and MRR.
Vendor Types - Support multiple wedding-industry vendor categories such as photographers, florists, caterers and DJs, with additional categories configurable as required.
Subscriptions - Manage vendor subscription access and plan allocation from a dedicated module.
Packages - Create and manage subscription package structures according to the selected commercial model.
Feature Toggles - Control the availability of selected platform features according to package, rollout or operational requirements.
Support - Maintain a centralized support area for vendor assistance and service requests.
AI Workspace - Provide a dedicated AI area for approved creative, support or operational assistance workflows.
3. User Experiences & Access
Platform Management - SaaS Oversight
Designed for the business team responsible for monitoring vendors, subscriptions, revenue, packages, support and platform configuration.
Dashboard - Review active vendors, MRR, subscriptions, churn risk, revenue trends and plan distribution.
Vendors - Maintain vendor accounts and review vendor type, plan and account status.
Subscriptions - Manage subscription records and plan access.
Revenue - Monitor recurring revenue performance and related business metrics.
Packages - Configure commercial packages and plan structures.
Feature Toggles - Enable or restrict selected capabilities according to platform requirements.
Support - Review and manage vendor assistance requirements.
AI & Settings - Use the configured AI workspace and maintain platform settings.
Vendor - Account & Plan-Based Access
A vendor-facing SaaS experience that begins with secure sign-in or registration and can provide access according to the vendor's assigned subscription package and enabled features.
Account Access - Sign in to the vendor SaaS portal with approved account credentials.
Registration - Create a vendor account where self-registration is enabled.
Plan-Based Features - Access only the modules and capabilities enabled for the selected vendor package.
Support Access - Use the configured support workflow for platform-related assistance.
Public Client - Discovery & Booking Journey
A polished public-facing experience for couples and clients evaluating wedding photography and creative services.
Portfolio Discovery - Explore weddings, pre-wedding work, events and recent stories.
Service Confidence - Review service positioning, quality messaging and featured work before making contact.
Booking CTA - Use Book Your Date and related calls-to-action to begin the enquiry process.
Content Experience - Read journal content and planning guidance that can support trust and lead generation.
4. How It Helps Your Wedding & Creative Business Grow
Combine Website & SaaS Operations - Use one connected solution for public marketing, vendor access, subscriptions, revenue monitoring and platform operations.
Create a Premium Brand Experience - A high-quality portfolio website helps wedding businesses present their work professionally and improve customer confidence.
Generate More Enquiries - Clear portfolio sections, recent work, journals and booking calls-to-action make it easier for prospective clients to engage.
Build Recurring Revenue - Subscription packages allow a vendor platform to operate with recurring plan-based revenue.
Monitor Subscription Health - MRR, total subscriptions, plan mix and churn-risk indicators provide clearer SaaS business visibility.
Support Multiple Vendor Categories - The platform can expand beyond photography to florists, caterers, DJs and other wedding-service providers.
Control Feature Access - Feature toggles and package-based availability help the business create different service tiers.
Scale the Platform - Add more vendors, packages, features, reports, integrations, mobile apps and vendor-specific modules as the business grows.
5. Technology Stack
React.js - Modern responsive frontend interface for the public website, vendor portal and SaaS management dashboards.
Vite - Fast frontend development and optimized application build tooling.
Node.js + Express - Backend services and APIs for users, vendors, subscriptions, packages, support, revenue and platform workflows.
MySQL - Structured relational database management for vendor, subscription, revenue and operational data.
Prisma ORM - Database interaction layer for structured and maintainable full-stack application development.

Alternative technology stacks can also be used according to client requirements, integration needs and deployment architecture. Kiaan Technology can work with React Native, Java, Python, TypeScript and other suitable frontend, mobile or backend technologies where required.

Android & iOS Applications - Dedicated vendor, client or platform-management mobile applications can be developed for Android and iOS using React Native or other suitable native or cross-platform technologies according to project requirements.

AI & Automation - AI-assisted content generation, client communication, image or gallery assistance, support automation, vendor onboarding assistance and other approved workflows can be developed around the agreed use case.
6. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements

The software can be adapted around the way your photography business, wedding marketplace or vendor SaaS operates. Branding, vendor categories, packages, subscription rules, client experience, AI tools and internal workflows can be tailored to the agreed scope.
Branding - Logo, software name, public website styling, portfolio presentation and SaaS interface can be customized.
Vendor Categories - Photographers, florists, caterers, DJs and additional vendor categories can be added according to the target marketplace.
Packages & Pricing - Subscription plans, trial periods, feature access and commercial rules can be adapted to the required business model.
Vendor Workflows - Vendor onboarding, profile fields, approvals, statuses and account-management workflows can be customized.
Client Website - Portfolio sections, services, galleries, enquiry forms, booking actions, journals and client sections can be modified or extended.
Revenue & Reports - MRR, subscription, churn, package and custom business reporting can be expanded according to management requirements.

Third-Party API Integrations - Suitable payment gateways, email, SMS, WhatsApp, CRM, storage, gallery, accounting, calendar and other third-party services can be integrated where required and supported by the selected providers.
AI & Automation - AI tools and automated workflows can be developed for approved use cases such as content assistance, vendor support, customer communication or business insights.
Mobile Applications - Android and iOS applications can be added where included in the project scope.
Multi-Language Support - Additional interface and public website languages can be developed according to client requirements.
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance, expansion and further development.
7. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual photography, wedding-vendor or SaaS business model instead of forcing every client into one fixed process.
Business-Focused Product Design - The platform connects public marketing, vendor subscriptions, revenue visibility and operational tools in a way that supports easier management and growth.
Scalable SaaS Architecture - Start with the current platform and expand vendor categories, subscription tiers, reports, AI tools, mobile apps and integrations as requirements evolve.
Role & Access Control - Authenticated access and plan-based feature availability can help keep platform capabilities controlled according to user and package requirements.

Security-Focused Development - Kiaan Technology develops software with authenticated login, controlled data visibility and secure password handling. Additional hosting, backup, audit, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates showing what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
8. FAQ
Can this software support photographers and other wedding vendors?
Yes. It can support photographers, florists, caterers, DJs and other wedding-service vendors according to the configured marketplace.
Can vendors register and subscribe to different packages?
Yes. Vendor registration, subscriptions, packages and plan-based feature access can be configured around the selected business model.
Can we track recurring subscription revenue?
Yes. The dashboard includes MRR, total subscriptions, revenue trends, plan mix and churn-risk visibility.
Is the data secure?
The software uses authenticated access and controlled data visibility. Additional hosting, backup, audit and encryption controls can be configured according to the agreed architecture.
Can third-party systems be integrated?
Yes. Suitable payment, messaging, CRM, gallery, storage, accounting, calendar and other services can be integrated where supported.
Can AI features be added?
Yes. AI can support approved use cases such as content assistance, vendor support, customer communication and operational insights.
Is source code included and can Android / iOS apps be developed?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license. Android and iOS apps can also be developed using React Native or other suitable technologies.
Will we receive regular project updates and technical support?
Yes. We provide transparent communication, regular progress updates and technical support according to the selected package.
BOOK A DEMO • GET A QUOTE

Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your photography website, vendor marketplace, subscription model, packages, AI features, mobile applications and integration requirements, and receive a project-specific proposal.

209.title: Contractor Management Software
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
CONTRACTOR PROJECT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
Unified Project, Design, Supply & Site Installation Platform
A role-based platform that connects project managers, CAD designers, material suppliers and site installers in one coordinated workflow—from project planning to final installation.
1. What We Provide
A centralized contractor project management solution designed to improve visibility, coordination and control across projects, design approvals, material procurement, shipping and site installation.
4 User Roles: Senior Project Manager / Admin, Lead Joinery CAD Designer, Material Supplier & Site Operations Lead / Installer
Project Management: All projects, project creation, project timeline, tasks and activities
Design & Drawing Control: All drawings, drawing uploads, revision history and approval status
Supplier & Material Coordination: Suppliers, material orders, supplier status and purchase requests
Purchase & Shipping: Purchase orders, shipment tracking and delivery status
Installation Management: Installation schedule, installation tasks, site progress, final inspection, issues and notes
Site Updates: Photo uploads, daily notes, progress updates and issue reporting
Client Management: Client list, client projects and project visibility
Reports & Cost Control: Project reports, cost tracking and progress reports
Documents & Communication: Project documents, installation drawings, site instructions, comments and messages
Administration & Access: Users & roles, permissions and system settings
Responsive Access: Designed for Desktop, Laptop, Tablet and Mobile devices
Mobile App Availability: Android & iOS versions can be provided according to the selected package and requirements
2. Technology Stack
React.js + Vite — Modern, fast and responsive frontend
Tailwind CSS — Responsive, consistent and modern interface styling
Node.js + Express — Backend APIs and application logic
MySQL — Reliable relational database management
Prisma ORM — Structured and efficient database interaction
3. Role-Based Access
Senior Project Manager / Admin → Complete operational control across projects, drawings, suppliers, purchase orders, shipping, installation, clients, reports, costs, users, permissions and settings.
Lead Joinery CAD Designer → Focused access to assigned projects, tasks, timelines, drawings, uploads, revisions, approval status, project documents, comments and messages.

Material Supplier → Dedicated supplier portal for purchase requests, purchase orders, order history, production status, ready-for-dispatch updates, shipping, delivery, invoices, shipping documents and messages.

Site Operations Lead / Installer → Field-focused access to assigned projects, installation schedules and tasks, final inspection, site photos, daily notes, progress updates, issue reporting, installation drawings and site instructions.
4. Source Code

Source code availability is based on the selected package or license. If source code is included, Kiaan Technology will clearly confirm the applicable package terms before the project or software package is finalized.
5. Customization & Expansion
The software can be tailored to match your company workflow, branding and operational process.
Logo • Branding • UI • Roles • Permissions • Modules • Fields • Reports • Workflows • Integrations
Additional modules, approval flows, project stages, reports, integrations and automation can be developed as your requirements grow.
6. FAQ
Can we customize the software?
Yes. Modules, workflows, fields, reports and features can be customized according to your business requirements.
Is the software mobile and tablet responsive?
Yes. The web system is responsive for desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile screens.
Are Android and iOS app versions available?
Yes. Android and iOS app versions can be provided based on the selected package and requirements.
How are passwords, data and user access secured?

Passwords are protected using secure authentication and password hashing, while role-based permissions restrict every user to authorized modules and actions. Application and database access can also be configured according to deployment security requirements.
Can third-party APIs and AI automation be integrated?
Yes. Third-party APIs, notifications, payment services, AI features and workflow automations can be integrated as required.
Is source code included?
Yes, where included in the selected package/license.
Can we add our branding?
Yes. Logo, name, colors and UI can be customized.
Which technologies are used?
React.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MySQL and Prisma ORM.
Does Kiaan Technology provide technical support?
Yes. Kiaan Technology can provide technical support for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
Can a different technology stack be used?
Yes. We work across full-stack technologies including React Native, WordPress, TypeScript, Java, Python and others based on project requirements.

211.title: Contractor Project Management Software
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
OUTDOOR KITCHEN PROJECT & CUSTOMER MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Leads, Quotes, Design, Planning, Partners, Build, Payments & Aftercare

A centralized project management platform designed for outdoor kitchen and custom outdoor living businesses to manage leads, customer projects, partner collaboration, quotations, designs, planning, build progress, photos, documents, payments and aftercare from one connected system.
Dedicated Admin, Partner and Customer portals help each user access the information relevant to their role while keeping project communication, documents and progress more organized.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage
Leads - Capture and manage prospective customer opportunities before they move into active projects.
Customer Projects - Maintain project information and track active outdoor kitchen or outdoor living jobs from one workspace.
Bookkeeping - Support project-related bookkeeping and financial administration within the management workflow.
Partners - Maintain partner records and coordinate external partners involved in project delivery.
Planning - Organize project planning information and keep upcoming work visible to the relevant team and partners.
Photos & Media - Store and review project photos, visual updates and other media connected to project progress.
Tasks - Create and manage project-related tasks so responsibilities and pending work remain visible.
Documents - Keep project documents organized and available to authorized users.
Quotes - Provide customers with access to their quotation information through the customer portal.
Design & Renders - Share project design material and visual renders with customers during the design stage.
Planning & Build - Give customers visibility into planning and build-related project information.
Payments - Provide customers with access to payment-related information within the project portal.
Messages & Contact - Maintain a structured customer communication and contact area.
Handover & Aftercare - Support final handover information and aftercare communication after project completion.
Role-Based Access - Admin, Partner and Customer users work from separate portals aligned with their responsibilities.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides dedicated portals for Admin, Partner and Customer users, helping each role focus on the information and actions required during the project lifecycle.
Admin - Complete Project & Business Oversight
Designed for broad management of leads, projects, partners, planning, media, tasks, documents and system configuration.
Dashboard - Review overall business and project activity from the main administration workspace.
Leads - Manage prospective customer opportunities and move suitable leads into project workflows.
Projects - Maintain active and historical project records.

216.title: Rental Property Management Software
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
SHORT-TERM RENTAL & HOSPITALITY PROPERTY MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Multi-Tenant Operations, Guest Automation, Smart Access & Financial Visibility
Manage property portfolios, bookings, guests, automated check-ins, smart lock access, staff tasks, inventory, financials and multi-channel operations from one connected platform.
1. Overview
Short-Term Rental & Hospitality Property Management Software is a multi-tenant SaaS platform designed for property hosts, hospitality groups, operations teams and guests.

The platform centralizes portfolio management, booking coordination, guest identity verification, automated check-in, smart lock access, staff operations, inventory, financial reporting and property analytics so teams can manage growing portfolios with better control and less manual work.
2. Core Platform Capabilities
• Property Portfolio Management - Manage multiple properties, property status, occupancy information and portfolio-level operational data from one system.
• Booking Calendar - Coordinate reservations and property availability through a centralized booking calendar.
• Multi-Channel Reservation Sync - Support reservation synchronization across channels such as Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO and direct booking sources.
• Guest Profiles - Maintain guest information, reservation history, stay activity and identity-verification status.
• Automated Guest Verification - Support passport OCR and guest document verification as part of the check-in workflow.
• Check-In Automation - Automate guest check-in steps and connect verified reservations with access credentials.
• Smart Lock Automation - Generate and manage smart lock PIN access for eligible guest reservations.
• Staff Task Board - Coordinate cleaning, maintenance, verification and guest-preparation tasks through a Kanban-style operations board.
• Inventory Management - Track operational inventory and property-related stock used across the portfolio.
• Financials & Tax - Provide authorized financial visibility and support tax / VAT-related operational workflows.
• Reports & Analytics - Review portfolio performance, occupancy, revenue and operational analytics.
• Audit Trail - Maintain visible system activity and administrative action logs for stronger operational traceability.
• Multi-Tenant SaaS Management - Support isolated property groups or hospitality organizations from one platform-level administration environment.
3. Role-Based Portals

The software includes dedicated workspaces for Platform Admin, Property Host, Staff / Operations and Guest users. Each role sees the tools required for its responsibilities while sensitive controls remain restricted.
Platform Admin - SaaS & Multi-Tenant Control
• Platform System Overview - Monitor annual recurring revenue, active SaaS tenants, managed units and smart lock connectivity from a global dashboard.
• Tenant Provisioning - Create and manage new property organizations or hospitality tenant groups.
• Enterprise Tenant Management - Review active tenant groups, plans, managed units, monthly recurring revenue and account status.
• Global Property Visibility - Access property, booking, guest, inventory, financial and operational modules across the platform.
• Audit Logs - Review administrative actions and live audit-trail activity.
• Export - Export platform data such as tenant or operational records where available.
• Financial & Tax Oversight - Access financial and tax-related platform modules according to administrative permissions.
Property Host - Portfolio, Revenue & Guest Operations
• Host Dashboard - Monitor monthly gross revenue, portfolio occupancy, active properties and tax / VAT visibility.
• Property Portfolio - View properties with occupancy or maintenance status, location, property details and pricing information.
• Today's Check-Ins - Review expected guest arrivals and reservation source information.
• Guest Verification - Inspect guest verification profiles before or during check-in.
• Check-In Flow - Launch guided check-in workflows for arriving guests.
• Booking Calendar - Review and manage reservation timing across the portfolio.
• Guest Profiles - Access guest information connected to property stays.
• Inventory - Manage property or operational inventory.
• Financials & Tax - Review revenue and tax-related information from the host workspace.
• Reports & Analytics - Access performance reporting for portfolio-level decision-making.
• Staff Task Board - Coordinate operational tasks with cleaning, maintenance and guest-service teams.
Staff / Operations - Real-Time Task Execution
• Properties & Booking Calendar - Access the property and reservation information required for daily operational work.
• Guest Profile - Review guest information relevant to check-in and service tasks.
• Check-In Automation - Support guest-arrival and automated check-in operations.
• Inventory - Work with inventory needed for property readiness and ongoing operations.
• Kanban Task Board - Manage tasks across To Do, In Progress, Verification Audit and Completed stages.
• Priority Management - Classify operational tasks by priority for faster issue handling.
• Cleaning & Maintenance - Track work such as deep cleaning, pool checks, AC maintenance and property-preparation activities.
• Verification Tasks - Handle verification or audit-related tasks before guest access is finalized.
• Task Export & Creation - Create new tasks and export operational task data where available.
Guest Portal - Verified Stay & Smart Access
• Guest Profile - View personal profile information, verification status and reservation-linked details.
• Identity Verification - Support passport-based identity verification for secure guest onboarding.
• Active Reservation Details - See reserved property, check-in time and relevant stay information.
• Smart Lock PIN - Receive the assigned smart lock PIN for eligible reservations.
• Check-In Automation - Access automated check-in information and related logs.
• Stay History - View previous stay count and guest spending information where available.
4. Hospitality Automation & Operational Intelligence
• AI-Powered Operations & Occupancy Forecasting - Use portfolio-level operational and occupancy forecasting views to support planning and resource allocation.
• Real-Time Availability - Keep portfolio status and property availability visible across operational teams.
• Occupancy & Revenue Tracking - Monitor occupancy, average daily rate and portfolio revenue from management dashboards.
• Smart Access Control - Reduce manual key handovers by connecting verified reservations with smart lock credentials.
• Automated Tax Compliance - Support tax and VAT workflows as part of hospitality financial operations, including configurable regional requirements.
• Guest Document Verification - Use document verification as part of a more structured and controlled check-in process.
• Operational Task Visibility - Give management and staff a clear view of cleaning, maintenance, verification and guest-readiness work.
5. How It Can Help Your Property Business Grow

• Manage More Properties with Less Manual Work - Centralized portfolios, booking operations, check-ins, guest records and task workflows reduce the need to manage each property through separate tools.
• Improve Occupancy & Revenue Visibility - Portfolio dashboards make it easier to track occupancy, revenue and property performance across the business.
• Deliver a Faster Guest Experience - Automated verification, check-in workflows and smart lock credentials can reduce delays between reservation and property access.
• Reduce Operational Errors - Role-based workflows, audit trails and structured task stages help teams follow a more consistent process.
• Improve Staff Coordination - Cleaning, maintenance, verification and guest-readiness activities can be assigned and tracked from one operational board.

KI Dental is a centralized practice management platform designed to support clinical care, patient records, appointments, billing, recalls, self-service workflows, analytics and multi-site practice oversight. rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
HOSPITAL WAREHOUSE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Centralized Inventory, Facility Supply & Requisition Management

A role-based hospital warehouse platform designed to help healthcare organizations manage inventory, facility stock, requisitions, dispatches, suppliers, batches, assets, returns and operational visibility from one connected system.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage
• Central & Facility Inventory — Maintain visibility of stock across the main warehouse and individual facilities.
• Requisitions & Requests — Create, monitor and process inventory requests with priority and status tracking.
• Dispatches & Incoming Goods — Coordinate movement of stock from the warehouse to facilities and record incoming supplies.
• Low-Stock & Critical Alerts — Identify items that require attention before stock availability becomes a bigger operational issue.
• Suppliers & Batch Management — Organize supplier information and batch-related inventory operations.
• Assets & Returns — Track operational assets and manage returned stock through defined workflows.
• Facilities & Multi-Facility Visibility — Review facilities and system-wide inventory from a centralized management view.
• Reports, Categories & Units — Support structured reporting and consistent inventory organization across locations.
• User Management — Manage system users and give teams access aligned with their responsibilities.
• Inventory Analytics — Review stock distribution, inventory value, request volume, system utilization and warehouse activity trends.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides four role-based experiences so each team works with the information and actions relevant to its responsibilities.
Super Admin — System-Wide Control & Oversight
• Central dashboard for inventory items, facilities, pending requisitions and overall inventory value.
• System-wide stock distribution and inventory composition visibility across major categories.
• Access to Inventory, Requisitions, Dispatches, Assets, Facilities, All Facilities Inventory, Users, Batch Management and Suppliers.
• Monthly volume trends and recent system activity for broader operational monitoring.
• Security overview, critical stock alerts and storage-capacity visibility to support proactive management.
Warehouse Admin — Main Warehouse Operations
• Main Inventory management with Bulk Import for high-volume stock administration.
• Supplier, Batch Management, Requisition, Dispatch, Return and Asset workflows.
• Warehouse-level visibility of total stock units, low-stock alerts, pending requisitions and inventory value.
• Monthly supply distribution and inventory breakdown by consumables, medications, equipment and other categories.
• Recent requisition and dispatch monitoring, stock-integrity status and critical restock actions.
Facility Admin — Facility Inventory & Logistics Management
• Central Inventory and Facility Stock views for facility-level stock management.
• My Requests, Requisitions, Incoming Goods and External Entry workflows for day-to-day facility supply operations.
• Supplier, Asset, Return, Report, Units & Categories and User Management access.
• Facility dashboard visibility for active items, inventory value, pending requisitions, critical alerts, system health and active staff.
• Stock distribution by category, system utilization, request velocity and critical stock alerts.
• Export Summary, Audit Timeline and logistics-health visibility to support review and operational follow-up.
Facility User — Request & Inventory Access
• Access to Admin Inventory, Facility Inventory, Requisitions, My Requests and Receipts.
• Dashboard visibility for pending requests, delivered items, low-stock items and total inventory items.
• Clear request tracking with requisition ID, priority, items, remarks, creation date and current status.
• Approved and delivered request visibility helps users follow supply progress without relying on manual updates.
3. Key Business Benefits
• Easier Day-to-Day Management — Bring warehouse, facility and stock workflows into one organized system instead of managing information across disconnected records.
• Better Stock Visibility — See current inventory, low-stock items, critical alerts and category distribution so teams can make faster supply decisions.
• Faster Requisition Flow — Track pending, processing, approved, in-transit and delivered requests in a structured workflow.
• Improved Multi-Facility Coordination — Give central teams and facility teams a shared view of inventory movement and request status.
• Stronger Inventory Control — Batch management, returns, receipts, stock-integrity views and operational logs support more disciplined inventory handling.
• Financial Visibility — Inventory value and stock-distribution insights help management understand where stock and working capital are concentrated.
• Organized Data & Controlled Access — Role-based access and user management help keep operational information structured and limit access according to responsibility.
• Supports Business Growth — More efficient stock control, clearer facility coordination and faster decision-making can help healthcare operations scale with less administrative friction.
4. Why This Platform Is Valuable for Healthcare Operations

Hospital supply operations depend on having the right items available at the right location and at the right time. The software gives warehouse and facility teams a common operational view so they can follow stock levels, requests, dispatches, incoming goods and alerts without depending on scattered spreadsheets or manual follow-up.
• Helps reduce avoidable delays caused by unclear stock status or request progress.
• Makes it easier to identify low-stock and critical items that require immediate attention.
• Provides management with both operational detail and higher-level inventory visibility.
• Keeps requests, stock activity and facility information easier to review and manage over time.

WOMEN'S HEALTH & WELLNESSMANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
A Digital Wellness Platform for Members, Content, Community and Growth
Manage wellness content, member journeys, plans, payments, engagement and administration from one connected platform.
1. Overview

Women's Health & Wellness Management Software is a customer-facing digital platform designed to bring wellness education, member engagement, content management, community interaction and subscription administration into one organized system. It combines a public wellness website with dedicated Admin and Member portals so organizations can present their services, onboard members, manage content and plans, monitor engagement and provide members with convenient access to wellness resources.
Built for organizations that want to make wellness services easier to manage and easier for members to access.
2. What the Software Helps You Manage
• Public Wellness Website — Present wellness programs, educational resources, books, blog content, plans and contact/feedback options through a customer-facing website.
• Member Registration & Access — Support login and signup journeys with member access, plan selection and account onboarding.
• Wellness Content & Books — Organize wellness books and guided learning content for members in a structured digital library.
• Member Management — Manage member records, subscriptions and member activity from the administration portal.
• Plans & Payments — Create and manage membership plans, monitor paid users and view revenue/payment information.
• Community Engagement — Provide community-focused areas and wellness interaction features that encourage ongoing participation.
• Messages & Communication — Support administrative messaging and member communication from within the platform.
• Analytics & Growth Visibility — Track user growth, paid users, revenue, active users and other platform activity from the admin dashboard.

The public website acts as the discovery and engagement layer of the platform. It can showcase wellness services, educational resources, books, expert content, blog articles, membership plans and contact options in one place.

• Progress & Engagement — View streaks, badges and level/status indicators that support ongoing participation.
• FAQ & Help — Access help and frequently asked questions from within the member portal.

• Build a Stronger Wellness Brand — Deliver a consistent digital experience across discovery, signup, learning, community and member engagement.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
TELEHEALTH MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Role-Based Digital Healthcare Operations for Organizations, Doctors and Patients
Manage healthcare organizations, staff, patients, appointments, consultations, communication, transactions and platform operations from one connected telehealth system.
1. Overview
Telehealth Management Software is a multi-role digital healthcare platform designed to connect platform owners, healthcare administrators, doctors and patients through one structured system.

The software supports organization-level management, patient administration, appointment scheduling, doctor workflows, consultation records, communication history, transactions and remote care access while giving each user a focused portal based on their responsibilities.
2. Core Platform Capabilities
• Multi-Role Access - Dedicated workspaces for Super Admin, Admin, Doctor and Patient users.
• Organization Management - Centralized visibility and management of healthcare organizations from the platform-level Super Admin workspace.
• Plans & Subscriptions - Manage platform plans and monitor active subscriptions at the global administration level.
• Admin Management - Create and manage platform or organization administrators.
• Finance & Revenue Visibility - Authorized users can monitor revenue performance, transactions and financial activity.
• Patient Management - Manage active patients, archived patient records and patient-level operational data.
• Doctor & Staff Management - Administrative tools support doctor and staff management within the healthcare organization.
• Appointment Management - Create, monitor and manage healthcare appointments from admin, doctor and patient workflows.
• Consultation & Encounter Records - Maintain consultation results and encounter activity as part of the care workflow.
• Communication History - Track SMS and email communication history from the administrative workspace.
• Doctor-Patient Chat - Patients and doctors can use direct chat functionality within their respective portals.
• Waiting Room - Support telehealth waiting-room workflows before remote consultations.
• Transactions - Patients and administrators can access transaction-related information according to role.
• Reporting & Export - Admin users can export reports and review operational and revenue analytics.
3. Role-Based Portals
Each portal is designed around a specific level of responsibility, helping users focus on the information and actions they need without exposing unnecessary system controls.
Super Admin - Global Platform Control
• Platform Dashboard - Monitor total organizations, total admins, monthly revenue and active subscriptions.
• Organizations - Create and manage healthcare organizations using the platform.
• Plans - Manage platform plans and subscription structures.
• Admins - Create and manage platform-level or organization administrators.
• Finance - Review platform financial performance and revenue activity.
• Revenue Growth - Monitor multi-month revenue trends from the global dashboard.
• Quick Actions - Access shortcuts for creating organizations, adding admins, financial audit and system-health review.
• Settings - Manage platform-level settings and configuration.
Admin - Organization Operations & Patient Management
• Administrative Dashboard - Monitor total revenue, total patients, active doctors and today's appointments.
• Staff Management - Manage healthcare staff within the organization.
• Manage Patients - Access and maintain active patient records.
• Archived Patients - Maintain archived patient records separately from active patient management.
• Login History - Review user login activity for administrative oversight.
• SMS History - Access SMS communication records.
• Email History - Access email communication records.
• Consultation Results - Review consultation result information across the organization.
• Appointment Calendar - Manage appointment scheduling and calendar activity.
• Transaction List - Review transaction-related records.
• Revenue Analytics - Monitor monthly, quarterly or yearly revenue performance.
• Export Report - Export administrative reports for further review or recordkeeping.
• Settings - Manage organization-level system configuration.
Doctor - Clinical Scheduling & Patient Care
• Doctor Dashboard - View active patients, today's appointments and total encounters.
• Waiting Room - Access patients waiting for telehealth consultations.
• Appointments - Review and manage scheduled patient appointments.
• Encounters - Access patient encounter activity as part of the care workflow.
• Calendar - Manage the doctor's appointment calendar.
• Patient Chat - Communicate directly with patients through the system.
• My Patients - Access patients connected to the doctor's care.
• Consultation Results - Record or review consultation result information.
• Upcoming Appointments - See confirmed and pending appointments with date and time information.
• Patient Search - Search patients directly from the doctor workspace.
• New Appointment - Create appointments from the doctor dashboard.
• My Profile - Maintain doctor identity and profile information.
Patient - Digital Care Access
• Patient Dashboard - View total consultations, connected doctors and upcoming appointments.
• My Appointments - Review scheduled and previous appointments.
• Encounters - Access encounter-related information from the patient's care history.
• Chat With Doctor - Communicate with connected doctors through the patient portal.
• Find a Doctor - Search for available healthcare providers.
• Waiting Room - Enter the telehealth waiting-room workflow before a consultation.
• Emergency Booking - Access emergency booking from the patient dashboard.
• Join Tele-Session - Join the next scheduled remote consultation directly from the portal.
• My Transaction List - Review patient transaction information.
• My Health Profile - Access personal health-profile information.
4. How It Can Help a Healthcare Business Grow
• Expand Digital Care Access - Give patients a structured way to find doctors, book appointments, communicate and join remote consultations without depending entirely on physical visits.
• Support Multiple Healthcare Organizations - The global organization structure enables a platform owner to manage multiple healthcare organizations from one system.
• Increase Appointment Opportunities - Doctor search, appointment creation, patient booking and remote care access can make it easier for patients to move from inquiry to consultation.
• Improve Doctor Productivity - Doctors can manage appointments, waiting-room patients, calendars, encounters and patient communication from one focused workspace.

• Improve Administrative Efficiency - Patient management, staff management, appointment calendars, communication history and transactions are centralized instead of being spread across disconnected tools.
• Improve Revenue Visibility - Authorized dashboards provide revenue, subscription and transaction visibility to support better business decisions.
• Strengthen Patient Engagement - Patient chat, appointment visibility, health-profile access and tele-session workflows keep patients more connected to their care journey.
• Keep Data Better Organized - Role-based portals help centralize operational healthcare information and make it available to the appropriate users.
• Support Business Expansion - The software structure can be extended with new organizations, admins, doctors, workflows and integrations as the platform grows.
5. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be customized around your healthcare organization structure, specialties, appointment model, patient journey, revenue model and internal operating process.
• Branding - Logo, platform name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
• Organizations & Admin Structure - Organization hierarchy, admin levels and management permissions can be adapted.
• Roles & Permissions - Super Admin, Admin, Doctor and Patient permissions can be changed, and additional roles can be developed where required.
• Appointment & Consultation Workflow - Booking stages, appointment fields, waiting-room flow and consultation processes can be tailored.
• Patient & Doctor Management - Patient, doctor, staff and profile fields can be modified or extended.
• Plans & Subscription Model - Plan structures, subscriptions and platform access rules can be configured around the commercial model.
• Communication - SMS, email and other communication workflows can be extended based on project requirements.
• Forms, Fields & Reports - Operational forms, healthcare fields, dashboard metrics and reports can be modified or expanded.
• Integrations - Suitable payment, video-consultation, communication and other third-party APIs can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.

• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what is complete, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Role-Based Product Structure - Dedicated Super Admin, Admin, Doctor and Patient workspaces keep each user focused on relevant responsibilities.

7. Frequently Asked Questions

Yes. The Super Admin workspace includes organization management, allowing the platform structure to support multiple healthcare organizations.
Can administrators manage patients, staff and appointments?
Yes. The Admin portal includes staff management, patient management, appointment calendar, consultation results, communication history and transaction-related tools.
Can doctors manage appointments and communicate with patients?
Yes. Doctors can access appointments, calendar, waiting room, encounters, patient chat and their connected patients.
Can patients find doctors and join online consultations?
Yes. The Patient portal includes Find a Doctor, Waiting Room, appointment access and Join Tele-Session functionality.
Does the system support emergency booking?
Yes. Emergency Booking is available from the patient dashboard.
Can we monitor platform revenue and subscriptions?
Yes. The Super Admin dashboard includes monthly revenue and active-subscription visibility, while Admin users have organization-level revenue analytics.
Can reports be exported?
Yes. The Admin portal includes report export functionality.
Can SMS and email history be tracked?
Yes. The Admin workspace includes SMS History and Email History sections.

Yes. Branding, roles, workflows, organizations, forms, reports, subscriptions and integrations can be customized according to project requirements.
Can third-party APIs be integrated?
Suitable payment, video, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.

Yes. We maintain transparent communication and provide regular progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.

Build a telehealth platform around your healthcare organizations, doctors, patients, appointment workflows and digital care model.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your organization.

202.title: Real Estate CRM Software
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
PROPERTY MANAGEMENT & OWNER FINANCE SOFTWARE
Rentals, Owner-Financed Sales, Payments, Maintenance & Property Operations
Manage rental properties, owner-finance contracts, tenants, buyers, payments, mortgages, maintenance, documents and public property listings from one connected real estate platform.
1. Overview
Property Management & Owner Finance Software is a multi-portal real estate operations platform designed for property owners, managers, renters and contract buyers.

It unifies rental management, owner-financed property sales, underlying mortgage tracking, payment schedules, cash-flow visibility, maintenance, documents, communications and public listings so the business can operate from one organized system instead of disconnected spreadsheets, messages and records.
2. What the Software Helps You Manage
• Property Portfolio - Manage rental, owner-finance and mixed property portfolios with property status, occupancy and performance visibility.
• Rental Operations - Track tenants, leases, monthly rent, rent due dates, payment status and rental-property activity.
• Owner-Finance Contracts - Manage contract buyers, financed balances, interest rates, monthly payments, balloon dates, balloon amounts and equity progress.
• Payment Schedules - Maintain structured payment schedules showing due date, payment amount, principal, interest and remaining balance.
• Underlying Mortgage Visibility - Track mortgage balances and costs connected to managed properties for more accurate property-level financial visibility.
• Income, Costs & Net Cash Flow - Review property income, mortgage expense, taxes, insurance, operating expenses and net cash flow from management dashboards.
• Listings & Public Website - Publish and present available rental and owner-finance properties through a branded public property website.
• Customers - Maintain tenant, buyer and other customer information from one management workspace.
• Maintenance - Track maintenance tickets, urgency, vendor status and completed work across properties.
• Documents - Keep leases, property condition reports, contracts and other property documents organized in a dedicated document area.
• Messages - Support communication between management and portal users through centralized messaging workflows.
• Accounting, Finance & Reports - Provide management with financial, accounting and reporting tools for portfolio oversight.
• Title & Closing - Support title and closing-related workflows for owner-financed property transactions.
• Website / CMS - Manage public-facing property content and listings from the management system.
3. Role-Based Portals

The software includes focused portals for Owner / Manager, Tenant Renter, Contract Buyer and the Public Website. Each portal presents the information and actions relevant to that user type while keeping sensitive business functions controlled.
Owner / Manager Portal - Complete Property & Financial Control
• Management Dashboard - Monitor total properties, occupied and available units, properties under contract, monthly income, monthly costs, net cash flow and mortgage balance.
• Property Performance - Compare income, mortgage, taxes, insurance, expenses and net cash flow by property.
• Occupancy Overview - See available, occupied, pending and under-contract property status in one place.
• Properties - Manage property records, type, status and operational information.
• Payment Schedule - Manage rent or owner-finance payment schedules across the portfolio.
• Listings - Control properties available for rent or sale and manage public listing visibility.
• Customers - Manage tenant, buyer and customer information.
• Finance & Accounting - Track financial activity, portfolio costs and property-level performance.
• Title & Closing - Manage title and closing-related information for property-sale workflows.
• Maintenance Queue - Monitor open, urgent, waiting-vendor and completed maintenance work.
• Property Alerts - Surface important events such as mortgage payments, tax escrow, insurance renewals, lease expiry and balloon-payment deadlines.
• Documents & Messages - Keep important files and communications connected to property operations.
• Reports - Review portfolio and operational reporting for management decisions.
• Website / CMS & Settings - Control public property content and configure the system around business needs.
Tenant Renter Portal - Rent, Lease & Maintenance Self-Service
• Tenant Dashboard - View monthly rent, current balance, next rent due date, lease expiry date and payment status.
• My Property - Access information related to the rented property.
• My Lease - Review lease-related information from the tenant portal.
• Pay Rent - Make or access rent-payment workflows from the portal.
• Recent Payments - Review previous rent-payment records and payment status.
• Maintenance - Submit new maintenance requests and track active requests.
• Secure Documents - Access important tenant documents such as lease contracts and property condition reports.
• Messages - Communicate with property management and review recent messages.
• My Profile - Maintain tenant profile information.
Contract Buyer Portal - Owner-Finance Payment & Equity Tracking
• Buyer Dashboard - View monthly amount due, interest rate, current financed balance and next payment date.
• My Property & My Contract - Access the property and owner-finance contract connected to the buyer account.
• Payment Schedule - Review upcoming payments with principal, interest and remaining balance.
• Principal Balance Reduction - Track how the financed balance changes as payments are made.
• Note Breakdown - View principal paid, interest paid and remaining balance information.
• Balloon Tracking - Monitor balloon date and balloon amount for contracts that include balloon financing.
• Total Paid & Equity Built - Provide the buyer with visibility into payment progress and accumulated equity.
• Account Alerts - Surface important payment, balloon, tax, insurance and title-related reminders.
• Payments, Documents, Maintenance & Messages - Give buyers access to payment activity, important files, service requests and management communication.
Public Website - Property Discovery & Lead Generation
• Available Managed Properties - Show rental, owner-finance and mixed property opportunities to prospective customers.
• Property Details - Present property type, availability, location, features and pricing information.
• Rental & Owner-Finance Filters - Help visitors browse properties according to the type of opportunity they are looking for.
• Owner-Finance Information - Present owner-finance opportunities and payment-related information to interested buyers.
• ROI & Amortization Calculator - Provide an interactive calculator for estimated monthly payment, principal, interest, projected equity and yield-style analysis.
• Inquiry Form - Allow prospective customers to contact the management office about a property or service.
• FAQ & Service Information - Explain rental, owner-finance and maintenance processes to prospective customers.
4. Financial & Owner-Finance Intelligence
• Net Cash Flow Visibility - Combine property income with mortgage, tax, insurance and operating expenses to understand property-level net cash flow.
• Amortization Tracking - Track long-term payment schedules with principal and interest allocation over time.
• Balloon Payment Monitoring - Surface approaching balloon-payment obligations so management and buyers can plan ahead.
• Mortgage & Cost Oversight - Keep underlying mortgage balances and recurring property costs visible alongside income.
• Buyer Equity Progress - Show total paid, principal reduction and equity built to make owner-finance accounts easier to understand.
• Portfolio Alerts - Bring important financial and operational deadlines into one alert panel instead of relying on manual reminders.
5. How It Can Help Your Real Estate Business Grow
• Manage More Properties Efficiently - Centralized property, customer, payment, maintenance, document and financial workflows reduce the administrative burden of managing a growing portfolio.
• Support Multiple Revenue Models - Operate traditional rentals and owner-financed property sales within the same platform instead of maintaining separate systems.
• Improve Cash-Flow Visibility - Property-level income, costs and net cash flow help management understand which assets are performing well and which need attention.

ENTERPRISE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Manage Every Property, Tenant & Lease from One Platform
A centralized property operations platform for buildings, units, tenants, leases, rent collection, accounting, payroll, maintenance, communications and role-based access.
1. Overview
Enterprise Property Management Software is a centralized, role-based platform designed to help property managers manage day-to-day real estate operations from one connected workspace.

It brings property and unit management, tenant administration, lease workflows, rent collection, accounting, payroll, maintenance, communication and reporting together so teams can work more efficiently, keep records organized and maintain better operational visibility as the portfolio grows.
2. Complete Property Management Operations
• Overview Dashboard - Access a central view of property operations, with dedicated overview, vacancy and revenue dashboards for management visibility.
• Buildings & Units - Manage building records, unit information and unit-readiness activity from a structured property inventory.
• Tenant Management - Maintain tenant records and support tenant-related operational workflows from one central area.
• Vehicle Management - Record and manage tenant-linked vehicle information.
• Insurance Alerts - Track insurance-related alerts to support tenant and property compliance follow-up.
• Shuttle Management - Manage shuttle-related operations where the property or community provides transportation services.
• Owners - Maintain owner-related records within the property management platform.
• Lease Management - Manage lease records, lease history and lease-renewal workflows.
• Rent Roll - Maintain rent-roll visibility for managed properties and tenants.
• Documents - Keep property, tenant and operational documents organized within the system.
• Maintenance & Tickets - Manage maintenance activity and service tickets so open issues remain visible to the responsible team.
• Reports - Generate and review operational reports for property-management decision-making.
3. Rent Collection, Payments & Accounting
• Rent Collection & Ledger - Track rent collection and maintain a structured ledger of tenant payment activity.
• Payments Received - Review incoming payment records and payment history.
• Outstanding Dues - Identify unpaid or outstanding tenant balances that require follow-up.
• Refunds & Adjustments - Record and manage approved payment adjustments and refund-related activity.
• General Ledger - Maintain accounting records within the platform's financial workflow.
• QuickBooks Sync - Support QuickBooks synchronization as part of the accounting workflow.
• Chart of Accounts - Organize financial accounts for structured accounting and reporting.
• Tax Settings - Maintain tax-related configuration required for the property-management accounting process.
• Financial Visibility - Bring rent, payments, outstanding dues and accounting activity into one connected operational view.
4. Time, Payroll & Workforce Management
• Time & Payroll Dashboard - Access workforce and payroll information from a dedicated management area.
• Employees - Maintain employee records for the property-management team.
• Attendance - Track employee attendance information.
• Shifts - Manage staff shift schedules and working assignments.
• Leaves - Record and manage employee leave activity.
• Overtime - Track overtime information for payroll processing and management review.
• Run Payroll - Process payroll through the platform's payroll workflow.
• Audit Timeline - Maintain a timeline of payroll or workforce activity for internal review.
• Team Access Control - Manage staff access and permissions according to user responsibility.
5. Communication & Team Coordination
• SMS Hub - Centralize SMS communication through an inbox, campaign manager and reusable message templates.
• Email Hub - Send emails, maintain email templates and review sent-email history.
• Notes Hub - Keep internal operational notes in one accessible workspace.
• TAL Cases - Manage TAL case-related records from a dedicated module.
• Profile & Settings - Maintain user-profile information and system configuration from the platform.
6. Role-Based Portals
The software supports dedicated Admin, Tenant and Owner access. Role-based portals help users focus on the information and actions relevant to them while keeping administrative controls restricted.
Admin Portal - Complete Property Operations Control
• Full Operational Access - Manage dashboards, buildings, units, tenants, owners, leases, rent roll, documents, payments, accounting, payroll, communications, maintenance, reports and settings.
• Vacancy & Revenue Visibility - Use dedicated dashboard views to monitor occupancy-related activity and revenue performance.
• Lease & Tenant Administration - Maintain tenant records, lease history, lease renewals, vehicles, insurance alerts and related property activity.
• Financial Control - Monitor rent collection, payments received, outstanding dues, refunds, accounting records and tax settings.
• Workforce Control - Manage employees, attendance, shifts, leaves, overtime and payroll.
• Permission Management - Control team access according to staff responsibility.
Tenant Portal - Easy Self-Service for Residents
• Tenant Dashboard - Give tenants a clear view of their current rent, lease status, maintenance activity, insurance status and registered vehicles.
• My Lease - Allow tenants to review their lease-related information.
• My Invoices - Provide access to tenant invoices from the portal.
• Pay Rent - Give tenants a direct rent-payment workflow.
• My Documents - Keep tenant-accessible documents available in one secure account area.
• Insurance - Provide visibility into tenant insurance or compliance status.
• Maintenance Tickets - Allow tenants to review and follow maintenance requests.
• Messages - Support direct communication with the property-management team.
• My Vehicles - Allow tenants to review registered vehicle information.
• Reports - Provide tenant-accessible reporting where enabled.
Owner Portal - Owner-Focused Portfolio Access
• Dedicated Owner Access - Provide property owners with their own role-based portal instead of requiring access to the full administrative system.
• Portfolio Visibility - Present owner-relevant property information and reporting according to configured permissions.
• Controlled Access - Keep owner visibility separate from tenant and administrative workflows.
• Customizable Owner Experience - Owner-facing modules, financial views, reports and documents can be configured around the property's management model and reporting requirements.

• Manage More Properties with Less Administrative Work - Centralizing buildings, units, tenants, leases, payments, accounting and workforce activity reduces the need to manage the business through scattered spreadsheets and disconnected systems.

• Support Portfolio Expansion - A structured, role-based platform makes it easier to add more buildings, units, tenants, owners and staff as the business grows.

Yes. The platform includes building management, unit management and unit-readiness workflows for structured portfolio administration.

Yes. The Tenant Portal includes a dedicated Pay Rent workflow along with invoices and lease information.
Can we track outstanding tenant dues?
Yes. The Payments area includes outstanding-dues visibility along with rent collection, payment receipts, refunds and adjustments.

Yes. The Leases module includes lease history and lease-renewal workflows.

Yes. Tenant management includes Vehicle Management and Insurance Alerts, and the Tenant Portal includes My Vehicles and Insurance sections.
Does the system include accounting?
Yes. Accounting functionality includes General Ledger, QuickBooks Sync, Chart of Accounts and Tax Settings.
Can we manage staff attendance and payroll?
Yes. The Time & Payroll area includes employees, attendance, shifts, leaves, overtime, payroll and an audit timeline.

Yes. The platform includes an SMS Hub with inbox, campaign manager and templates, plus an Email Hub with sending, templates and sent-email history.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
SERVICE LEAD & JOB MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
From Lead Discovery to Quote, Assignment, Execution and Payment
A connected platform for service businesses to manage leads, professional onboarding, quotations, job assignment, field execution, notifications and payment workflows from one place.
1. Overview

Service Lead & Job Management Software is a digital operations platform built for service-based businesses and professionals that need to manage leads, quotations, job allocation and field execution in one connected workflow.

The platform helps businesses move from customer request to completed service with clearer pricing, better task visibility, organized professional records and structured communication throughout the job lifecycle.
2. Core Platform Capabilities
• Lead Discovery & Search - Customers can search for the service they need and use location or postcode-based discovery to find relevant service options.
• Lead Management - Service requests can be managed as actionable leads instead of remaining scattered across calls, messages or manual notes.
• Quote Creation - Create structured quotes with guided measurements or scope, transparent pricing breakdowns and approval steps.
• Lead Selling or Assignment - Businesses can sell leads or assign jobs to professionals according to their operating model.
• Professional Registration - Service professionals can request an account by submitting identity, contact, business, specialty and location information.
• Category & Specialty Setup - Professionals can register under a service category such as plumbing, electrical or other supported specialties.
• Project / Service Plans - Professional onboarding includes plan selection, supporting a plan-based service model.
• Task Assignment & Tracking - Assign work and monitor tasks from start through completion.
• Proof of Work & Compliance - Support proof-of-work and compliance-related job closure steps.
• Job Status Tracking - Monitor job progress with real-time status visibility through the execution workflow.
• Notifications - Keep professionals and teams informed with job-related notifications during assignment and execution.
• Rescheduling - Support easier rescheduling where job timing needs to change.
• Payments - Include payment-related steps as part of the end-to-end service workflow.
• Mobile App Access - The platform promotes mobile access through downloadable applications for professionals and field users.
3. Customer & Lead Experience
• Simple Service Search - Customers can begin by entering the service required and their location or postcode.
• Clear Job Details - Lead and job information can include rich details to help professionals understand the work before accepting or quoting.
• Transparent Quotation - Structured pricing and scope information helps reduce confusion between customers and service providers.
• Approval & Signature - The quotation workflow supports approval and signature steps before work progresses.
• Track Work to Completion - The platform is designed around a clear request-to-completion journey rather than disconnected job stages.
4. Professional / Service Provider Experience
• Professional Registration - Professionals can apply with name, business name, email, phone, specialty, plan and address details.
• Business Profile Setup - Business identity and service location information are captured during onboarding.
• Preferred Plan Selection - Professionals can select a preferred service plan during registration.
• Assigned Jobs - Professionals can receive job assignments based on the business workflow.
• Field Execution - Assigned work can be tracked through status updates, notifications and completion steps.
• Mobile Workflow - App access supports professionals who need to manage work while away from a desktop.
5. From Lead to Job Completion
• Step 1 - Receive or Discover the Lead - Capture a customer request through the service-search and lead workflow.
• Step 2 - Build the Quote - Define scope, measurements and pricing, then move the quote toward approval.
• Step 3 - Sell or Assign the Job - Route the opportunity to the appropriate business or professional.
• Step 4 - Execute & Track - Manage assigned tasks, job status, notifications and any required rescheduling.
• Step 5 - Verify & Close - Use proof-of-work, compliance and closure steps to complete the service lifecycle.
• Step 6 - Payment - Track the payment-related stage as part of the completed job workflow.

1. Overview

Business Accounting, Inventory & GST Management Software is a centralized digital platform designed for companies that want to manage billing, stock, accounts, purchase and sales activity, GST reporting and day-to-day financial operations from one secure workspace.

The platform combines company-level business operations with a separate Super Admin SaaS console for company onboarding, subscriptions and global settings, making it suitable for both individual businesses and scalable multi-company software deployments.

• Inventory Management - Track stock, batches and low-stock conditions while keeping inventory activity organized for day-to-day operations.
• POS Billing - Support fast billing workflows with barcode-scanning and thermal-printing capabilities shown in the product feature set.
• Bill Book - Maintain sales and purchase invoice history in one structured billing area.
• Accounts Management - Track double-entry ledgers and daily cash-balance activity for clearer financial control.
• Account Summary - View consolidated account information across cash, bank and overall balances.
• Inventory Summary - Review inventory from category, brand and item-level summary views.
• Final Accounts - Access final-account reporting, including Trading and Profit & Loss-related financial views.
• GST Reports - Support GST reporting workflows with GSTR summary and filing-oriented report access, including GSTR-1, GSTR-2 and GSTR-3B references shown in the platform.
• Audit Logs - Maintain visibility of user activity and audited entries for stronger operational traceability.
• Multi-Language Support - Provide access in English, Hindi and other regional-language configurations where supported.
• Day Book Summary - View daily transaction summaries covering business activity such as sales and expenses.
• Expiry Report - Track stock-expiry information and alerts for items that require timely attention.
3. Company Admin Workspace
The Company Admin portal is the main operating workspace for a registered business and brings key financial, stock and billing information into one dashboard.

• Today Purchase - Monitor current-day purchase activity.
• Current Stock Status - View the current inventory position from the dashboard.
• Today's Expenses - Track current-day business expenses.
• Customer Outstanding - Monitor amounts receivable from customers.
• Company Outstanding - Track outstanding amounts associated with company-side obligations or balances.

• Sales Trend - Review sales performance over selectable periods such as 30 days or 12 months.

• Inventory - Manage stock and inventory records.
• POS Billing - Run point-of-sale billing workflows.
• Bill Book - Access sales and purchase invoice history.

• Stock Details - Jump directly to stock information.

1. Overview

HRM, Payroll & Employee Management Software is a centralized workforce administration platform designed to help organizations manage employee records, payroll operations, attendance, leave, salary processes, payslips, reporting and system administration from one connected environment.

• Company Selection - Authorized users can select the company or payroll environment they need to work with before continuing into operations.
• Multiple Payroll Frequencies - The company-selection area shows support for monthly, weekly and fortnightly payroll frequencies.
• Multi-Tenant Employee Portal - The software is structured for company-based employee access so multiple organizations or payroll entities can be managed through a controlled environment.
• System Period & Regional Context - Operational screens display the active system period and regional context, helping users work within the correct payroll period and company environment.
3. HRM & Employee Management
• Employee Management - Maintain employee information and workforce records from a dedicated HRM module.
• Attendance Management - Organize employee attendance information as part of the HR and payroll workflow.
• Leave Management - Manage leave activity and provide employees with a self-service leave-request option.
• Salary Management - Maintain salary-related information used within payroll administration.
• Payroll Management - Centralize payroll-related HR operations and connect employee records with payroll processing.
• User Provisioning - Create and edit system users from the administration console so access can be controlled by authorized personnel.
• Employee Profile Updates - Employee self-service includes profile updates for personal details such as address and banking information.
4. Payroll & Finance Operations
