• Transaction Entry - Record payroll-related transactions through a dedicated transaction-entry workflow.
• Entered Transaction Register - Review transactions that have been entered before or during payroll processing.
• Time Keeper - Maintain time-related payroll inputs through the Finance workflow.
• Post Transactions - Move processed transaction information into the posted payroll workflow when ready.
• Posted Transaction Register - Review posted payroll transactions in a dedicated register.
• Payroll Calculation - Run payroll calculation activities from the finance module.
• Calculation Register - Review calculated payroll results through the Calculation Register.
• Payroll Update - Apply payroll updates as part of the processing cycle.
• Payroll Register - Maintain a detailed payroll register after processing.
• Payroll Register Summary - Review summarized payroll information for management and reconciliation purposes.
• Pay Disbursement - Manage the payroll disbursement stage after calculations and payroll updates are complete.
• TRN-Protected Payslips - The interface includes a Generate & Email payslip workflow identified as TRN protected.
• Cheque Printing - Support physical payment workflows through cheque-printing options.
• Electronic Payments - Support electronic-payment workflows from the Finance menu.
5. Reports & Statutory Reporting Workflows
• Regulatory Reports Hub - Access a centralized reporting area for regulatory and statutory reporting workflows.
• Statutory Returns - Maintain statutory-return related reporting from the Reports module.
• Employee Report - Review workforce-related information in a dedicated employee report.
• Attendance Report - Analyze attendance information for payroll and HR review.
• Payroll Report - Review payroll processing information and results.
• Salary Report - Review salary-related information in report format.
• Payroll Summary - Use summarized payroll information for management review.
• Transaction Register - Review payroll and finance transactions through the reporting area.
• Turnover Report - Monitor workforce turnover information.
• Year-to-Date Breakdown - Review year-to-date payroll or employee information in a structured breakdown.
• Retention Report - Monitor employee retention information for management visibility.
• Crystal Reporting Interface - The Reports menu includes a Crystal Reporting Interface option for report-oriented workflows.
• Bank Transfer Advice - Generate or manage bank-transfer advice information from the reporting area.
• Email P24 Advice - The reporting interface includes an Email P24 Advice workflow.
6. System Administration, Audit & Data Management
• Company Setup - Maintain master organization details and company-level configuration.
• Customized Modules - The system menu includes customized-module configuration for organization-specific requirements.
• System Configuration - Maintain regional, security and system preferences from the administration area.
• System Logs & Audit Trails - View system logs and audit-related activity through dedicated administration options.
• Backup & Restore - Use built-in backup and restore functions for operational data management.
• Import & Export Data - The Files module includes data import and export functions for controlled data handling.
• Preference Configuration - Maintain payroll and user-interface preferences from the administration console.
• Operational Monitoring - The administration console includes indicators for active users, employees, database health, processing output and audit logs.
• System Advisory - Display operational notices or scheduled system advisories to authorized administrators.
7. Employee / User Self-Service
• Payroll Snapshot - Employees can view information such as the next pay date and most recent net pay from their portal.
• Leave Balance - The self-service dashboard displays the employee leave balance for quick reference.
• Tax Status - The employee portal displays tax-status information and identifies P24-related status where configured.
• My Payslips - Employees can access payslip history from their own self-service area.
• Request Leave - Employees can submit leave or vacation requests directly from the portal.
• Tax Documents - The portal includes access to tax-document workflows identified as P24 and P45 forms.
• Update Profile - Employees can update profile information including address and banking details.
• Recent Documents - Recent payslips, tax certificates and leave documents can be displayed for convenient access and download.
• Notice Board - Important employee announcements and assessment notices can be surfaced in the self-service portal.

The software can be customized around your organization structure, employee categories, payroll process, pay frequencies, reporting requirements, approval flows and regional operating needs.

Yes. Attendance Management and Leave Management are included in the HRM module.

Manage Clients, Matters, WIP, Compliance & Legal Performance from One Platform

1. Overview

Enterprise Legal CRM, Case Management & BI Software is a centralized, role-based platform designed to help law firms, chambers and legal teams manage client relationships, legal matters, financial performance and operational activity from one connected workspace.

• CRM Dashboard - Access a dedicated CRM view for monitoring lead activity, client relationships, pipeline movement and business-development performance.
• Leads - Capture and manage prospective clients and new-business opportunities from a structured lead pipeline.
• Contacts - Maintain organized contact records for prospects, clients and other relevant legal relationships.
• Clients - Maintain centralized client records and support a client 360-degree view across matters, billing activity and relationship history.
• Deals - Track commercial opportunities and deal values as part of the firm's legal sales pipeline.
• Sales Funnel - Monitor prospects as they move through qualification, engagement and conversion stages.
• Cross-Sell Visibility - Use client and matter information to identify suitable cross-selling opportunities across practice areas and services.

• Cases & Matters - Maintain legal case and matter records in a dedicated workspace with status visibility and operational tracking.
• Matter Pipeline & Velocity - Track active matters, progression and turnaround indicators so management can identify delays and workload movement.
• Case Performance - Review matter and case performance to understand activity, completion trends and operational results.
• Case Status Overview - View live matters by status such as active, in progress, awaiting action, completed or overdue where configured.
• Department & Fee-Earner Filters - Review performance and case activity across departments and fee earners using management-level filters.
• Operational Activity Feed - Keep recent case, workflow and synchronization activity visible to authorized users.
4. Financial, WIP & Aged-Debt Management
• Financial Reporting - Access legal finance information from a dedicated reporting area for management review.
• Time Recording & WIP Control - Support time-recording and work-in-progress visibility so billable activity can be monitored before invoicing.
• WIP Overview - Review unbilled work across aging brackets to identify work that needs billing or management attention.
• Aged Debt - Monitor overdue receivables by aging period and highlight balances that require collection follow-up.
• Client Profitability - Evaluate client-level profitability to understand the commercial value and performance of legal relationships.
• Revenue Visibility - Track billed revenue alongside case volumes and other operational indicators.
• Department Performance - Compare open cases, completed work, revenue, WIP and performance across legal departments or practice areas.
5. Executive Reporting & Legal Business Intelligence

• Risk-Focused Reporting - Use operational and compliance data to support review of high-risk matters, client checks and required follow-up where configured.
• Role-Based Governance - Restrict sensitive legal, financial and administrative information according to user responsibility.
• Audit-Ready Operational Records - Maintain structured activity, synchronization and workflow histories that can support internal review and operational accountability.

• Workflow Activity Monitoring - Review automation status, processed items and workflow outcomes from the management workspace.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
MANUFACTURING QUALITY CONTROL & QUALITY MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Role-Based Production, Quality Control, Defect, Complaint, Supplier & Analytics Management in One Platform

A centralized manufacturing quality platform designed to improve visibility across production, inspection, quality results, defects, complaints, suppliers and performance analytics while keeping operational access structured by role.
1. Overview

Manufacturing Quality Control & Quality Management Software is a centralized platform designed for manufacturing businesses that need clearer control over production quality, inspections, defects, complaints, supplier-related workflows and operational performance from one connected environment.

The system combines role-based access with a live manufacturing dashboard so different teams can focus on the information and modules relevant to their responsibilities. Management can monitor batch activity, quality pass rates, active defects, complaint volume, production capacity, rejection performance and trend-based insights without relying on scattered spreadsheets or disconnected records.
2. Role-Based Access & Controlled Operations
• Secure Sign-In - Users access the system through an authenticated email and password login before entering their authorized workspace.
• Admin - The Admin workspace provides access to Dashboard, Production, Quality Control, Defects, Complaints, Analytics and Suppliers for broad operational oversight.
• Quality Manager - The Quality Manager workspace focuses on Dashboard, Quality Control, Defects, Complaints and Analytics for quality-focused supervision and decision-making.
• Production Manager - The Production Manager workspace focuses on Dashboard and Production, helping production leadership work within a dedicated operational area.
• Inspector - The Inspector workspace is centered on Quality Control, keeping inspection-related access focused and simplified.
• Supplier Manager - The Supplier Manager workspace provides access to Analytics and Suppliers for supplier-oriented operational oversight.
• Complaint Handler - The Complaint Handler workspace provides access to Complaints and Analytics, supporting a focused complaint-management responsibility.
• Viewer - The Viewer role provides dashboard visibility without exposing the wider operational modules shown for management roles.
• Role Separation - Different menus are shown by role, helping reduce unnecessary access and keeping each team member focused on the functions relevant to their responsibilities.
3. Production & Batch Monitoring
• Production Workspace - A dedicated Production module is available to authorized roles for manufacturing-production related operations.
• Total Batch Visibility - The dashboard displays total batch activity so management can understand the current production workload at a glance.
• Daily Capacity Monitoring - Daily production capacity is displayed as a key operating metric for quick management review.
• Production Trend - A six-month production trend compares units produced against target, giving teams a clear view of output direction and performance over time.
• Production Manager Access - A dedicated Production Manager role helps separate production responsibilities from quality, supplier and complaint workflows.
• Management Visibility - Production information is presented alongside quality and rejection indicators, helping leadership understand how output and quality performance relate to each other.
4. Quality Control & Inspection Management
• Quality Control Module - A dedicated Quality Control workspace is available for authorized quality and inspection roles.
• QC Pass Rate - The dashboard provides a visible quality-control pass-rate KPI for fast quality-performance monitoring.
• QC Results Breakdown - Quality results are summarized as Pass, Fail and In Review, giving users a simple view of inspection outcomes and items still requiring review.
• Inspector-Focused Access - Inspectors receive a simplified Quality Control workspace so they can work without unnecessary exposure to unrelated modules.
• Quality Manager Oversight - Quality Managers can combine Quality Control, Defects, Complaints and Analytics to review quality performance from a broader management perspective.
• Rejection Rate Monitoring - The dashboard tracks rejection rate as a dedicated metric, helping teams monitor quality loss and improvement trends.
5. Defect & Complaint Management
• Defects Workspace - A dedicated Defects module is available to authorized quality and admin roles for centralized defect-related operations.
• Active Defects - The dashboard displays the number of active defects so unresolved quality issues remain visible to management.
• Critical Defect Visibility - Critical-open indicators highlight urgent defect conditions that require management attention.
• Complaints Workspace - A dedicated Complaints module keeps complaint-related activity separate from production and inspection work.
• Open Complaints - The dashboard displays open complaint volume and highlights high-priority complaint activity for faster management awareness.
• Complaint Handler Role - A dedicated Complaint Handler role allows complaint-focused users to work within a targeted Complaints and Analytics workspace.
• Faster Follow-Up - By keeping defect and complaint information visible in the same quality environment, teams can reduce delays in identifying and following up on operational issues.
6. Supplier & Analytics Management
• Suppliers Module - A dedicated Suppliers workspace is available to authorized users for supplier-related operational management.
• Supplier Manager Role - Supplier Managers receive a focused interface with access to Suppliers and Analytics rather than the complete system menu.
• Analytics Workspace - Analytics is available across several management roles, allowing production, quality, supplier and complaint information to be reviewed from a performance perspective.
• Cross-Functional Visibility - Admin and management roles can use shared performance information to connect manufacturing output, quality results, rejection activity, defects and complaints.
• Better Management Decisions - Consolidated operational metrics can help leadership identify recurring quality concerns, production pressure and areas that require closer review.
7. Live Dashboard & Management Insights
• Live Operations View - The dashboard presents a live manufacturing overview with current operational status and role-specific access.
• Total Batches - Monitor batch volume from the main dashboard.
• QC Pass Rate - Track quality-control performance as a percentage KPI.
• Active Defects - Keep unresolved defects visible to the appropriate management roles.
• Open Complaints - Monitor complaint volume and priority indicators from the same operational dashboard.
• Daily Capacity - Review production-capacity information alongside quality and issue metrics.
• Rejection Rate - Track rejected-output performance and improvement movement over time.
• Production Trend - Review units produced against target across a six-month period.
• QC Result Mix - View Pass, Fail and In Review distribution for quick quality-status understanding.

• Improve Quality Consistency - Centralized quality-control visibility helps teams identify poor results and rejection trends sooner, supporting more consistent manufacturing output.

INTELLIGENT LOAN MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Manage the Complete Lending Journey from Application to Recovery

A centralized, role-based lending operations platform for employee loan applications, eligibility verification, credit assessment, approvals, disbursements, payroll-linked repayments, management analytics and recovery workflows.
1. Overview
Intelligent Loan Management Software is a centralized, role-based platform designed to help organizations manage the full lending lifecycle from one connected workspace.

It brings borrower self-service, HR verification, application processing, credit assessment, finance operations, portfolio analytics and recovery management together so each team can work within a dedicated portal while management maintains visibility across the complete loan pipeline.
2. Complete Loan Application & Borrower Management
• Borrower Dashboard - Give employees or borrowers a clear view of their loan status, current balance, upcoming deduction, eligibility and recent account activity.
• Apply New Loan - Provide a structured self-service workflow for submitting new loan applications.
• Application Status - Allow users to review the progress and current state of their loan requests from their own portal.
• Statements - Keep borrower statements accessible from a dedicated account area.
• Letters & Documents - Provide secure access to loan-related letters and documents from the borrower portal.
• Settlement & Paid-Up Requests - Support borrower requests for settlement letters, paid-up letters and other configured loan correspondence.
• Borrower Profile - Maintain user profile information required for loan servicing and account management.
• Recent Activity - Present payment, disbursement and other account activity in a structured history view.
• Payroll-Linked Repayment Visibility - Show upcoming payroll deduction information where repayment is connected to the employee payroll process.
3. HR Verification & Employee Eligibility
• HR Verification Hub - Give the HR team a dedicated workspace for reviewing verification queues and employee eligibility.
• Pending Verification Queue - Keep submitted and HR-pending applications visible so required checks can be completed in an organized sequence.
• Employee Directory - Maintain access to employee records required for verification and lending workflows.
• Approval & Rejection Tracking - Track verification outcomes and provide management visibility into pending, approved and rejected activity.
• Activity Reports - Review HR-related lending activity through a dedicated reporting area.
• Queue Management - Use an operational queue to prioritize applications waiting for HR action.
4. Application Operations & Administration
• Operations Dashboard - Monitor total applications, pending reviews, approvals and rejections from an administrative overview.
• Application Management - Review lending applications as they move through the approval pipeline.
• Employee Management - Maintain employee-related records required across lending operations.
• Recent Application Activity - See applicant, employer, requested amount and current stage information in one operational view.
• Pipeline Health - Monitor approval-rate and processing-velocity indicators to understand workflow performance.
• Search & Filtering - Locate employee or application information quickly through operational search and filtering tools.
5. Credit Assessment & Risk Review
• Credit Operations Dashboard - Provide credit teams with a dedicated view of assessments waiting in queue, high-risk cases and completed approvals.
• Credit Queue - Organize applications that require credit assessment and analyst action.
• Risk Reviews - Support structured review of borrower risk before final lending decisions are completed.
• Credit Score Visibility - Display applicant credit-score information within the assessment workflow where available.
• Risk Classification - Identify cases by risk level so high-priority or higher-risk applications remain visible.
• Assessment Workflow - Allow credit personnel to open and process prioritized assessments from their own workspace.
• Credit Policy Metrics - Provide credit-performance indicators such as average score and rejection rate for operational monitoring.
6. Finance, Payouts & Disbursement Control
• Finance Executive Dashboard - Give the finance team a dedicated view of pending payout value, total disbursed value and failed-payment activity.
• Payout Queue - Organize approved loans waiting for finance action and disbursement.
• Bank Detail Verification - Support finance checks of beneficiary and bank information before initiating payout.
• Batch Processing - Process grouped finance activity through a dedicated batch-processing workflow.
• Payout History - Maintain a history of finance and disbursement activity for review.
• Audit History - Provide access to finance-related audit history for operational accountability.
• Failed Payment Visibility - Keep unsuccessful or failed payment activity visible for follow-up.
7. Management Analytics & Portfolio Visibility
• Executive Insights - Present management with a high-level view of lending performance and portfolio activity.
• Analytics - Review performance indicators and trends through a dedicated analytics workspace.
• Reports - Access management reporting without requiring operational teams to share disconnected spreadsheets.
• Revenue Visibility - Monitor total lending-related revenue or configured financial performance measures.
• Portfolio Yield - Track portfolio-yield information to support management review of lending performance.
• Disbursement Trends - Visualize disbursement movement over time for portfolio monitoring.
• Application Status Distribution - Review how applications are distributed across stages such as submitted, HR pending, HR approved and credit pending.
• Active Portfolio Visibility - Monitor active customer or borrower portfolio information according to the organization’s configured lending model.
8. Recovery & Collections Management
• Recovery Performance Dashboard - Give recovery users a dedicated workspace for assigned accounts, arrears and collection performance.
• Recovery Cases - Manage accounts requiring collection or recovery follow-up from one structured module.
• Payment Tracking - Track repayment activity and collections against recovery cases.
• Portfolio Arrears - Monitor the value of accounts currently in arrears.
• Active Recovery Cases - Maintain visibility into the number of accounts requiring ongoing recovery action.
• Collection Efficiency - Measure recovery performance over a defined period.
• Portfolio Aging - Segment overdue accounts into aging bands to support collection prioritization.
• Priority Collections - Surface borrowers and outstanding balances that require focused recovery action.
9. Role-Based Portals

The software supports separate User/Employee, HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery workspaces. Each role can be restricted to the information and actions required for its responsibilities.
User / Employee Portal - Loan Self-Service
• Personal Loan Overview - Review active loan status, balance, deductions, eligibility, statements and recent activity.
• Self-Service Requests - Apply for loans, check status and access letters or documents without requiring full administrative access.
HR Portal - Verification Control
• Employee Verification - Review employment-related eligibility and move applications through the HR verification stage.
• HR Reporting - Access employee, queue and activity information relevant to HR responsibilities.
Admin Portal - Operational Control
• Application Oversight - Manage applications, employees and pipeline activity across the lending process.
• Operational Monitoring - Track application volumes, pending reviews, stages and workflow health.
Credit Portal - Risk & Assessment
• Credit Decision Support - Review credit queues, scores, risk classifications and prioritized assessments.
Finance Portal - Disbursement Control
• Payout Management - Control approved disbursements, batch processing, history and bank-verification activity.
Management Portal - Executive Intelligence
• Portfolio Analytics - Review financial, application and portfolio performance from a management-focused dashboard.
Recovery Portal - Collections Control
• Collections Management - Manage overdue accounts, payment tracking, aging and recovery performance from a dedicated workspace.
10. How It Can Help Your Lending Operations Grow
• Manage the Full Loan Lifecycle in One System - Centralizing application, verification, credit, finance and recovery activity reduces dependence on separate spreadsheets and disconnected tools.
• Improve Processing Visibility - Role-specific queues and dashboards make it easier to see where each application is currently waiting and which team needs to act next.
• Deliver Better Borrower Self-Service - Employees can apply, track status, review balances, access statements and request letters from their own portal.
• Strengthen Credit Control - Dedicated credit queues, risk reviews and score visibility help keep assessment activity structured and traceable.
• Improve Finance Accountability - Payout queues, bank-detail checks, batch processing and audit history give finance teams clearer operational control.
• Support Faster Management Decisions - Executive analytics, portfolio yield, application distribution and trend reporting provide a clearer view of lending performance.
• Improve Recovery Prioritization - Arrears, aging, active cases and priority collections help recovery teams focus on accounts that need attention.
• Scale Across Teams - Separate HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery workspaces allow the platform to support more structured operations as lending volume grows.
11. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements

The software can be adapted around your lending products, employee or borrower journey, approval structure, credit policy, finance process, repayment model, recovery strategy and internal operating procedures.
• Branding - Logo, software name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
• Roles & Permissions - User, HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery access can be modified, and additional roles can be developed where required.
• Loan Products - Application fields, loan types, eligibility rules, limits, instalment structures and product-specific workflows can be configured according to project requirements.
• Approval Workflow - HR verification, administrative review, credit assessment, management approvals and finance gatekeeping stages can be adjusted to match your operating model.
• Credit & Risk Rules - Risk categories, score thresholds, review steps and credit-policy controls can be tailored around the organization’s lending policy.
• Repayment & Payroll - Deduction schedules, repayment visibility and payroll-linked processes can be adapted according to the selected implementation model.
• Finance & Disbursement - Payout approvals, banking checks, batch processing, finance history and related controls can be configured.
• Recovery - Aging bands, collection stages, assignment rules, payment tracking and recovery reporting can be customized.
• Dashboards & Reports - KPIs, analytics, filters, exports and management reports can be adjusted around the information your business needs.
• Integrations - Suitable payroll, banking, payment, identity, credit-data, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
12. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your lending operations instead of forcing every organization into one fixed workflow.
• Role-Based Architecture - Dedicated workspaces keep borrowers and operational teams focused on the information relevant to their responsibilities.
• End-to-End Process Coverage - The platform can support the lending journey from application and verification through assessment, finance and recovery.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout customization and implementation.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The system can evolve with new loan products, policies, roles, reports, workflows and integrations as the organization expands.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
13. FAQ
Can employees apply for a loan from their own portal?
Yes. The User/Employee portal includes an Apply Loan workflow together with loan-status, statement, document and profile access.
Can the system show loan balance and repayment information?
Yes. The borrower dashboard can present current balance, loan status, upcoming deduction information, eligibility and recent activity.
Does the software include HR verification?
Yes. The HR workspace includes verification queues, employee access and activity reporting for employment or eligibility checks.
Can credit teams review risk before approval?
Yes. The Credit workspace includes a credit queue, risk reviews, assessment actions, score visibility and risk-level information where configured.
Can finance manage disbursements?
Yes. Finance users can work with payout queues, bank-detail verification, batch processing, payout history and audit history.
Does the system support management reporting?
Yes. The Management workspace includes analytics, reports, performance indicators, disbursement trends and application-status visibility.
Can overdue accounts be managed?
Yes. Recovery users can work with recovery cases, payment tracking, arrears, aging and priority collections.
Can different departments have different access?
Yes. The platform is structured around separate User, HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery roles, and permissions can be customized.
Can the loan workflow be customized?
Yes. Application fields, products, eligibility rules, approval stages, credit controls, finance workflows, repayment processes and recovery stages can be tailored to project requirements.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.

Build a lending-management platform around your applicants, employees, approvals, credit policy, finance operations, repayments, portfolio analytics and recovery processes.
See the software in action, discuss the roles, workflows and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your lending operation.

204.title: Hostel Management Software
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
HOSTEL MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Hostel Discovery, Booking, Student Rent, Meal Plan, Room, Resident & Property Operations in One Platform

A centralized hostel management solution designed for student accommodation and hostel businesses, combining public property discovery, role-based portals, rent tracking, resident services, owner operations and platform-level administration in one structured system.
1. Overview

Hostel Management Software is a centralized platform designed for hostel operators, property owners, student residents and administrators who need an organized way to manage accommodation discovery, bookings, rooms, residents, rent, meal plans, facilities, maintenance, requests and platform operations.

The system combines a public hostel discovery website with secure role-based portals. Students can manage their stay and services, property owners can operate hostels and residents, and platform administrators can supervise hostels, users, approvals, reports and settings from a central dashboard.
2. Role-Based Access & Controlled Operations
• Secure Sign-In - Users access the system through an authenticated email and password login before entering their authorized workspace.
• Student - The Student portal provides access to My Dashboard, My Rent, Meal Plan, Maintenance, Notices and Requests for resident self-service.

• Property Owner / Hostel Owner - The owner workspace provides access to Dashboard, Register Hostel, Manage Rooms, Residents, Bookings, Rent Tracker, Visitor Log, Mess Management, Maintenance, Facilities, Compliance, Communication and Tenant Requests.
• Admin / Super Admin - Platform administration provides access to Dashboard, Manage Hostels, Manage Users, Reports and Settings for overall supervision and governance.
• Role Selection - The login experience supports role-based entry so users are directed to the appropriate portal and functions.
• Controlled Visibility - Different menus and data views are shown according to role, reducing unnecessary access and keeping each user focused on relevant responsibilities.
• Separate Operational Workspaces - Student, owner and administrative workflows remain logically separated while operating within the same platform.
• Account-Level Security - Login, role separation and controlled portal access help keep resident, property and administrative information better organized.
• Scalable User Structure - The role model can be expanded with staff, manager, accountant, warden or additional custom roles when required.
3. Public Hostel Discovery & Booking Platform
• Hostel Search - Visitors can search accommodation by city, area and target user type from the public website.
• City & Destination Discovery - Popular destinations help users explore hostel availability across major locations.
• Featured Properties - Highlight selected hostels with room imagery, monthly pricing, facilities and quick property access.
• Verified Quality Presentation - Property cards can communicate verified status, amenities and accommodation details to improve trust during selection.
• Compare & Discover - Users can review available options, pricing and property details before deciding where to stay.
• Booking-Focused Experience - The public journey is designed to move users from discovery to property selection and booking with minimal friction.
4. Student Resident Portal
• Personal Dashboard - Students receive a dedicated dashboard showing their assigned room, property and current accommodation status.
• Rent Visibility - Monthly rent is displayed clearly with a direct Pay Rent action for quick resident access.
• Meal Plan - Students can view the current meal-plan package and monthly meal charge from their account.
• Maintenance - Residents can access maintenance support and monitor active maintenance requirements from the portal.
• Notices - Hostel notices and important resident communications can be made available directly inside the student workspace.
• Requests - Students can submit or manage requests without depending on manual paper-based communication.
5. Property Owner / Hostel Owner Management
• Hostel Registration - Owners can register hostel properties and manage their accommodation portfolio from one owner account.
• Room Management - Create and manage room inventory, bed availability and room-level accommodation information.
• Resident Management - Maintain resident records and view active residents associated with the selected hostel.
• Booking Management - Review booking activity and recent booking requests, including approval status.
• Rent Tracker - Track resident rent activity and use quick actions to record rent or follow up on outstanding amounts.
• Visitor Log - Maintain visitor-related records for better hostel operational control and resident safety processes.
• Mess Management - Manage meal-related operations alongside accommodation and resident services.
6. Rent, Facilities & Resident Services
• Occupancy Overview - Owners can review room and bed occupancy indicators from the dashboard for quicker availability decisions.
• Facility Management - Manage or communicate available resident facilities such as Wi-Fi, parking, laundry and personal storage.
• Maintenance Operations - Track hostel maintenance activity and provide a clear service channel for residents.
• Compliance - A dedicated compliance area gives owners a structured place for operational compliance-related management.
• Communication - Centralized communication tools can support owner-to-resident updates and service coordination.
7. Super Admin & Platform Oversight
• Platform Overview - The Super Admin dashboard provides a consolidated view of hostel count, users, approvals, bookings, revenue and ratings.
• Manage Hostels - Review and administer hostel properties registered across the platform.
• Manage Users - Maintain oversight of student and owner accounts from a central administrative workspace.
• Pending Approvals - Keep pending hostel or account approval items visible for faster administrative action.
• Booking Overview - Track platform-level booking activity and pending booking indicators.
• Revenue Visibility - Review platform revenue information from the administrative dashboard.
• Ratings Overview - Monitor average property ratings across the platform for service-quality visibility.
• Reports - Access reporting functions for management review and platform-level performance analysis.
• Settings - Configure platform-level preferences and administrative controls from a centralized settings area.
8. How It Can Help Your Hostel Business Grow
• Increase Property Visibility - A public discovery website helps hostel owners present properties, rooms and facilities to a wider audience.
• Improve Occupancy - Search, destination discovery, property listings and streamlined booking can help convert more visitors into residents.
• Simplify Daily Operations - Rooms, residents, bookings, rent, maintenance, mess, facilities and communication are organized inside one operating environment.
• Reduce Manual Rent Follow-Up - Central rent visibility, resident payment access and owner-side rent tracking reduce dependence on spreadsheets and scattered records.
• Improve Resident Experience - Students can view rent, meal plans, facilities, notices and requests from their own self-service portal.
• Respond Faster to Requests - Maintenance and resident request areas give owners a clearer process for handling service needs.
• Strengthen Operational Control - Occupancy, resident, booking and approval visibility helps management identify what needs attention without checking multiple systems.
• Build Trust with Better Information - Verified properties, clear pricing, facilities, property details and role-based access can support a more professional booking experience.
• Support Multi-Property Growth - Owners can manage hostel portfolios while the Super Admin can supervise many properties and users at platform level.
• Make Better Decisions - Dashboards, ratings, bookings, occupancy, residents and revenue indicators give management a stronger basis for planning and growth.
9. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements

The software can be customized around your hostel business model, property structure, resident journey, booking rules, rent process, meal plans, facility packages, staff roles, compliance needs and reporting requirements.
• Branding - Software name, logo, colors, domain and interface styling can be adapted to your company identity.
• Roles & Permissions - Student, Property Owner, Super Admin and additional staff roles can be configured around your organization.
• Property & Room Structure - Hostel, building, floor, room, bed and accommodation categories can be tailored to your operational model.
• Booking Rules - Booking fields, approval steps, availability rules, deposits and booking statuses can be configured as required.
• Rent & Payment Workflows - Rent cycles, due dates, payment tracking, receipts, late-fee rules and payment gateway integrations can be added according to project scope.
• Meal & Facility Plans - Meal packages, Wi-Fi, parking, laundry, lockers and other paid or included facilities can be configured around your services.
• Maintenance & Requests - Ticket forms, priorities, statuses, assignment workflows and resident request processes can be customized.
• Dashboards & Reports - KPIs, charts, exports, occupancy reports, rent reports, user reports and management analytics can be tailored to business needs.
• Notifications & Communication - Email, SMS, WhatsApp or in-app alerts can be integrated where required and supported by the selected providers.
• Mobile & Third-Party Integrations - Payment gateways, maps, identity verification, accounting or other third-party services can be integrated based on agreed requirements and provider availability.
10. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your hostel workflow instead of forcing every accommodation business into the same fixed process.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies, delivery expectations and customization decisions are communicated clearly throughout the project.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The system can evolve with additional properties, rooms, branches, staff roles, services, reports and integrations as your business grows.
• Role-Based Operational Control - Separate Student, Property Owner and Super Admin workspaces help keep responsibilities clear while maintaining management visibility.

• Organized & Safer Data Handling - Centralized, permission-controlled workflows help keep resident and property records better organized and reduce unnecessary access compared with scattered manual records.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
11. Frequently Asked Questions
What type of businesses can use this software?
The platform is suitable for student hostels, private hostels, co-living operators, paying guest accommodation, shared housing providers and multi-property hostel businesses.
Which user roles are available in the current system?
The current system shows Student, Property Owner and Admin access, with dedicated Student, Hostel Owner and Super Admin dashboards.
Does the software have a public hostel listing website?
Yes. The current solution includes a public website with hostel search, destination discovery, featured properties, property details and booking-oriented navigation.
Can students pay rent through the portal?
The Student dashboard includes monthly rent visibility and a Pay Rent action. Payment gateway implementation can be configured according to the selected provider and project scope.
Can students manage meal plans and facilities?
Yes. The Student portal shows meal-plan information and subscribed facilities such as Wi-Fi, parking, laundry and personal locker services.
Can property owners manage rooms and residents?
Yes. The owner menu includes Register Hostel, Manage Rooms, Residents, Bookings, Rent Tracker and additional operational modules.
Does it support maintenance and resident requests?
Yes. Maintenance and request-related areas are available for resident self-service and owner-side management.
Can owners track occupancy and bookings?
Yes. The owner dashboard includes occupancy overview, active residents and recent booking request visibility.
Does the platform support Super Admin control?
Yes. The Super Admin dashboard includes hostel management, user management, pending approvals, reports, settings and platform-level KPIs.
Can the software be customized?
Yes. Roles, room structures, rent rules, meal plans, facilities, booking workflows, reports, branding and other agreed areas can be customized to project requirements.
Is the data secure?

The current system uses authenticated login and role-based access. Additional hosting, backup, audit, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Can third-party systems be integrated?
Suitable payment gateways, maps, messaging, accounting, identity verification and other services can be integrated where required and supported by the selected providers.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where it is included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. Kiaan Technology maintains transparent communication and provides regular progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
12. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a hostel management platform around your property portfolio, room structure, resident services, booking process, rent collection, meal plans, maintenance and administration requirements.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal designed around your hostel operations and growth goals.
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements.

62.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Management Software
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
ASAP DELIVERY SERVICESMANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Role-Based Delivery Operations, Dispatch, Fleet & Shipment Management

A centralized delivery management platform designed to help delivery businesses manage shipments, orders, dispatch operations, routes, drivers, fleet, zones, tracking, proof of delivery and client billing from one connected system.
Dedicated role-based dashboards give each team member access to the tools relevant to their responsibilities, while management gains clearer visibility across delivery operations.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage
Shipment & Order Management — Manage delivery orders and shipment activity through dedicated order workflows.
Dispatch Operations — Coordinate delivery work through the order queue, route planning, exceptions and driver management.
Route Planning — Organize delivery routes and provide drivers with a focused route and stop workflow.
Driver & Fleet Management — Manage drivers and fleet resources from the tenant administration portal.
Zone Management — Maintain delivery zones for better operational organization.
Live Tracking — Provide shipment tracking for clients and live map visibility for drivers.
Proof of Delivery — Maintain POD records so clients can access delivery documentation.
Billing & Earnings — Provide clients with billing access and drivers with an earnings view.
Multi-Tenant Operations — Support platform-level tenant administration through a dedicated Super Admin portal.
Role-Based Access — Super Admin, Tenant, Dispatcher, Driver and Client users work from dedicated dashboards and menus.
Centralized Operations — Bring administration, dispatch, delivery execution and client services into one connected platform.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides five dedicated delivery experiences, helping each user focus on the information and actions needed for their role.
Super Admin — Platform-Wide Oversight
Designed for centralized administration of the delivery platform and its tenant organizations.
Dashboard — Access the main platform administration overview.
Tenants — Manage and oversee tenant organizations using the platform.
Plans — Manage platform plans.
Users — Manage platform users.
Settings — Maintain platform-level settings.
Logout — Exit the Super Admin portal.
Tenant — Delivery Business Administration
Built for the delivery business or tenant team to manage day-to-day delivery resources.
Dashboard — Access the tenant administration overview.
Orders — Manage delivery orders and shipment activity.
Drivers — Manage drivers associated with the tenant.
Fleet — Manage fleet resources.
Zones — Manage delivery zones.
Logout — Exit the Tenant portal.
Dispatcher — Live Delivery Operations
Focused on coordinating active delivery work and keeping dispatch operations organized.
Live Operations — Work from a live operational view.
Order Queue — Review and coordinate delivery orders awaiting dispatch action.
Route Planner — Plan and organize delivery routes.
Exceptions — Review delivery exceptions that require attention.
Drivers — Access driver information needed for dispatch coordination.
Logout — Exit the Dispatcher portal.
Driver — Delivery Execution
Provides drivers with a focused workspace for routes, stops, maps and earnings.
Routes — Access the driver's delivery route workflow.
Stop List — View delivery stops assigned to the driver.
Live Map — View delivery activity and route location on a live map.
Earnings — Access the driver's earnings area.
Settings — Manage driver settings and profile information.
Logout — Exit the Driver portal.
Client — Shipment & Customer Self-Service
Designed for clients to create shipments, track deliveries and access delivery records.
My Orders — View the client's shipment and order activity.
New Shipment — Create a new shipment request.
Tracking — Track shipment status.
Order History — Review previous orders.
POD Records — Access proof-of-delivery records.
Billing — Access client billing information.
Logout — Exit the Client portal.
3. Technology Stack

React.js — Modern responsive interface.Vite — Fast application development and build tooling.Node.js + Express — Backend and API services.MySQL — Database management.Prisma ORM — Database interaction layer.Alternative technology stacks can also be discussed based on project requirements.
4. How It Helps Your Delivery Business
Easier Day-to-Day Management — Centralized workflows make it simpler to manage orders, dispatch, routes, drivers, fleet and client activity.
Better Delivery Visibility — Live operations, route planning and tracking help teams understand delivery activity more clearly.
Faster Shipment Tracking — Clients can use Tracking, My Orders and Order History to access shipment information.
Improved Dispatch Coordination — Order Queue, Route Planner, Exceptions and Drivers support organized dispatch workflows.
Organized Fleet Operations — Tenant teams can manage Drivers, Fleet and Zones from one administration area.
Better Driver Workflow — Drivers receive dedicated access to Routes, Stop List, Live Map and Earnings.
Proof-of-Delivery Access — Dedicated POD Records make delivery documentation easier for clients to access.
Controlled Access to Information — Role-based portals help users work with the modules relevant to their responsibilities.
Reduced Administrative Complexity — One connected platform reduces the need to coordinate delivery operations across separate tools.
5. Platform Workflow

The software is structured around a connected delivery workflow. Super Admin manages the platform and tenants. Tenant users manage orders, drivers, fleet and zones. 65.title: Student Recruitment Management Software
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
STUDENT VISA MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Student Recruitment, Inquiry, Applications, Visa Processing & Counselor Management in One Platform

A complete digital solution for education consultants, student-recruitment teams and visa-processing businesses to manage inquiries, students, applications, follow-ups, payments and visa workflows from one centralized system.
1. Overview

Student Visa Management Software is a centralized platform designed to organize the complete student recruitment and visa-processing journey from the first inquiry through application and visa follow-up. It helps education consultants and recruitment teams keep student information, counselor activity, application progress, communication, payments and operational tasks in one structured workspace.

The platform supports a detailed inquiry profile, dashboard analytics, lead and student management, application workflows, task management, role-based access, payments and invoices, and a dedicated visa-processing list. It can also be customized around the organization's countries, branches, counselors, intakes, services and internal processes.
2. Core Student Recruitment & Visa Management Features
• Dashboard & Analytics - Monitor total leads, total students, counselors, universities, tasks and inquiries from one management dashboard.
• Lead & Inquiry Management - Capture inquiries, convert qualified prospects into leads, assign responsibility and track progress through the recruitment funnel.
• Student Management - Maintain structured student profiles, academic history, program interests, contact details and ongoing recruitment status.
• Applications - Organize student applications and track their progress through institution and internal processing stages.
• Visa Processing List - Maintain a dedicated operational view for students moving through visa-related processing and follow-up stages.
• Task Management - Create and track follow-up tasks so counselors and operations staff can manage pending actions and deadlines.
• Roles & Permissions - Control access according to user responsibility so counselors, managers, finance users and administrators see the appropriate information.
• Payments & Invoices - Maintain payment and invoice workflows related to student services, application processing or consulting fees according to the configured business process.
• University & Program Tracking - Organize the countries, universities, programs, study levels, fields and intakes used during counseling and application processing.
• Search & Filters - Filter operational data by date, country, counselor, status, intake and lead source for faster review and reporting.
3. Detailed Inquiry & Student Profile Management
The inquiry form can collect detailed student information at the beginning of the recruitment process so counselors do not need to maintain disconnected spreadsheets, forms or chat notes.
• Inquiry Classification - Record inquiry type, source, branch and priority for structured lead handling.
• Personal Information - Capture full name, phone number, email address, interested country, city, date of birth and gender.
• Academic Background - Maintain highest education level, board or university name and medium of instruction.
• Course & Program Information - Record the interested course or program, preferred study level, study field, intake and estimated first-year budget.
• English Proficiency - Maintain the selected English-language test type and related information according to project requirements.
• Work History - Record company name, job title, duration and study-gap information where relevant to the student profile.
• Visa History - Capture whether a previous visa was refused and record the reason where applicable.
• Address Information - Maintain permanent and present address details in the same student record.
• Inquiry Notes & Consent - Record inquiry date, additional counselor notes and confirmation/consent information.
4. Application & Visa Processing Workflow
• Inquiry to Lead - Create a structured inquiry, assign a counselor and move suitable prospects into the active lead pipeline.
• Lead to Student - Convert qualified leads into student records while retaining their recruitment history and key information.
• Counseling & Program Selection - Track preferred countries, universities, courses, study levels, intakes and budget requirements.
• Application Management - Organize application activity and maintain visibility of current application status and pending actions.
• Document Follow-Up - Use tasks, notes and configurable document workflows to keep required student or application documents organized.
• Visa Processing - Move students into a dedicated visa-processing workflow and track the operational status until completion.
• Payment & Invoice Follow-Up - Record applicable fees, invoice activity and payment status within the same business system.
• History & Traceability - Keep activity, task and status information centralized so management can review progress without relying on separate records.
5. Dashboard, Analytics & Reporting
• Conversion Funnel - View the movement from inquiries to leads, students and applicants for clearer conversion visibility.
• Lead Conversion Growth - Compare current and previous conversion performance to monitor recruitment effectiveness.
• Top Performing Counselors - Review counselor performance using conversion-oriented statistics and management reporting.
• Country Distribution - Analyze student or lead distribution by destination country.
• Inquiry Heatmap / Timeline - Review inquiry volume across days or selected time periods to understand lead activity patterns.
• Advanced Filters - Filter dashboard information by date range, country, counselor, status, intake and lead source.
• Custom Reports - Additional management, counselor, application, payment and visa reports can be developed according to client requirements.
6. Role-Based Access & Team Productivity
• Platform / System Admin - Manage global configuration, users, permissions, modules and platform-level settings.
• Counselor Access - Allow counselors to work with assigned inquiries, leads, students, follow-ups and applications according to permissions.
• Manager Access - Provide management visibility across teams, counselor performance, applications, tasks and operational reports.
• Finance Access - Restrict payment and invoice information to authorized users where the business requires financial separation.
• Custom Roles - Additional roles and permission levels can be configured based on branches, departments and actual staff responsibilities.
7. AI & Third-Party API Integration
The platform can be extended with suitable AI features and external services according to the selected project scope and provider availability.
• AI Lead Assistance - AI can be integrated for inquiry classification, lead scoring, counselor suggestions or follow-up prioritization where required.
• AI Chat or Assistant - An AI-assisted help or counseling interface can be added for common student questions, internal staff support or knowledge-based responses.
• Document Assistance - AI can be used for document summarization, checklist assistance or data-extraction workflows where technically suitable and approved.
• Communication APIs - Email, SMS, WhatsApp or other communication services can be integrated for notifications and follow-up workflows.
• Payment Gateways - Suitable payment providers can be integrated for online fee or invoice payments based on the selected country and provider.
• Other Third-Party Systems - CRM, accounting, identity, document, calendar or other supported APIs can be connected where required by the project architecture.
8. Technical Stack, Mobile Apps & Development Options
Our primary full-stack development approach for this type of platform uses modern web technologies that support scalable frontend, backend and database development.
• Frontend - React.js for responsive, component-based web application interfaces.
• Backend - Node.js with Express.js for API development and business logic.
• ORM - Prisma ORM for structured database access and maintainable data models.
• Database - MySQL for relational data storage and operational reporting.
• Full-Stack Development - Frontend, backend, database, authentication, role-based permissions, integrations and deployment can be handled as one coordinated development scope.
• Android & iOS Applications - Mobile applications can be developed as an add-on for Android and iOS according to the required user journeys and project scope.
• Alternative Technologies - When client requirements call for a different technology, development can also be planned using React Native, Java, Python or other suitable technologies.
9. Security & Secure Data Handling

The system is designed to keep business and student information organized behind authenticated access and role-based permissions. Sensitive operational information can be restricted according to user responsibilities, helping prevent unnecessary access across teams.
• Authenticated Access - Login-based access can be used to control entry into the platform.
• Role-Based Permissions - Users can be limited to the modules and actions required for their role.
• Secure Data Architecture - Database access, API permissions and deployment architecture can be configured to support secure handling of student and business records.

• Additional Security Controls - Hosting, backups, audit logs, encryption, monitoring and deployment-level controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture and hosting environment.
10. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be adapted around your actual student recruitment, counseling, admissions and visa-processing workflow instead of forcing your organization into one fixed operating model.
• Branding - Software name, logo, interface text and visual identity can be customized for your business.
• Inquiry Fields - Inquiry forms, student fields, source lists, priorities, branches and required information can be modified.
• Countries, Universities & Programs - Destination countries, institutions, courses, study levels and intakes can be configured according to your market.
• Lead & Student Workflows - Statuses, stages, conversion rules, assignments and follow-up processes can be customized.
• Application & Visa Stages - Application stages, document checkpoints, visa-processing statuses and internal approvals can be adapted to your process.
• Roles & Permissions - Counselor, branch manager, finance, application, visa and admin roles can be configured according to your team structure.
• Payments & Invoices - Fee types, invoice formats, payment workflows and financial permissions can be tailored.
• Reports & Dashboards - KPIs, filters, reports and management views can be changed according to the information your business needs.
• Mobile & Integrations - Android/iOS applications, AI functions and suitable third-party APIs can be added where required.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
11. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual student-recruitment and visa-processing workflow rather than forcing every consultancy into the same fixed process.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates showing what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Full-Stack Capability - Frontend, backend, database, APIs, authentication, permissions and deployment can be handled within one coordinated development process.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The platform can evolve with new branches, countries, counselors, roles, application stages, reports, AI functions and integrations as the business grows.
• Organized & Controlled Access - Role-based permissions help keep student, application and financial information available to the appropriate team members.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
12. Technical Support & Future Enhancements

Kiaan Technology can provide technical assistance according to the selected package, including deployment support, troubleshooting, maintenance, bug fixes, version updates and future feature development. As business requirements change, new modules, reports, workflows, AI features, mobile applications and integrations can be planned as additional development scope.
13. FAQ
Can this software manage the complete student inquiry-to-visa workflow?
Yes. The platform can manage inquiries, leads, student profiles, applications, tasks, payments and a dedicated visa-processing workflow in one centralized system.
Can the software be customized?

Yes. Branding, fields, countries, universities, courses, statuses, application stages, visa workflows, roles, reports, payments, mobile apps and integrations can be customized according to project requirements.
Is the data secure?

The current system uses authenticated login and role-based access. Additional hosting, backup, audit, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Can third-party systems be integrated?
Suitable payment gateways, messaging, email, CRM, accounting, document, identity and other services can be integrated where required and supported by the selected providers.
Can Android and iOS applications be developed?
Yes. Android and iOS applications can be developed as part of the project scope, including cross-platform development where appropriate.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where it is included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. Kiaan Technology maintains transparent communication and provides regular progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
14. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a Student Visa Management Platform around your counselors, students, destination countries, applications, visa-processing workflow and reporting requirements.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your education consultancy or student-recruitment business.

Financial Reporting - Review revenue, pending payments, reservation totals and other financial information through management reports.

Leased Fleet - View the boat, catamaran, jet ski or other service asset assigned to the reservation.

Policies - Maintain policy information and make policy records available to authorized roles.
Insurance Products - Maintain insurance product information for staff and management use.
Net Worth Information - Record and review net-worth or financial-profile information where required by the approved advisory or insurance workflow.
Case Management - Open and manage client cases so ongoing service, review or insurance-related activity stays organized.
Approvals - Support approval workflows for management and administrative review where required.

Settings - Maintain available platform configuration and administrative preferences.

Settings - Manage available system-level configuration.

Policies & Products - Access policy and product information for management use.
Net Worth - Review available client financial-profile information where required.

Documents & Reports - Access relevant records, documents and management reporting.
Team Overview - Review team-related information without full system administration access.

Dashboard - Access the staff operational overview.
Accounts & Contacts - Maintain client and contact information.
Policies - Review and work with policy records within assigned access.
Products - Access available insurance product information.
Net Worth - Access financial-profile information where required and permitted.
Case Open - Create or manage client cases according to the configured workflow.
Documents - Access and maintain relevant documents for assigned work.

A restricted workspace focused on the information required for insurance review and underwriting-related activity.
Dashboard - Access the underwriter overview and assigned operational information.
Accounts & Contacts - Review client and contact information required for risk assessment.
Policies - Review policy records within underwriting access.
Case Open - Access active cases relevant to underwriting review.
Documents - Review supporting documents required for the underwriting process.
Controlled Access - Keep unrelated administrative, user-management and broader management features outside the underwriter workspace.

Centralize Client Information - Bring accounts, contacts, policies, products, cases and documents into one organized CRM environment.

Vite - Fast frontend development and optimized application build tooling.

TOY RENTAL & SWAP MARKETPLACE SOFTWARE
Multi-Role Toy Rental, Subscription, Swap & Marketplace Management

A centralized toy rental and marketplace platform designed to help businesses manage toy listings, owners, renters, rentals, swaps, subscriptions, payments, moderation, analytics and day-to-day marketplace operations from one connected system. Dedicated Owner, User and Admin experiences keep each role focused while management retains platform-wide visibility and control.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage

Toy Marketplace — Present toys in organized categories so customers can discover rental options across educational toys, STEM learning toys, action figures, remote-control cars, ride-on toys, outdoor play, musical toys, board games and puzzles.
Toy Rental Operations — Support a complete browse, select, rent and return journey with rental visibility for customers and owners.
Swap Requests — Manage toy-swap requests as an additional marketplace workflow alongside rentals.
Owner Listings — Allow toy owners to maintain their toy inventory and monitor marketplace availability, estimated rental value and rental activity.
Customer Accounts — Give renters access to their rentals, cart, order tracking, subscriptions and wishlist from one account area.
Subscriptions & Repeat Rentals — Support recurring customer engagement through subscription and repeat-rental experiences.
Payments & Platform Revenue — Track rental payments and platform-level financial activity from the administrative workspace.
Moderation & Listing Control — Review toy listings and marketplace activity before or during publication based on the configured approval workflow.
Reports & Platform Analytics — Provide operational and marketplace reporting for inventory, rentals, payments and overall platform performance.
Role-Based Access — Owner, User and Admin accounts work from dedicated interfaces with access aligned to their responsibilities.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides three dedicated user experiences so toy owners, renters and administrators can work from focused dashboards without unnecessary access to other areas of the system.
Owner — Toy Portfolio & Rental Performance
Designed for individuals or businesses that list toys and monitor their rental performance on the marketplace.
Owner Dashboard & KPIs — View total revenue, active rentals and the number of toys in the owner portfolio.
My Toys — Maintain toy listings and monitor their current marketplace availability.
Marketplace Status — Review listed toys, availability and estimated rental value from one operational view.
Activity Pulse — Follow rental, return and approval-related marketplace activity.

222.title: Medical Practice Management Software
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
MEDICAL PRACTICE & MULTI-MODALITY BILLING SOFTWARE
Role-Based Clinical Operations, Patient Scheduling & Multi-Provider Billing

A centralized medical practice management platform designed to bring patient administration, accident cases, appointments, clinical documentation, treatment sessions, AI-assisted note workflows, provider billing, claims, payments, documents and operational reporting into one connected system. Dedicated role-based workspaces help clinical, front-desk and billing teams focus on the tools relevant to their responsibilities while management maintains broader oversight.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage
Patient & Case Management — Maintain patient records, accident cases and related clinical activity in a structured practice workflow.
Appointments & Self-Booking — Manage staff scheduling, appointment activity, patient check-in and a public patient self-booking workflow.

Multi-Modality Clinical Operations — Support multiple provider and treatment workflows including Pain Management, ESWT Shockwave Therapy, Laser Therapy, Counseling & Mental Health, Trigger Point Injection and TECAR Therapy.
Clinical Records & Assessments — Maintain clinical records, assessments, forms, treatment-session information and provider review activity.
AI-Assisted Clinical Notes — Support AI-assisted drafting workflows for clinical notes while keeping review, approval and signing actions with authorized clinical users.
Billing & Claims — Manage billing overview, provider-specific bills, CMS-1500 claim previews, payments, adjustments and account-aging activity.
Documents & Patient Packets — Organize practice documents and patient packet workflows from one centralized area.
Staff, Providers & Services — Manage staff roles, provider profiles, services, codes, settings, reports and operational audit activity.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides dedicated experiences for administrative, clinical, front-desk and billing users, helping each role work with the information and actions relevant to its responsibilities.
Super Admin — Complete Practice Oversight
Designed for system-wide management, provider configuration, financial visibility and operational control.
Master Dashboard — Monitor outstanding balances, active patients and cases, scheduled appointments, reminder issues and provider-service status.
Practice Administration — Manage patients, accident cases, appointments, patient self-booking, staff and roles, provider profiles, services and codes.
Clinical Oversight — Access clinical records, AI note workflows, assessments, forms and treatment-session information.
Financial Control — Review billing, provider bills, CMS-1500 claims, payments, adjustments and account aging.
Governance & Reporting — Access documents, patient packets, reports, audit logs and system settings.
Receptionist — Front Desk & Scheduling
Focused on patient registration, arrivals, scheduling and day-to-day front-desk coordination.
Patient Registration — Register and access patient records according to front-desk permissions.
Appointment Scheduling — Schedule visits and review the daily appointment queue.
Patient Check-In — Track arrival status and process check-ins from a dedicated action queue.
Reminder Visibility — Monitor SMS/email reminder delivery status for scheduled appointments.
Documents — Access relevant practice documents based on assigned permissions.
Doctor — Clinical Review & AI-Assisted Documentation
A clinical workspace for reviewing charts, reports and AI-assisted note drafts before authorized approval and signing.
Clinical Review Queue — Review patient charts and provider documents requiring clinical action.
Signed & Locked Reports — Maintain visibility into completed clinical documentation and approved reports.
AI Note Assistant — Use configurable AI-assisted note drafting for supported clinical documentation workflows.
Patients & Cases — Access patient, accident-case and appointment information relevant to clinical care.
Assessments & Treatment Sessions — Work with assessments, forms and treatment-session records.
Therapist — Treatment Session Execution
Built for treatment-session logging and parameter capture across assigned therapy services.
ESWT Session Logging — Record shockwave treatment-session activity and procedure parameters.
Laser Therapy Sessions — Capture treatment settings, duration, energy and related session outcomes.
Vitals & Compliance Checks — Record required visit-level checks where configured in the clinical workflow.
Clinical Records — Access patients, cases, forms, treatment sessions and documents according to therapist permissions.
Counselor — Mental Health & Session Documentation
A focused workspace for counseling intake, session-note documentation and treatment-progress tracking.
Counseling Appointments — Monitor scheduled counseling visits and assigned patient activity.
Session Notes — Create and manage counseling session-note drafts within the configured clinical workflow.
Clinical Records — Access patient and case information required for counseling services.
Billing Visibility — Review permitted provider-bill information where the role is configured for view-only access.
Billing Staff — Multi-Provider Billing & Claims
Designed for financial operations across multiple provider services and patient cases.
Accounts Receivable — Monitor practice balances and overdue account-aging information.
Provider Bills — Maintain multiple provider bill statements within the patient case structure.
CMS-1500 Claims — Generate and review CMS-1500 claim previews as part of the configured billing workflow.
Payments & Adjustments — Record and review payment and adjustment activity.
Billing Reports — Access billing-related reports, documents and patient packets as permitted.
Patient Self-Booking Portal — Convenient Appointment Requests
A public-facing booking experience can allow patients to request or schedule appointments without requiring access to staff administration screens.
Self-Service Booking — Provide an easier path for patients to select available appointment options where enabled.
Reduced Front-Desk Workload — Shift suitable appointment requests to a controlled self-service workflow.
Configurable Availability — Booking rules, providers, services and availability can be tailored around practice requirements.
3. How It Helps Your Medical Practice
