Improve Role Clarity — Dedicated workspaces help reception, clinical staff, billing teams and administrators focus on the functions relevant to their responsibilities.
Strengthen Appointment Coordination — Scheduling, patient self-booking, check-in queues and reminder visibility help keep appointment activity organized.
Standardize Clinical Documentation — Structured forms, treatment-session records and review workflows support more consistent documentation across providers and modalities.
Support Faster Documentation Workflows — AI-assisted note drafting can reduce repetitive preparation while keeping review and approval with authorized clinical users.
Improve Billing Visibility — Provider bills, claims, payments, adjustments and aging information give financial teams a clearer view of outstanding activity.
Keep Practice Records Organized — Centralized documents, patient packets, service codes and provider configurations reduce fragmented record handling.
Support Practice Growth — A configurable role-based structure can expand with additional users, providers, services, reports and integrations as requirements evolve.
4. Technology Stack
Responsive Web Application — The demonstrated platform is delivered through a modern browser-based interface for administrative, clinical and billing workflows.
Role-Based Application Layer — Separate authenticated workspaces control access for Super Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Therapist, Counselor and Billing Staff roles.
Centralized Data Layer — Patient, appointment, clinical, billing, document and audit information is managed through a connected application data structure.
AI Integration Layer — The platform includes an AI-assisted clinical note workflow that can be configured around approved documentation use cases.
Integration-Ready Architecture — Messaging, reminder, billing and other third-party services can be integrated where required and supported by selected providers.

Service Modalities — Existing treatment modalities can be adjusted and additional provider services can be configured or developed based on project scope.

Clinical Forms & Templates — Assessments, procedure forms, note templates, patient packets and documentation workflows can be modified around agreed practice requirements.

Reports & Dashboards — KPIs, operational reports, financial reports and dashboard views can be adjusted around management needs.
Integrations — Suitable payment, messaging, email, SMS, identity, accounting, clinical or other third-party services can be integrated based on requirements and provider availability.
AI Automation — AI-assisted workflows can be configured for approved use cases, with human review steps retained where required.

7. FAQ
Can the software manage multiple providers and treatment modalities?

Yes. The demonstrated platform supports multiple provider profiles and configurable service modalities, including Pain Management, ESWT, Laser Therapy, Counseling, Trigger Point Injection and TECAR Therapy. Additional services can be adapted based on project requirements.
Does the platform support patient self-booking and appointment management?
Yes. The platform includes appointment scheduling, front-desk check-in workflows and a patient self-booking portal that can be configured around provider availability and practice rules.
Does it support clinical documentation and AI-assisted notes?

Yes. The platform includes clinical records, assessments, forms, treatment-session documentation and an AI-assisted note workflow. Clinical review, approval and signing can remain with authorized staff according to the configured process.
Is the data secure?

The current system uses authenticated login, role-based access, controlled data visibility and secure password handling. The demonstrated platform also includes audit-log functionality and presents HIPAA-aligned privacy and security controls. Additional hosting, backup, audit, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Can third-party systems be integrated?
Suitable payment gateways, messaging, email/SMS reminders, accounting, identity, clinical and other services can be integrated where required and supported by the selected providers.

Yes. The software can be delivered for desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile-friendly screens. Android and iOS app versions can also be provided based on the selected package and project scope.

Yes. Kiaan Technology maintains transparent communication and provides regular progress updates during development and customization work.

Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
PROPERTY MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Centralized Portfolio, Finance, Operations & Owner Management
Manage properties, owners, reservations, expenses, invoices, payments, accounting, maintenance operations and reporting from one role-based platform.
1. Overview

Property Management Software is a centralized, role-based platform designed to help property management businesses control portfolio operations, finances, expenses, owner relationships and day-to-day service activity from one connected system.

It combines property performance, reservations, transactions, accounting, billing, operational tasks, reporting and owner-facing financial visibility to make property management easier to monitor, organize and scale.
2. What the Software Helps You Manage
• Property Portfolio - Maintain property records and monitor active properties across the managed portfolio.
• Property Owners - Manage owner information and property-owner relationships from a centralized area.
• Reservations - Track reservation activity as part of day-to-day property operations.
• Transactions - Maintain property-related financial transactions in one system.
• Billable Expenses - Record and manage expenses that can be assigned or billed as part of property operations.
• Invoices - Create and manage invoice workflows for property-related charges and owner billing.
• Payments - Track payment activity and owner-related payment information.
• Accounting - Support financial recordkeeping and reconciliation workflows within the property platform.
• Reports - Generate and review reports for property, finance and operational performance.
• Automation Rules - Configure operational automation rules to reduce repetitive manual work.
• Integrations - Manage supported external integrations from the system configuration area.
• Users & Permissions - Control user access and permissions according to staff responsibility.
• Settings - Maintain system-level and operational settings in one place.
• Owner Portal - Provide property owners with a dedicated financial and property-performance workspace.
3. Role-Based Portals

The software provides separate workspaces for Super Admin, Finance Manager, Operations Staff and Property Owner users. This helps each team member work with the tools relevant to their responsibilities while keeping sensitive information restricted where appropriate.
Super Admin - Complete Portfolio & System Control
• Admin Dashboard - Monitor total properties, total owners, monthly revenue and occupancy rate from the main portfolio overview.
• Revenue by Property - Compare revenue contribution across individual managed properties.
• Expense Analysis - Review expenses by category such as utilities, maintenance, cleaning, supplies and marketing.
• Profit & Occupancy Trends - Track monthly profit and occupancy trends to support management decisions.
• Vendor Spending - Review top expense vendors and major outgoing costs.
• Recent Transactions - Monitor recent property-related income and expense activity.
• Pending Expenses - Identify expenses that still require assignment or follow-up.
• Owner Payments - Review recent owner payment activity and matching status.
• Full Module Access - Access properties, owners, reservations, transactions, billable expenses, invoices, payments, accounting, reports, automation rules, integrations, users and settings.
• Report Generation - Generate management reports for the selected reporting period.
Finance Manager - Financial Health & Reconciliation
• Finance Dashboard - View total revenue, unreconciled activity, outstanding invoices and pending payouts.
• Transactions - Manage financial transaction records and reconciliation-related activity.
• Invoices - Review and manage outstanding and completed invoice workflows.
• Payments - Track payments across managed properties and owners.
• Accounting - Work with financial records and accounting-related processes.
• Reports - Generate and review financial reporting for the selected period.
• Property Revenue Analysis - Compare monthly revenue performance across properties.
• Expense Categories - Monitor major expense categories and spending distribution.
• Profit & Occupancy Trends - Review financial and occupancy trends that influence portfolio performance.
• Owner Payout Visibility - Track pending payouts and owner payment status.
Operations Staff - Maintenance, Cleaning & Guest Operations
• Operations Dashboard - View active properties, properties in maintenance, cleaning tasks and upcoming guest check-ins.
• Properties - Access property information required for day-to-day operations.
• Reservations - Review reservation information relevant to guest and property operations.
• Billable Expenses - Capture operational expenses that may need to be assigned or billed.
• Automation Rules - Use configured rules to support repeatable operational workflows.
• Maintenance Visibility - Identify properties requiring maintenance attention and prioritize active work.
• Cleaning Tasks - Monitor assigned cleaning work and property-readiness activity.
• Guest Check-Ins - Track upcoming guest check-ins to support smooth property turnover and arrival preparation.
• Operational Reporting - Generate reports for the selected operating period.
Property Owner - Dedicated Financial & Portfolio View
• Owner Portal - Provide owners with a focused view of their own managed properties and financial performance.
• Property Revenue - Review revenue generated from the owner's properties.
• Expenses - See expenses associated with the owner's portfolio.
• Net Profit - Track profit after fees and expenses for the selected period.
• Open Invoices - Monitor invoices requiring attention.
• Payments Made - Review payments made during the reporting period.
• Monthly Profit Trend - See month-by-month profit performance through a visual trend.
• Expense Breakdown - Understand how costs are distributed across major expense categories.
• Properties - Access property information connected to the owner account.
• Invoices, Payments & Transactions - Review owner-specific financial records from one place.
4. Business Intelligence & Financial Visibility
• Portfolio-Level Performance - Compare property revenue, occupancy and profitability across the portfolio instead of reviewing properties separately.
• Expense Control - See where money is being spent and identify the largest vendors or expense categories.
• Owner Payment Tracking - Keep owner payouts and payment matching visible for better financial control.
• Reconciliation Support - Highlight unreconciled activity and outstanding items that need finance-team attention.
• Property-Level Profitability - Combine revenue and expense information to understand which properties are contributing most effectively to the business.
• Period-Based Reporting - Review current-month or selected-period performance and generate reports for management review.
5. How It Can Help Your Property Management Business Grow
• Manage More Properties More Easily - A centralized system reduces the need to manage properties, finances and operations across separate spreadsheets or disconnected tools.
• Improve Financial Control - Revenue, expenses, invoices, payments and accounting data are organized in one place, making financial follow-up easier for management and finance teams.
• Give Owners Better Visibility - A dedicated Owner Portal helps property owners see revenue, expenses, profit, invoices and payments without relying on repeated manual updates from staff.
• Reduce Administrative Work - Role-based workspaces and automation rules can reduce repetitive coordination and keep teams focused on the tasks that require attention.
• Improve Operational Coordination - Maintenance, cleaning, reservations and guest check-ins are visible to operations staff, helping teams prepare properties more consistently.
• Make Better Decisions with Reports - Portfolio trends, property revenue, occupancy, expenses and profit views give management clearer information for planning and growth decisions.
• Keep Business Data Organized - Centralized records help reduce scattered property, owner and financial information while giving authorized users access to the data they need.
• Strengthen Owner Relationships - Consistent financial visibility and organized reporting can make owner communication clearer and more professional.
• Support Portfolio Expansion - A structured property, finance and role-management system can scale as the business adds more owners, properties and team members.
6. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements

The software can be adapted around your portfolio structure, accounting workflow, owner reporting model, operational process and staff responsibilities. You are not limited to a fixed set of fields or workflows.
• Branding - Logo, software name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
• Property & Owner Fields - Property details, owner information and portfolio fields can be modified or extended.
• Roles & Permissions - Super Admin, Finance Manager, Operations Staff and Property Owner permissions can be adjusted, and additional roles can be developed where required.
• Finance Workflow - Invoices, payments, payouts, transaction categories and reconciliation processes can be tailored to your business model.
• Expense Workflow - Expense categories, approval stages and billable-expense handling can be customized.
• Owner Reporting - Owner dashboards, reports, payment visibility and financial summaries can be adapted to your reporting requirements.
• Automation Rules - Automated workflows and rules can be configured around operational triggers and business processes.
• Reports & Analytics - Dashboard metrics, exports and management reports can be adjusted according to your needs.
• Integrations - Suitable accounting, payment, booking, communication or other third-party APIs can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
7. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual property-management workflow instead of forcing every business into the same fixed template.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what is complete, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Role-Based Product Structure - Dedicated Admin, Finance, Operations and Owner workspaces help each user focus on relevant responsibilities.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The platform can evolve with new properties, owners, staff roles, reports, automation and integrations as your business expands.
• Organized & Controlled Access - Centralized records and permission-based access help keep property and financial information organized while limiting unnecessary visibility.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
8. FAQ
Can this software manage multiple properties and owners?
Yes. The platform includes dedicated Properties and Owners modules and a portfolio dashboard for centralized management.
Can finance staff manage invoices, payments and accounting separately?
Yes. The Finance Manager workspace is focused on transactions, invoices, payments, accounting, reports and reconciliation visibility.
Can operational staff manage maintenance and cleaning work?
Yes. The Operations workspace includes maintenance, cleaning-task and guest check-in visibility together with access to relevant property and reservation information.
Can property owners see their own revenue and expenses?
Yes. The Owner Portal provides owner-specific visibility into property revenue, expenses, net profit, invoices, payments and transactions.
Can the system track occupancy and property performance?
Yes. Management dashboards include occupancy metrics, property revenue, monthly profit trends and portfolio performance views.
Can we generate reports?
Yes. Report generation is available from management and role-based dashboards where shown, and reporting can be customized further according to project requirements.
Can the software be customized?
Yes. Branding, roles, fields, finance workflows, owner reporting, automation and integrations can be customized according to your requirements.
Can third-party services be integrated?
Suitable accounting, payment, booking, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. We maintain transparent communication and provide regular project progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
9. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a property management platform around your portfolio, owners, finance team, operations staff and reporting requirements.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your property management business.
BOOK A DEMO  •  GET A QUOTE
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements.

244.title: PROPERTY MANAGEMENT & OWNER FINANCE SOFTWARE
244.subtitle: Specification Document
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
PROPERTY MANAGEMENT & OWNER FINANCE SOFTWARE
Rentals, Owner-Financed Sales, Payments, Maintenance & Property Operations
Manage rental properties, owner-finance contracts, tenants, buyers, payments, mortgages, maintenance, documents and public property listings from one connected real estate platform.
1. Overview
Property Management & Owner Finance Software is a multi-portal real estate operations platform designed for property owners, managers, renters and contract buyers.

It unifies rental management, owner-financed property sales, underlying mortgage tracking, payment schedules, cash-flow visibility, maintenance, documents, communications and public listings so the business can operate from one organized system instead of disconnected spreadsheets, messages and records.
2. What the Software Helps You Manage
• Property Portfolio - Manage rental, owner-finance and mixed property portfolios with property status, occupancy and performance visibility.
• Rental Operations - Track tenants, leases, monthly rent, rent due dates, payment status and rental-property activity.
• Owner-Finance Contracts - Manage contract buyers, financed balances, interest rates, monthly payments, balloon dates, balloon amounts and equity progress.
• Payment Schedules - Maintain structured payment schedules showing due date, payment amount, principal, interest and remaining balance.
• Underlying Mortgage Visibility - Track mortgage balances and costs connected to managed properties for more accurate property-level financial visibility.
• Income, Costs & Net Cash Flow - Review property income, mortgage expense, taxes, insurance, operating expenses and net cash flow from management dashboards.
• Listings & Public Website - Publish and present available rental and owner-finance properties through a branded public property website.
• Customers - Maintain tenant, buyer and other customer information from one management workspace.
• Maintenance - Track maintenance tickets, urgency, vendor status and completed work across properties.
• Documents - Keep leases, property condition reports, contracts and other property documents organized in a dedicated document area.
• Messages - Support communication between management and portal users through centralized messaging workflows.
• Accounting, Finance & Reports - Provide management with financial, accounting and reporting tools for portfolio oversight.
• Title & Closing - Support title and closing-related workflows for owner-financed property transactions.
• Website / CMS - Manage public-facing property content and listings from the management system.
3. Role-Based Portals

The software includes focused portals for Owner / Manager, Tenant Renter, Contract Buyer and the Public Website. Each portal presents the information and actions relevant to that user type while keeping sensitive business functions controlled.
Owner / Manager Portal - Complete Property & Financial Control
• Management Dashboard - Monitor total properties, occupied and available units, properties under contract, monthly income, monthly costs, net cash flow and mortgage balance.
• Property Performance - Compare income, mortgage, taxes, insurance, expenses and net cash flow by property.
• Occupancy Overview - See available, occupied, pending and under-contract property status in one place.
• Properties - Manage property records, type, status and operational information.
• Payment Schedule - Manage rent or owner-finance payment schedules across the portfolio.
• Listings - Control properties available for rent or sale and manage public listing visibility.
• Customers - Manage tenant, buyer and customer information.
• Finance & Accounting - Track financial activity, portfolio costs and property-level performance.
• Title & Closing - Manage title and closing-related information for property-sale workflows.
• Maintenance Queue - Monitor open, urgent, waiting-vendor and completed maintenance work.
• Property Alerts - Surface important events such as mortgage payments, tax escrow, insurance renewals, lease expiry and balloon-payment deadlines.
• Documents & Messages - Keep important files and communications connected to property operations.
• Reports - Review portfolio and operational reporting for management decisions.
• Website / CMS & Settings - Control public property content and configure the system around business needs.
Tenant Renter Portal - Rent, Lease & Maintenance Self-Service
• Tenant Dashboard - View monthly rent, current balance, next rent due date, lease expiry date and payment status.
• My Property - Access information related to the rented property.
• My Lease - Review lease-related information from the tenant portal.
• Pay Rent - Make or access rent-payment workflows from the portal.
• Recent Payments - Review previous rent-payment records and payment status.
• Maintenance - Submit new maintenance requests and track active requests.
• Secure Documents - Access important tenant documents such as lease contracts and property condition reports.
• Messages - Communicate with property management and review recent messages.
• My Profile - Maintain tenant profile information.
Contract Buyer Portal - Owner-Finance Payment & Equity Tracking
• Buyer Dashboard - View monthly amount due, interest rate, current financed balance and next payment date.
• My Property & My Contract - Access the property and owner-finance contract connected to the buyer account.
• Payment Schedule - Review upcoming payments with principal, interest and remaining balance.
• Principal Balance Reduction - Track how the financed balance changes as payments are made.
• Note Breakdown - View principal paid, interest paid and remaining balance information.
• Balloon Tracking - Monitor balloon date and balloon amount for contracts that include balloon financing.
• Total Paid & Equity Built - Provide the buyer with visibility into payment progress and accumulated equity.
• Account Alerts - Surface important payment, balloon, tax, insurance and title-related reminders.
• Payments, Documents, Maintenance & Messages - Give buyers access to payment activity, important files, service requests and management communication.
Public Website - Property Discovery & Lead Generation
• Available Managed Properties - Show rental, owner-finance and mixed property opportunities to prospective customers.
• Property Details - Present property type, availability, location, features and pricing information.
• Rental & Owner-Finance Filters - Help visitors browse properties according to the type of opportunity they are looking for.
• Owner-Finance Information - Present owner-finance opportunities and payment-related information to interested buyers.
• ROI & Amortization Calculator - Provide an interactive calculator for estimated monthly payment, principal, interest, projected equity and yield-style analysis.
• Inquiry Form - Allow prospective customers to contact the management office about a property or service.
• FAQ & Service Information - Explain rental, owner-finance and maintenance processes to prospective customers.
4. Financial & Owner-Finance Intelligence
• Net Cash Flow Visibility - Combine property income with mortgage, tax, insurance and operating expenses to understand property-level net cash flow.
• Amortization Tracking - Track long-term payment schedules with principal and interest allocation over time.
• Balloon Payment Monitoring - Surface approaching balloon-payment obligations so management and buyers can plan ahead.
• Mortgage & Cost Oversight - Keep underlying mortgage balances and recurring property costs visible alongside income.
• Buyer Equity Progress - Show total paid, principal reduction and equity built to make owner-finance accounts easier to understand.
• Portfolio Alerts - Bring important financial and operational deadlines into one alert panel instead of relying on manual reminders.
5. How It Can Help Your Real Estate Business Grow
• Manage More Properties Efficiently - Centralized property, customer, payment, maintenance, document and financial workflows reduce the administrative burden of managing a growing portfolio.
• Support Multiple Revenue Models - Operate traditional rentals and owner-financed property sales within the same platform instead of maintaining separate systems.
• Improve Cash-Flow Visibility - Property-level income, costs and net cash flow help management understand which assets are performing well and which need attention.
• Improve Tenant & Buyer Experience - Self-service portals give renters and buyers direct access to payments, documents, maintenance, messages and account information.
• Reduce Missed Deadlines - Alerts for rent, mortgages, taxes, insurance, leases and balloon payments help teams stay ahead of important obligations.
• Generate More Property Leads - A branded public website and property catalog help turn available inventory into rental or buyer inquiries.
• Keep Documents & Data Organized - Centralized records reduce scattered files and make important property, lease and contract information easier for authorized users to access.
• Improve Communication - Built-in messaging and request workflows create a clearer connection between management, tenants and buyers.
• Support Portfolio Expansion - The system can be extended with additional properties, roles, reports and workflows as the business grows.
6. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be adapted around your property portfolio, rental model, owner-finance structure, accounting process, document requirements and customer journey.
• Branding - Logo, software name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
• Property Types - Rental, owner-finance, mixed and additional property classifications can be configured around your business model.
• Roles & Permissions - Owner / Manager, Tenant and Buyer access can be adjusted, and additional roles can be developed where required.
• Lease & Contract Workflows - Lease fields, buyer contract terms, payment rules and property statuses can be tailored.
• Finance & Accounting - Income, cost, mortgage, tax, insurance and reporting structures can be adjusted to match operational needs.
• Payment & Amortization Rules - Payment schedules, principal / interest calculations, balloon structures and due-date logic can be configured according to project requirements.
• Maintenance Workflow - Request types, priorities, vendor statuses and maintenance stages can be customized.
• Documents & Forms - Lease, contract, inspection and property-document workflows can be modified or extended.
• Public Website - Property catalog, inquiry forms, services, FAQs and branded website content can be customized.
• Integrations - Suitable payment, accounting, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
7. Why Choose Kiaan Technology

• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual rental, owner-finance and property-management workflow instead of forcing every real estate business into the same fixed template.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what is completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Business-Growth Focus - The platform is structured to help reduce manual work, improve portfolio visibility and support expansion into more properties and revenue models.
• Role-Based Product Structure - Separate Owner / Manager, Tenant and Buyer experiences keep each user focused on the information relevant to them.
• Organized & Controlled Access - Centralized records and role-based permissions help keep business information organized while limiting unnecessary visibility.
• Flexible Customization - Modules, workflows, reports, payment structures and public website features can be adapted as your requirements evolve.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
8. Frequently Asked Questions
Can this software manage both rental and owner-financed properties?
Yes. The platform supports rental, owner-finance and mixed property operations within the same management system.
Can tenants pay rent and submit maintenance requests?
Yes. The Tenant portal includes rent-payment access, payment history, maintenance requests, documents and messages.
Can contract buyers see their payment schedule and remaining balance?
Yes. The Buyer portal includes payment schedules, principal and interest information, remaining balance, balloon details and payment progress.
Does the software track mortgages, taxes and insurance costs?
The management dashboard includes mortgage, tax, insurance and operating-cost visibility as part of property-level financial performance.
Can the system show net cash flow by property?
Yes. Property performance views combine income and major cost categories to show net cash flow at property level.
Can we track balloon payments?
Yes. Owner-finance workflows include balloon-date and balloon-amount tracking with account alerts.
Can properties be listed publicly?
Yes. The platform includes a public property website for rental and owner-finance listings, property information and inquiries.
Can we customize payment schedules and contract terms?
Yes. Payment schedules, contract fields, finance structures and related workflows can be customized according to project requirements.
Can third-party services be integrated?
Suitable payment, accounting, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. We maintain transparent communication and provide regular project progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
9. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a property management platform around your rental portfolio, owner-finance contracts, tenants, buyers, payments and operating processes.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your real estate business.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
EMPLOYEE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Track Time, Attendance, Productivity & Workforce Activity from One Platform

A centralized workforce management platform for employee monitoring, time tracking, attendance, productivity insights, screenshots, locations, tasks, reports, payroll, alerts, compliance and administration.
1. Overview

Employee Management Software is a centralized workforce operations and productivity platform designed to help organizations monitor employee activity, track working time, manage attendance and gain clearer visibility into day-to-day workforce performance from one connected workspace.

It brings time tracking, attendance, activity monitoring, screenshot monitoring, location tracking, tasks and projects, workforce reporting, payroll, alerts, employee records, compliance and system settings together so administrators can manage workforce information more efficiently and make better-informed operational decisions.
2. Complete Employee Management Operations
• Dashboard - Access a central workforce overview with employee activity, productivity, working hours, performance trends, alerts and live workforce visibility.
• Time Tracking - Track employee working time through a dedicated module for organized time visibility and workforce review.
• Attendance - Maintain attendance-related information and support day-to-day employee attendance monitoring.
• Activity Monitoring - Monitor workforce activity to understand employee engagement and operational activity during working periods.
• Screenshot Monitoring - Use a dedicated screenshot-monitoring area to support visibility into employee work activity where enabled by company policy.
• Location Tracking - Review employee location-related information through a dedicated workforce tracking module where applicable.
• Tasks & Projects - Manage employee work assignments and project-related activity from a centralized section.
• Employees - Maintain employee records within the administrative platform.
• Settings - Manage system configuration and administrative preferences from one controlled area.
3. Workforce Intelligence & Performance Visibility
• Active Employees - View the number of active employees from the management dashboard for quick workforce visibility.
• Online Now - See how many employees are currently online and active within the system.
• Productivity Score - Review a summarized productivity score to support workforce performance monitoring.
• Total Hours - Monitor accumulated working hours for the selected dashboard period.
• Performance Pulse - View high-level productivity performance and benchmark information from the dashboard.
• Performance Metrics - Review intraday performance trends through a time-based management chart with date selection.
• Live Workforce - See employee availability grouped into Online, Idle and Offline states for real-time workforce awareness.
• Employee Activity Status - Review individual employees in the live workforce area and identify who is currently active.
• Operations Health - Use a summarized operations-health indicator to understand overall system or workforce operating status at a glance.
4. Reports & Workforce Analytics
The software includes a structured Reports area that helps management review workforce patterns across multiple operational dimensions.
• Work Type - Analyze employee activity or workforce information according to work-type classifications.
• Schedule Adherence - Review how workforce activity aligns with expected schedules and working periods.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
HRM, PAYROLL & EMPLOYEE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Multi-Company HRM, Payroll, Attendance, Payslips, Reporting & Employee Self-Service in One Platform
A centralized HR and payroll operations platform designed to organize employees, attendance, leave, salary, payroll processing, payslips, reporting, company records, backups and role-based access.
1. Overview

HRM, Payroll & Employee Management Software is a centralized workforce administration platform designed to help organizations manage employee records, payroll operations, attendance, leave, salary processes, payslips, reporting and system administration from one connected environment.

The platform also supports company selection, multiple payroll frequencies, role-based access, employee self-service, audit visibility, data import/export and backup/restore functions, helping businesses reduce scattered records and maintain a more organized payroll and HR workflow.
2. Role-Based Access & Multi-Company Operations
• Secure User Verification - Users sign in with an assigned identity and password before accessing the system.
• Role-Based Portals - The access screen includes Admin, Driver, Manager, Supervisor and Viewer roles, allowing different user groups to enter the appropriate workspace.
• Company Selection - Authorized users can select the company or payroll environment they need to work with before continuing into operations.
• Multiple Payroll Frequencies - The company-selection area shows support for monthly, weekly and fortnightly payroll frequencies.
• Multi-Tenant Employee Portal - The software is structured for company-based employee access so multiple organizations or payroll entities can be managed through a controlled environment.
• System Period & Regional Context - Operational screens display the active system period and regional context, helping users work within the correct payroll period and company environment.
3. HRM & Employee Management
• Employee Management - Maintain employee information and workforce records from a dedicated HRM module.
• Attendance Management - Organize employee attendance information as part of the HR and payroll workflow.
• Leave Management - Manage leave activity and provide employees with a self-service leave-request option.
• Salary Management - Maintain salary-related information used within payroll administration.
• Payroll Management - Centralize payroll-related HR operations and connect employee records with payroll processing.
• User Provisioning - Create and edit system users from the administration console so access can be controlled by authorized personnel.
• Employee Profile Updates - Employee self-service includes profile updates for personal details such as address and banking information.
4. Payroll & Finance Operations
• Payslips - Generate and manage payslips, provide users with My Payslips access and support payslip delivery by email.
• Transaction Entry - Record payroll-related transactions through a dedicated transaction-entry workflow.
• Entered Transaction Register - Review transactions that have been entered before or during payroll processing.
• Time Keeper - Maintain time-related payroll inputs through the Finance workflow.
• Post Transactions - Move processed transaction information into the posted payroll workflow when ready.
• Posted Transaction Register - Review posted payroll transactions in a dedicated register.
• Payroll Calculation - Run payroll calculation activities from the finance module.
• Calculation Register - Review calculated payroll results through the Calculation Register.
• Payroll Update - Apply payroll updates as part of the processing cycle.
• Payroll Register - Maintain a detailed payroll register after processing.
• Payroll Register Summary - Review summarized payroll information for management and reconciliation purposes.
• Pay Disbursement - Manage the payroll disbursement stage after calculations and payroll updates are complete.
• TRN-Protected Payslips - The interface includes a Generate & Email payslip workflow identified as TRN protected.
• Cheque Printing - Support physical payment workflows through cheque-printing options.
• Electronic Payments - Support electronic-payment workflows from the Finance menu.
5. Reports & Statutory Reporting Workflows
• Regulatory Reports Hub - Access a centralized reporting area for regulatory and statutory reporting workflows.
• Statutory Returns - Maintain statutory-return related reporting from the Reports module.
• Employee Report - Review workforce-related information in a dedicated employee report.
• Attendance Report - Analyze attendance information for payroll and HR review.
• Payroll Report - Review payroll processing information and results.
• Salary Report - Review salary-related information in report format.
• Payroll Summary - Use summarized payroll information for management review.
• Transaction Register - Review payroll and finance transactions through the reporting area.
• Turnover Report - Monitor workforce turnover information.
• Year-to-Date Breakdown - Review year-to-date payroll or employee information in a structured breakdown.
• Retention Report - Monitor employee retention information for management visibility.
• Crystal Reporting Interface - The Reports menu includes a Crystal Reporting Interface option for report-oriented workflows.
• Bank Transfer Advice - Generate or manage bank-transfer advice information from the reporting area.
• Email P24 Advice - The reporting interface includes an Email P24 Advice workflow.
6. System Administration, Audit & Data Management
• Company Setup - Maintain master organization details and company-level configuration.
• Customized Modules - The system menu includes customized-module configuration for organization-specific requirements.
• System Configuration - Maintain regional, security and system preferences from the administration area.
• System Logs & Audit Trails - View system logs and audit-related activity through dedicated administration options.
• Backup & Restore - Use built-in backup and restore functions for operational data management.
• Import & Export Data - The Files module includes data import and export functions for controlled data handling.
• Preference Configuration - Maintain payroll and user-interface preferences from the administration console.
• Operational Monitoring - The administration console includes indicators for active users, employees, database health, processing output and audit logs.
• System Advisory - Display operational notices or scheduled system advisories to authorized administrators.
7. Employee / User Self-Service
• Payroll Snapshot - Employees can view information such as the next pay date and most recent net pay from their portal.
• Leave Balance - The self-service dashboard displays the employee leave balance for quick reference.
• Tax Status - The employee portal displays tax-status information and identifies P24-related status where configured.
• My Payslips - Employees can access payslip history from their own self-service area.
• Request Leave - Employees can submit leave or vacation requests directly from the portal.
• Tax Documents - The portal includes access to tax-document workflows identified as P24 and P45 forms.
• Update Profile - Employees can update profile information including address and banking details.
• Recent Documents - Recent payslips, tax certificates and leave documents can be displayed for convenient access and download.
• Notice Board - Important employee announcements and assessment notices can be surfaced in the self-service portal.
8. How It Can Help Your Business Grow
• Centralize HR & Payroll Operations - Bringing employee data, payroll, attendance, leave, payslips and reports into one system reduces dependency on disconnected records.
• Process Payroll More Efficiently - Structured calculation, registers, updates and disbursement workflows give payroll teams a clearer processing sequence.
• Support Multiple Companies - Company selection makes it easier for shared payroll or HR teams to work across multiple business entities from one environment.
• Handle Different Pay Cycles - Monthly, weekly and fortnightly payroll frequencies help the system support different workforce arrangements.
• Improve Employee Service - Self-service access to payslips, leave requests, tax documents and profile updates reduces routine administrative follow-up.
• Improve Management Visibility - Employee, attendance, payroll, salary, turnover, retention and year-to-date reports provide structured information for decision-making.
• Keep Records Organized - Registers, system logs, recent documents and company-based workflows make important HR and payroll records easier for authorized users to locate.
• Strengthen Operational Control - Role-based access, user provisioning and system configuration help separate responsibilities between administrators, managers, supervisors and other users.
• Support Business Continuity - Import, export, backup and restore options help organizations maintain better control over operational data handling.
• Scale With Workforce Growth - The platform can be adapted as employee counts, companies, payroll frequencies, roles and reporting requirements expand.
9. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be customized around your organization structure, employee categories, payroll process, pay frequencies, reporting requirements, approval flows and regional operating needs.
• Branding - Software name, logo, interface labels and other brand elements can be customized.
• Company Structure - Company profiles, payroll entities and organization-level fields can be adapted to your operational structure.
• Employee & HR Fields - Employee records, attendance fields, leave information and profile data can be adjusted according to business requirements.
• Payroll Workflow - Payroll stages, transaction fields, calculation workflow, registers and approval-related steps can be tailored to the agreed process.
• Pay Frequencies - Monthly, weekly, fortnightly or other required payroll cycles can be configured as part of the implementation scope.
• Roles & Permissions - Admin, Manager, Supervisor, Driver/Employee, Viewer and other role-based access can be adjusted according to responsibility.
• Payslips & Documents - Payslip layouts, document fields, employee forms and document workflows can be adapted to organizational requirements.
• Reports - Report fields, filters, summaries and management outputs can be customized around the information your team needs.

• Regional & Statutory Workflows - P24/P45, TRN-related, statutory-return or other region-specific workflows can be configured according to the agreed requirements and applicable implementation scope.
• Integrations - Suitable banking, payment, email, accounting or other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
10. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual HR, payroll and employee-management process rather than forcing every organization into the same fixed workflow.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what is complete, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Business-Focused Customization - The platform can evolve with new companies, payroll frequencies, employee types, reports, statutory workflows and integrations as your organization grows.
• Organized & Controlled Access - Role-based access helps keep HR and payroll information available to the appropriate users while limiting unnecessary visibility.
• Structured Data Management - Import/export, backup/restore, registers, logs and document access support a more organized operational environment.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
11. Frequently Asked Questions
Can the software manage multiple companies?
Yes. The interface includes company selection so authorized users can work with different company or payroll environments from one system.
Does it support different payroll frequencies?
Yes. Monthly, weekly and fortnightly frequencies are shown in the company-selection workflow, and additional requirements can be discussed during customization.
Can payroll calculations and registers be managed?
Yes. The Finance module includes Payroll Calculation, Calculation Register, Payroll Update, Payroll Register and Payroll Register Summary workflows.
Can payslips be generated and emailed?
Yes. The software includes payslip generation and management, My Payslips access and email-payslip workflows, including a TRN-protected option shown in the interface.
Can employees view payslips and request leave?
Yes. The employee self-service portal includes My Payslips, Request Leave, Tax Documents and Update Profile actions.
Does the system include attendance and leave management?
Yes. Attendance Management and Leave Management are included in the HRM module.
What reports are available?
The interface includes employee, attendance, payroll, salary, payroll summary, transaction, turnover, year-to-date, retention and other reporting workflows.
Does it include P24/P45-related workflows?
Yes. The current interface includes Email P24 Advice and employee tax-document areas identified as P24 and P45. Exact statutory configuration can be adapted to the agreed implementation requirements.
Can data be imported, exported and backed up?
Yes. The Files and administration areas include Export Data, Import Data, Backup System and Restore System functions.
Can user access be controlled by role?
Yes. The access screen includes Admin, Driver, Manager, Supervisor and Viewer roles, and role permissions can be adapted to the project requirements.
Can the software be customized?
Yes. Branding, fields, payroll workflows, pay frequencies, roles, reports, documents, regional workflows and other modules can be customized according to project requirements.
Can third-party services be integrated?
Suitable banking, payment, email, accounting and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. We maintain transparent communication and provide regular project progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
12. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build an HRM and payroll platform around your companies, employees, pay cycles, attendance, leave, payslips, reporting and employee self-service requirements.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your organization.
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
SERVICE LEAD & JOB MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
From Lead Discovery to Quote, Assignment, Execution and Payment
A connected platform for service businesses to manage leads, professional onboarding, quotations, job assignment, field execution, notifications and payment workflows from one place.
1. Overview

Service Lead & Job Management Software is a digital operations platform built for service-based businesses and professionals that need to manage leads, quotations, job allocation and field execution in one connected workflow.

The platform helps businesses move from customer request to completed service with clearer pricing, better task visibility, organized professional records and structured communication throughout the job lifecycle.
2. Core Platform Capabilities
• Lead Discovery & Search - Customers can search for the service they need and use location or postcode-based discovery to find relevant service options.
• Lead Management - Service requests can be managed as actionable leads instead of remaining scattered across calls, messages or manual notes.
• Quote Creation - Create structured quotes with guided measurements or scope, transparent pricing breakdowns and approval steps.
• Lead Selling or Assignment - Businesses can sell leads or assign jobs to professionals according to their operating model.
• Professional Registration - Service professionals can request an account by submitting identity, contact, business, specialty and location information.
• Category & Specialty Setup - Professionals can register under a service category such as plumbing, electrical or other supported specialties.
• Project / Service Plans - Professional onboarding includes plan selection, supporting a plan-based service model.
• Task Assignment & Tracking - Assign work and monitor tasks from start through completion.
• Proof of Work & Compliance - Support proof-of-work and compliance-related job closure steps.
• Job Status Tracking - Monitor job progress with real-time status visibility through the execution workflow.
• Notifications - Keep professionals and teams informed with job-related notifications during assignment and execution.
• Rescheduling - Support easier rescheduling where job timing needs to change.
• Payments - Include payment-related steps as part of the end-to-end service workflow.
• Mobile App Access - The platform promotes mobile access through downloadable applications for professionals and field users.
3. Customer & Lead Experience
• Simple Service Search - Customers can begin by entering the service required and their location or postcode.
• Clear Job Details - Lead and job information can include rich details to help professionals understand the work before accepting or quoting.
• Transparent Quotation - Structured pricing and scope information helps reduce confusion between customers and service providers.
• Approval & Signature - The quotation workflow supports approval and signature steps before work progresses.
• Track Work to Completion - The platform is designed around a clear request-to-completion journey rather than disconnected job stages.
4. Professional / Service Provider Experience
• Professional Registration - Professionals can apply with name, business name, email, phone, specialty, plan and address details.
• Business Profile Setup - Business identity and service location information are captured during onboarding.
• Preferred Plan Selection - Professionals can select a preferred service plan during registration.
• Assigned Jobs - Professionals can receive job assignments based on the business workflow.
• Field Execution - Assigned work can be tracked through status updates, notifications and completion steps.
• Mobile Workflow - App access supports professionals who need to manage work while away from a desktop.
5. From Lead to Job Completion
• Step 1 - Receive or Discover the Lead - Capture a customer request through the service-search and lead workflow.
• Step 2 - Build the Quote - Define scope, measurements and pricing, then move the quote toward approval.
• Step 3 - Sell or Assign the Job - Route the opportunity to the appropriate business or professional.
• Step 4 - Execute & Track - Manage assigned tasks, job status, notifications and any required rescheduling.
• Step 5 - Verify & Close - Use proof-of-work, compliance and closure steps to complete the service lifecycle.
• Step 6 - Payment - Track the payment-related stage as part of the completed job workflow.
6. How It Can Help a Service Business Grow
• Convert More Enquiries into Jobs - A structured lead-to-quote workflow helps teams respond faster and move opportunities toward approval and assignment.
• Reduce Lead Leakage - Centralized lead tracking helps prevent service requests from being lost across calls, spreadsheets or messaging apps.
• Improve Pricing Clarity - Guided scope and transparent pricing can reduce misunderstandings and improve customer confidence before work begins.
• Coordinate More Jobs - Task assignment, status tracking and notifications make it easier to manage multiple jobs and professionals at the same time.
• Improve Customer Experience - Clear quoting, approvals, job tracking and communication create a more organized service journey.
• Build a Professional Network - Professional registration and category-based onboarding support the growth of a wider service-provider network.
• Support New Revenue Models - Lead selling, job assignment and plan-based professional access can support different commercial models.
• Increase Operational Control - Management gains a clearer view of how work moves from request through assignment, execution and payment.
• Scale with Mobile Teams - Mobile application access supports field professionals working across multiple locations.
7. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be customized around your service categories, lead model, quotation process, professional network, job workflow and commercial structure.
• Branding - Logo, software name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
• Service Categories - Categories, specialties and service types can be configured according to your business.
• Lead Workflow - Lead fields, statuses, routing rules and ownership can be adapted to your process.
• Quotation & Pricing - Quote fields, pricing structure, scope information, approval stages and signature flow can be customized.
• Professional Onboarding - Registration fields, verification steps, service areas and plan selection can be modified.
• Job Assignment - Assignment rules, task stages, priorities and rescheduling workflows can be adjusted.
• Notifications - Notification triggers and communication workflows can be tailored to operational requirements.
• Payments - Payment-related workflows and suitable payment integrations can be configured based on project requirements and provider availability.
• Reports & Dashboards - Operational KPIs, lead reports, job reports and management dashboards can be added or adjusted.
• Integrations - Suitable CRM, payment, mapping, communication and other third-party APIs can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
8. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual lead and field-service workflow instead of forcing every service business into the same fixed process.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The platform can evolve with new service categories, professional types, lead models, reports and integrations as your business expands.
• End-to-End Workflow Focus - The system connects lead capture, quotation, assignment, execution, verification and payment in one structured journey.
• Mobile-Friendly Operations - Field professionals can work through a mobile-oriented experience rather than depending only on office-based tools.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
9. Frequently Asked Questions
Can the software be used for different service industries?
Yes. The platform supports category-based professional onboarding and can be customized for different service businesses and specialties.
Can customers search for services by location?
Yes. The customer-facing workflow includes service search with location or postcode-based discovery.
Can we create quotes inside the system?
Yes. The workflow includes quote creation with guided scope or measurements, pricing breakdown and approval steps.
Can leads be sold or assigned?
Yes. The platform supports workflows where a lead can be sold or a job can be assigned according to the business model.
Can jobs be tracked after assignment?
Yes. Job execution includes task assignment, status tracking, notifications, rescheduling and closure-related steps.
Can professionals register themselves?
Yes. A professional registration flow is available for submitting business, specialty, contact, plan and location details.
Does the platform support mobile access?
Yes. The product presents mobile-app access for service professionals and field workflows.
Can the pricing or subscription plans be changed?
The plan and pricing structure can be customized according to your commercial model and project requirements.
Can third-party services be integrated?
Suitable payment, mapping, CRM, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. We maintain transparent communication and provide regular project progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
10. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a service lead and job management platform around your categories, professional network, quotation process and field operations.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your business.
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
ENTERPRISE BUSINESS ERP SOFTWARE
Sales, Inventory, Purchase, Accounting & Operations Management

A centralized enterprise ERP platform designed to help businesses manage sales orders, customers, invoices, products, stock movement, purchasing, vendors, accounting, payments, taxes, packing, shipping, marketplace synchronization and operational reporting from one connected system.

Dedicated Super Admin, Sales Manager, Inventory Manager, Purchase Manager, Accountant and Operations Staff workspaces keep responsibilities organized while management maintains broader business visibility.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage
Sales Orders & Customers - Create and monitor sales orders, maintain customer records and review order activity from a structured sales workflow.
Invoices & Revenue Visibility - Track invoices, unpaid amounts, monthly revenue and other sales-related financial activity.
Products & Inventory - Maintain products and SKUs, review active stock levels and monitor current inventory availability.
Stock Movement & Low Stock - Track stock movements, minimum required quantities and low-stock or critical-stock conditions.
Purchasing & Vendors - Manage purchase orders, vendors, vendor bills and procurement activity from one connected purchasing workflow.
Accounting & Finance - Maintain chart of accounts, payments, taxes, reconciliation and profit-related reporting within the ERP environment.
Packing & Shipping - Organize packing queues, shipping queues, delivery issues and fulfillment-related operational activity.
Marketplace & Connector Sync - Support connected commerce workflows with marketplace synchronization such as Amazon SP-API, Mercado Libre and WooCommerce where configured.
Reports & Export Tools - Review sales, inventory, profit and operational information through dashboards, reports and available export actions.
Role-Based Access - Different business teams work from dedicated dashboards and menus aligned with their responsibilities.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides dedicated workspaces for key business roles, helping each user focus on the information and actions required for day-to-day operations.
Super Admin - Complete Enterprise Oversight
Designed for broad control of sales, inventory, purchasing, accounting, operations, reports, connectors and user access.
Operations Center - Monitor today's orders, pending deliveries, active stock items and unpaid invoices from one management view.
Sales & Customer Control - Access sales orders, customer records and invoice-related workflows.
Inventory Management - Manage products, stock moves and low-stock conditions across the organization.
Purchase Management - Access purchase orders, vendors and vendor bills.
Accounting & Reporting - Review accounting areas, reports and profit-related business information.
Connectors & Users - Manage connector settings, users, roles and other available administrative configuration.
Quick Actions & Sync - Use available actions for product creation, order creation, synchronization and report downloads.
Sales Manager - Sales Performance & Order Management
A focused sales workspace for monitoring orders, customers, revenue, delivery activity and conversion performance.
Sales Dashboard - Review today's orders, month-to-date revenue, pending deliveries and conversion rate.
Recent Orders - Monitor order IDs, customers, sales channels, totals and order statuses.
Top Customers - Identify high-value customers and review order contribution.
Order Creation & Export - Create new orders and export available sales information.
Inventory Manager - Stock & Warehouse Visibility
A dedicated inventory workspace for product stock, movements, low-stock alerts and shipment visibility.
Inventory Dashboard - Review total products, low-stock items, pending shipments and warehouse utilization.
Active Stock Levels - Monitor SKU, product, current stock, minimum required quantity and stock status.
Recent Movements - Review stock additions and deductions recorded against products.
Inventory Actions - Access products, stock moves, low-stock views, exports and product creation.
Purchase Manager - Vendor & Procurement Control
A purchasing workspace focused on suppliers, purchase orders, vendor bills and procurement performance.
Purchase Dashboard - Review active vendors, open purchase orders, pending bills and monthly procurement.
Recent Purchase Orders - Monitor vendors, purchase totals, status and order dates.
Vendor Bills - Track due-soon, pending and overdue supplier bills.
Purchase Actions - Create purchase orders, maintain vendors and export available purchasing information.
Accountant - Finance, Payments & Reconciliation
A finance workspace for revenue, payment, tax and reconciliation visibility.
Finance Dashboard - Review month-to-date revenue, outstanding payments, tax liability and reconciliation percentage.
Accounting Structure - Access chart of accounts, payments, taxes and reconciliation.
Recent Payments - Review customer and vendor payments together with amount and status.
Unpaid Invoices - Monitor pending and overdue customer invoices.
Financial Export - Export available profit-and-loss information for management review.
Operations Staff - Packing, Shipping & Fulfillment
A fulfillment workspace for daily packing, shipping and delivery-related activity.
Operations Dashboard - Review orders to pack, orders to ship, delivery issues and failed synchronization alerts.
