rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
SERVICE LEAD & JOB MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
From Lead Discovery to Quote, Assignment, Execution and Payment
A connected platform for service businesses to manage leads, professional onboarding, quotations, job assignment, field execution, notifications and payment workflows from one place.
1. Overview

Service Lead & Job Management Software is a digital operations platform built for service-based businesses and professionals that need to manage leads, quotations, job allocation and field execution in one connected workflow.

The platform helps businesses move from customer request to completed service with clearer pricing, better task visibility, organized professional records and structured communication throughout the job lifecycle.
2. Core Platform Capabilities
• Lead Discovery & Search - Customers can search for the service they need and use location or postcode-based discovery to find relevant service options.
• Lead Management - Service requests can be managed as actionable leads instead of remaining scattered across calls, messages or manual notes.
• Quote Creation - Create structured quotes with guided measurements or scope, transparent pricing breakdowns and approval steps.
• Lead Selling or Assignment - Businesses can sell leads or assign jobs to professionals according to their operating model.
• Professional Registration - Service professionals can request an account by submitting identity, contact, business, specialty and location information.
• Category & Specialty Setup - Professionals can register under a service category such as plumbing, electrical or other supported specialties.
• Project / Service Plans - Professional onboarding includes plan selection, supporting a plan-based service model.
• Task Assignment & Tracking - Assign work and monitor tasks from start through completion.
• Proof of Work & Compliance - Support proof-of-work and compliance-related job closure steps.
• Job Status Tracking - Monitor job progress with real-time status visibility through the execution workflow.
• Notifications - Keep professionals and teams informed with job-related notifications during assignment and execution.
• Rescheduling - Support easier rescheduling where job timing needs to change.
• Payments - Include payment-related steps as part of the end-to-end service workflow.
• Mobile App Access - The platform promotes mobile access through downloadable applications for professionals and field users.
3. Customer & Lead Experience
• Simple Service Search - Customers can begin by entering the service required and their location or postcode.
• Clear Job Details - Lead and job information can include rich details to help professionals understand the work before accepting or quoting.
• Transparent Quotation - Structured pricing and scope information helps reduce confusion between customers and service providers.
• Approval & Signature - The quotation workflow supports approval and signature steps before work progresses.
• Track Work to Completion - The platform is designed around a clear request-to-completion journey rather than disconnected job stages.
4. Professional / Service Provider Experience
• Professional Registration - Professionals can apply with name, business name, email, phone, specialty, plan and address details.
• Business Profile Setup - Business identity and service location information are captured during onboarding.
• Preferred Plan Selection - Professionals can select a preferred service plan during registration.
• Assigned Jobs - Professionals can receive job assignments based on the business workflow.
• Field Execution - Assigned work can be tracked through status updates, notifications and completion steps.
• Mobile Workflow - App access supports professionals who need to manage work while away from a desktop.
5. From Lead to Job Completion
• Step 1 - Receive or Discover the Lead - Capture a customer request through the service-search and lead workflow.
• Step 2 - Build the Quote - Define scope, measurements and pricing, then move the quote toward approval.
• Step 3 - Sell or Assign the Job - Route the opportunity to the appropriate business or professional.
• Step 4 - Execute & Track - Manage assigned tasks, job status, notifications and any required rescheduling.
• Step 5 - Verify & Close - Use proof-of-work, compliance and closure steps to complete the service lifecycle.
• Step 6 - Payment - Track the payment-related stage as part of the completed job workflow.
6. How It Can Help a Service Business Grow
• Convert More Enquiries into Jobs - A structured lead-to-quote workflow helps teams respond faster and move opportunities toward approval and assignment.
• Reduce Lead Leakage - Centralized lead tracking helps prevent service requests from being lost across calls, spreadsheets or messaging apps.
• Improve Pricing Clarity - Guided scope and transparent pricing can reduce misunderstandings and improve customer confidence before work begins.
• Coordinate More Jobs - Task assignment, status tracking and notifications make it easier to manage multiple jobs and professionals at the same time.
• Improve Customer Experience - Clear quoting, approvals, job tracking and communication create a more organized service journey.
• Build a Professional Network - Professional registration and category-based onboarding support the growth of a wider service-provider network.
• Support New Revenue Models - Lead selling, job assignment and plan-based professional access can support different commercial models.
• Increase Operational Control - Management gains a clearer view of how work moves from request through assignment, execution and payment.
• Scale with Mobile Teams - Mobile application access supports field professionals working across multiple locations.
7. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be customized around your service categories, lead model, quotation process, professional network, job workflow and commercial structure.
• Branding - Logo, software name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
• Service Categories - Categories, specialties and service types can be configured according to your business.
• Lead Workflow - Lead fields, statuses, routing rules and ownership can be adapted to your process.
• Quotation & Pricing - Quote fields, pricing structure, scope information, approval stages and signature flow can be customized.
• Professional Onboarding - Registration fields, verification steps, service areas and plan selection can be modified.
• Job Assignment - Assignment rules, task stages, priorities and rescheduling workflows can be adjusted.
• Notifications - Notification triggers and communication workflows can be tailored to operational requirements.
• Payments - Payment-related workflows and suitable payment integrations can be configured based on project requirements and provider availability.
• Reports & Dashboards - Operational KPIs, lead reports, job reports and management dashboards can be added or adjusted.
• Integrations - Suitable CRM, payment, mapping, communication and other third-party APIs can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
8. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual lead and field-service workflow instead of forcing every service business into the same fixed process.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The platform can evolve with new service categories, professional types, lead models, reports and integrations as your business expands.
• End-to-End Workflow Focus - The system connects lead capture, quotation, assignment, execution, verification and payment in one structured journey.
• Mobile-Friendly Operations - Field professionals can work through a mobile-oriented experience rather than depending only on office-based tools.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
9. Frequently Asked Questions
Can the software be used for different service industries?
Yes. The platform supports category-based professional onboarding and can be customized for different service businesses and specialties.
Can customers search for services by location?
Yes. The customer-facing workflow includes service search with location or postcode-based discovery.
Can we create quotes inside the system?
Yes. The workflow includes quote creation with guided scope or measurements, pricing breakdown and approval steps.
Can leads be sold or assigned?
Yes. The platform supports workflows where a lead can be sold or a job can be assigned according to the business model.
Can jobs be tracked after assignment?
Yes. Job execution includes task assignment, status tracking, notifications, rescheduling and closure-related steps.
Can professionals register themselves?
Yes. A professional registration flow is available for submitting business, specialty, contact, plan and location details.
Does the platform support mobile access?
Yes. The product presents mobile-app access for service professionals and field workflows.
Can the pricing or subscription plans be changed?
The plan and pricing structure can be customized according to your commercial model and project requirements.
Can third-party services be integrated?
Suitable payment, mapping, CRM, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. We maintain transparent communication and provide regular project progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
10. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a service lead and job management platform around your categories, professional network, quotation process and field operations.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your business.
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements.

80.title: TELEHEALTH MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
80.subtitle: Specification Document
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
TELEHEALTH MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Role-Based Digital Healthcare Operations for Organizations, Doctors and Patients
Manage healthcare organizations, staff, patients, appointments, consultations, communication, transactions and platform operations from one connected telehealth system.
1. Overview
Telehealth Management Software is a multi-role digital healthcare platform designed to connect platform owners, healthcare administrators, doctors and patients through one structured system.

The software supports organization-level management, patient administration, appointment scheduling, doctor workflows, consultation records, communication history, transactions and remote care access while giving each user a focused portal based on their responsibilities.
2. Core Platform Capabilities
• Multi-Role Access - Dedicated workspaces for Super Admin, Admin, Doctor and Patient users.
• Organization Management - Centralized visibility and management of healthcare organizations from the platform-level Super Admin workspace.
• Plans & Subscriptions - Manage platform plans and monitor active subscriptions at the global administration level.
• Admin Management - Create and manage platform or organization administrators.
• Finance & Revenue Visibility - Authorized users can monitor revenue performance, transactions and financial activity.
• Patient Management - Manage active patients, archived patient records and patient-level operational data.
• Doctor & Staff Management - Administrative tools support doctor and staff management within the healthcare organization.
• Appointment Management - Create, monitor and manage healthcare appointments from admin, doctor and patient workflows.
• Consultation & Encounter Records - Maintain consultation results and encounter activity as part of the care workflow.
• Communication History - Track SMS and email communication history from the administrative workspace.
• Doctor-Patient Chat - Patients and doctors can use direct chat functionality within their respective portals.
• Waiting Room - Support telehealth waiting-room workflows before remote consultations.
• Transactions - Patients and administrators can access transaction-related information according to role.
• Reporting & Export - Admin users can export reports and review operational and revenue analytics.
3. Role-Based Portals
Each portal is designed around a specific level of responsibility, helping users focus on the information and actions they need without exposing unnecessary system controls.
Super Admin - Global Platform Control
• Platform Dashboard - Monitor total organizations, total admins, monthly revenue and active subscriptions.
• Organizations - Create and manage healthcare organizations using the platform.
• Plans - Manage platform plans and subscription structures.
• Admins - Create and manage platform-level or organization administrators.
• Finance - Review platform financial performance and revenue activity.
• Revenue Growth - Monitor multi-month revenue trends from the global dashboard.
• Quick Actions - Access shortcuts for creating organizations, adding admins, financial audit and system-health review.
• Settings - Manage platform-level settings and configuration.
Admin - Organization Operations & Patient Management
• Administrative Dashboard - Monitor total revenue, total patients, active doctors and today's appointments.
• Staff Management - Manage healthcare staff within the organization.
• Manage Patients - Access and maintain active patient records.
• Archived Patients - Maintain archived patient records separately from active patient management.
• Login History - Review user login activity for administrative oversight.
• SMS History - Access SMS communication records.
• Email History - Access email communication records.
• Consultation Results - Review consultation result information across the organization.
• Appointment Calendar - Manage appointment scheduling and calendar activity.
• Transaction List - Review transaction-related records.
• Revenue Analytics - Monitor monthly, quarterly or yearly revenue performance.
• Export Report - Export administrative reports for further review or recordkeeping.
• Settings - Manage organization-level system configuration.
Doctor - Clinical Scheduling & Patient Care
• Doctor Dashboard - View active patients, today's appointments and total encounters.
• Waiting Room - Access patients waiting for telehealth consultations.
• Appointments - Review and manage scheduled patient appointments.
• Encounters - Access patient encounter activity as part of the care workflow.
• Calendar - Manage the doctor's appointment calendar.
• Patient Chat - Communicate directly with patients through the system.
• My Patients - Access patients connected to the doctor's care.
• Consultation Results - Record or review consultation result information.
• Upcoming Appointments - See confirmed and pending appointments with date and time information.
• Patient Search - Search patients directly from the doctor workspace.
• New Appointment - Create appointments from the doctor dashboard.
• My Profile - Maintain doctor identity and profile information.
Patient - Digital Care Access
• Patient Dashboard - View total consultations, connected doctors and upcoming appointments.
• My Appointments - Review scheduled and previous appointments.
• Encounters - Access encounter-related information from the patient's care history.
• Chat With Doctor - Communicate with connected doctors through the patient portal.
• Find a Doctor - Search for available healthcare providers.
• Waiting Room - Enter the telehealth waiting-room workflow before a consultation.
• Emergency Booking - Access emergency booking from the patient dashboard.
• Join Tele-Session - Join the next scheduled remote consultation directly from the portal.
• My Transaction List - Review patient transaction information.
• My Health Profile - Access personal health-profile information.
4. How It Can Help a Healthcare Business Grow
• Expand Digital Care Access - Give patients a structured way to find doctors, book appointments, communicate and join remote consultations without depending entirely on physical visits.
• Support Multiple Healthcare Organizations - The global organization structure enables a platform owner to manage multiple healthcare organizations from one system.
• Increase Appointment Opportunities - Doctor search, appointment creation, patient booking and remote care access can make it easier for patients to move from inquiry to consultation.
• Improve Doctor Productivity - Doctors can manage appointments, waiting-room patients, calendars, encounters and patient communication from one focused workspace.

• Improve Administrative Efficiency - Patient management, staff management, appointment calendars, communication history and transactions are centralized instead of being spread across disconnected tools.
• Improve Revenue Visibility - Authorized dashboards provide revenue, subscription and transaction visibility to support better business decisions.
• Strengthen Patient Engagement - Patient chat, appointment visibility, health-profile access and tele-session workflows keep patients more connected to their care journey.
• Keep Data Better Organized - Role-based portals help centralize operational healthcare information and make it available to the appropriate users.
• Support Business Expansion - The software structure can be extended with new organizations, admins, doctors, workflows and integrations as the platform grows.
5. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be customized around your healthcare organization structure, specialties, appointment model, patient journey, revenue model and internal operating process.
• Branding - Logo, platform name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
• Organizations & Admin Structure - Organization hierarchy, admin levels and management permissions can be adapted.
• Roles & Permissions - Super Admin, Admin, Doctor and Patient permissions can be changed, and additional roles can be developed where required.
• Appointment & Consultation Workflow - Booking stages, appointment fields, waiting-room flow and consultation processes can be tailored.
• Patient & Doctor Management - Patient, doctor, staff and profile fields can be modified or extended.
• Plans & Subscription Model - Plan structures, subscriptions and platform access rules can be configured around the commercial model.
• Communication - SMS, email and other communication workflows can be extended based on project requirements.
• Forms, Fields & Reports - Operational forms, healthcare fields, dashboard metrics and reports can be modified or expanded.
• Integrations - Suitable payment, video-consultation, communication and other third-party APIs can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
6. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your healthcare model, organization structure and operational workflow rather than forcing every business into the same fixed template.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what is complete, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Role-Based Product Structure - Dedicated Super Admin, Admin, Doctor and Patient workspaces keep each user focused on relevant responsibilities.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The platform can evolve with new organizations, users, workflows, reports, plans and integrations as your business expands.
• Organized & Controlled Access - Centralized records and permission-based access help keep operational information organized while limiting unnecessary visibility.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
7. Frequently Asked Questions
Can this software support multiple healthcare organizations?
Yes. The Super Admin workspace includes organization management, allowing the platform structure to support multiple healthcare organizations.
Can administrators manage patients, staff and appointments?
Yes. The Admin portal includes staff management, patient management, appointment calendar, consultation results, communication history and transaction-related tools.
Can doctors manage appointments and communicate with patients?
Yes. Doctors can access appointments, calendar, waiting room, encounters, patient chat and their connected patients.
Can patients find doctors and join online consultations?
Yes. The Patient portal includes Find a Doctor, Waiting Room, appointment access and Join Tele-Session functionality.
Does the system support emergency booking?
Yes. Emergency Booking is available from the patient dashboard.
Can we monitor platform revenue and subscriptions?
Yes. The Super Admin dashboard includes monthly revenue and active-subscription visibility, while Admin users have organization-level revenue analytics.
Can reports be exported?
Yes. The Admin portal includes report export functionality.
Can SMS and email history be tracked?
Yes. The Admin workspace includes SMS History and Email History sections.
Can the software be customized?
Yes. Branding, roles, workflows, organizations, forms, reports, subscriptions and integrations can be customized according to project requirements.
Can third-party APIs be integrated?
Suitable payment, video, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. We maintain transparent communication and provide regular progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
8. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a telehealth platform around your healthcare organizations, doctors, patients, appointment workflows and digital care model.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your organization.
BOOK A DEMO  •  GET A QUOTE
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
MEDICAL PRACTICE & MULTI-MODALITY BILLING SOFTWARE
Role-Based Clinical Operations, Patient Scheduling & Multi-Provider Billing

A centralized medical practice management platform designed to bring patient administration, accident cases, appointments, clinical documentation, treatment sessions, AI-assisted note workflows, provider billing, claims, payments, documents and operational reporting into one connected system. Dedicated role-based workspaces help clinical, front-desk and billing teams focus on the tools relevant to their responsibilities while management maintains broader oversight.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage
Patient & Case Management — Maintain patient records, accident cases and related clinical activity in a structured practice workflow.
Appointments & Self-Booking — Manage staff scheduling, appointment activity, patient check-in and a public patient self-booking workflow.

Multi-Modality Clinical Operations — Support multiple provider and treatment workflows including Pain Management, ESWT Shockwave Therapy, Laser Therapy, Counseling & Mental Health, Trigger Point Injection and TECAR Therapy.
Clinical Records & Assessments — Maintain clinical records, assessments, forms, treatment-session information and provider review activity.
AI-Assisted Clinical Notes — Support AI-assisted drafting workflows for clinical notes while keeping review, approval and signing actions with authorized clinical users.
Billing & Claims — Manage billing overview, provider-specific bills, CMS-1500 claim previews, payments, adjustments and account-aging activity.
Documents & Patient Packets — Organize practice documents and patient packet workflows from one centralized area.
Staff, Providers & Services — Manage staff roles, provider profiles, services, codes, settings, reports and operational audit activity.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides dedicated experiences for administrative, clinical, front-desk and billing users, helping each role work with the information and actions relevant to its responsibilities.
Super Admin — Complete Practice Oversight
Designed for system-wide management, provider configuration, financial visibility and operational control.
Master Dashboard — Monitor outstanding balances, active patients and cases, scheduled appointments, reminder issues and provider-service status.
Practice Administration — Manage patients, accident cases, appointments, patient self-booking, staff and roles, provider profiles, services and codes.
Clinical Oversight — Access clinical records, AI note workflows, assessments, forms and treatment-session information.
Financial Control — Review billing, provider bills, CMS-1500 claims, payments, adjustments and account aging.
Governance & Reporting — Access documents, patient packets, reports, audit logs and system settings.
Receptionist — Front Desk & Scheduling
Focused on patient registration, arrivals, scheduling and day-to-day front-desk coordination.
Patient Registration — Register and access patient records according to front-desk permissions.
Appointment Scheduling — Schedule visits and review the daily appointment queue.
Patient Check-In — Track arrival status and process check-ins from a dedicated action queue.
Reminder Visibility — Monitor SMS/email reminder delivery status for scheduled appointments.
Documents — Access relevant practice documents based on assigned permissions.
Doctor — Clinical Review & AI-Assisted Documentation
A clinical workspace for reviewing charts, reports and AI-assisted note drafts before authorized approval and signing.
Clinical Review Queue — Review patient charts and provider documents requiring clinical action.
Signed & Locked Reports — Maintain visibility into completed clinical documentation and approved reports.
AI Note Assistant — Use configurable AI-assisted note drafting for supported clinical documentation workflows.
Patients & Cases — Access patient, accident-case and appointment information relevant to clinical care.
Assessments & Treatment Sessions — Work with assessments, forms and treatment-session records.
Therapist — Treatment Session Execution
Built for treatment-session logging and parameter capture across assigned therapy services.
ESWT Session Logging — Record shockwave treatment-session activity and procedure parameters.
Laser Therapy Sessions — Capture treatment settings, duration, energy and related session outcomes.
Vitals & Compliance Checks — Record required visit-level checks where configured in the clinical workflow.
Clinical Records — Access patients, cases, forms, treatment sessions and documents according to therapist permissions.
Counselor — Mental Health & Session Documentation
A focused workspace for counseling intake, session-note documentation and treatment-progress tracking.
Counseling Appointments — Monitor scheduled counseling visits and assigned patient activity.
Session Notes — Create and manage counseling session-note drafts within the configured clinical workflow.
Clinical Records — Access patient and case information required for counseling services.
Billing Visibility — Review permitted provider-bill information where the role is configured for view-only access.
Billing Staff — Multi-Provider Billing & Claims
Designed for financial operations across multiple provider services and patient cases.
Accounts Receivable — Monitor practice balances and overdue account-aging information.
Provider Bills — Maintain multiple provider bill statements within the patient case structure.
CMS-1500 Claims — Generate and review CMS-1500 claim previews as part of the configured billing workflow.
Payments & Adjustments — Record and review payment and adjustment activity.
Billing Reports — Access billing-related reports, documents and patient packets as permitted.
Patient Self-Booking Portal — Convenient Appointment Requests
A public-facing booking experience can allow patients to request or schedule appointments without requiring access to staff administration screens.
Self-Service Booking — Provide an easier path for patients to select available appointment options where enabled.
Reduced Front-Desk Workload — Shift suitable appointment requests to a controlled self-service workflow.
Configurable Availability — Booking rules, providers, services and availability can be tailored around practice requirements.
3. How It Helps Your Medical Practice
Centralize Clinical & Administrative Work — Bring patients, cases, appointments, clinical records, treatment sessions, billing and documents into one connected platform.
Improve Role Clarity — Dedicated workspaces help reception, clinical staff, billing teams and administrators focus on the functions relevant to their responsibilities.
Strengthen Appointment Coordination — Scheduling, patient self-booking, check-in queues and reminder visibility help keep appointment activity organized.
Standardize Clinical Documentation — Structured forms, treatment-session records and review workflows support more consistent documentation across providers and modalities.
Support Faster Documentation Workflows — AI-assisted note drafting can reduce repetitive preparation while keeping review and approval with authorized clinical users.
Improve Billing Visibility — Provider bills, claims, payments, adjustments and aging information give financial teams a clearer view of outstanding activity.
Keep Practice Records Organized — Centralized documents, patient packets, service codes and provider configurations reduce fragmented record handling.
Support Practice Growth — A configurable role-based structure can expand with additional users, providers, services, reports and integrations as requirements evolve.
4. Technology Stack
Responsive Web Application — The demonstrated platform is delivered through a modern browser-based interface for administrative, clinical and billing workflows.
Role-Based Application Layer — Separate authenticated workspaces control access for Super Admin, Receptionist, Doctor, Therapist, Counselor and Billing Staff roles.
Centralized Data Layer — Patient, appointment, clinical, billing, document and audit information is managed through a connected application data structure.
AI Integration Layer — The platform includes an AI-assisted clinical note workflow that can be configured around approved documentation use cases.
Integration-Ready Architecture — Messaging, reminder, billing and other third-party services can be integrated where required and supported by selected providers.

The exact frontend framework, backend framework, database technology, hosting environment and deployment architecture should be confirmed for the selected package or implementation before final technical documentation is issued.
5. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements

The software can be adapted around the way your medical practice operates, allowing the platform to match your branding, provider structure, treatment services, documentation standards and billing workflow.
Branding — Logo, software name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
Service Modalities — Existing treatment modalities can be adjusted and additional provider services can be configured or developed based on project scope.
Roles & Permissions — Staff roles, permissions, module access and data visibility can be adapted to your operational structure.
Clinical Forms & Templates — Assessments, procedure forms, note templates, patient packets and documentation workflows can be modified around agreed practice requirements.
Billing & Claims — Provider billing structures, service codes, claim workflows, payment handling, adjustments and reports can be configured according to project requirements.
Appointments & Reminders — Scheduling, self-booking, check-in, reminder and notification workflows can be tailored.
Reports & Dashboards — KPIs, operational reports, financial reports and dashboard views can be adjusted around management needs.
Integrations — Suitable payment, messaging, email, SMS, identity, accounting, clinical or other third-party services can be integrated based on requirements and provider availability.
AI Automation — AI-assisted workflows can be configured for approved use cases, with human review steps retained where required.
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
6. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
Built Around Your Requirements — The platform can be adapted around your practice workflow instead of forcing every medical business into the same fixed process.
Role-Based Product Structure — Dedicated staff workspaces keep front-desk, clinical, billing and administrative workflows organized and permission-controlled.
Clinical & Financial Workflow Coverage — The platform connects patient administration, documentation, treatment-session activity and billing within one operational system.
Scalable Customization — Start from the existing platform and modify providers, modalities, modules, forms, reports and integrations as requirements evolve.
Full-Stack Delivery — Frontend, backend, database, APIs, integration work and deployment support can be handled as one connected software solution according to project scope.
Source Code Options — Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance and development.
Integration Flexibility — Third-party services, APIs, communication tools and AI-assisted workflows can be added where required and supported.
Responsive Delivery — The software can be delivered for desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile-friendly use, with Android and iOS app versions available based on package and project scope.

Security-Focused Development — Kiaan Technology develops software with authenticated access, role-based permissions, controlled data visibility and secure password handling. The demonstrated product also presents audit-log functionality and HIPAA-aligned privacy and security controls; additional hosting, backup, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Transparent Communication — Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization, with regular progress updates.
Technical Support — Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
7. FAQ
Can the software manage multiple providers and treatment modalities?

Yes. The demonstrated platform supports multiple provider profiles and configurable service modalities, including Pain Management, ESWT, Laser Therapy, Counseling, Trigger Point Injection and TECAR Therapy. Additional services can be adapted based on project requirements.
Does the platform support patient self-booking and appointment management?
Yes. The platform includes appointment scheduling, front-desk check-in workflows and a patient self-booking portal that can be configured around provider availability and practice rules.
Does it support clinical documentation and AI-assisted notes?

Yes. The platform includes clinical records, assessments, forms, treatment-session documentation and an AI-assisted note workflow. Clinical review, approval and signing can remain with authorized staff according to the configured process.
Is the data secure?

The current system uses authenticated login, role-based access, controlled data visibility and secure password handling. The demonstrated platform also includes audit-log functionality and presents HIPAA-aligned privacy and security controls. Additional hosting, backup, audit, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Can third-party systems be integrated?
Suitable payment gateways, messaging, email/SMS reminders, accounting, identity, clinical and other services can be integrated where required and supported by the selected providers.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where it is included in the selected package or license.
Is the software available for mobile and tablet use?
Yes. The software can be delivered for desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile-friendly screens. Android and iOS app versions can also be provided based on the selected package and project scope.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. Kiaan Technology maintains transparent communication and provides regular progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
BOOK A DEMO  •  GET A QUOTE
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements and receive a project-specific proposal for your medical practice.

232.subtitle: Specification Document
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
INTELLIGENT LOAN MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Manage the Complete Lending Journey from Application to Recovery

A centralized, role-based lending operations platform for employee loan applications, eligibility verification, credit assessment, approvals, disbursements, payroll-linked repayments, management analytics and recovery workflows.
1. Overview
Intelligent Loan Management Software is a centralized, role-based platform designed to help organizations manage the full lending lifecycle from one connected workspace.

It brings borrower self-service, HR verification, application processing, credit assessment, finance operations, portfolio analytics and recovery management together so each team can work within a dedicated portal while management maintains visibility across the complete loan pipeline.
2. Complete Loan Application & Borrower Management
• Borrower Dashboard - Give employees or borrowers a clear view of their loan status, current balance, upcoming deduction, eligibility and recent account activity.
• Apply New Loan - Provide a structured self-service workflow for submitting new loan applications.
• Application Status - Allow users to review the progress and current state of their loan requests from their own portal.
• Statements - Keep borrower statements accessible from a dedicated account area.
• Letters & Documents - Provide secure access to loan-related letters and documents from the borrower portal.
• Settlement & Paid-Up Requests - Support borrower requests for settlement letters, paid-up letters and other configured loan correspondence.
• Borrower Profile - Maintain user profile information required for loan servicing and account management.
• Recent Activity - Present payment, disbursement and other account activity in a structured history view.
• Payroll-Linked Repayment Visibility - Show upcoming payroll deduction information where repayment is connected to the employee payroll process.
3. HR Verification & Employee Eligibility
• HR Verification Hub - Give the HR team a dedicated workspace for reviewing verification queues and employee eligibility.
• Pending Verification Queue - Keep submitted and HR-pending applications visible so required checks can be completed in an organized sequence.
• Employee Directory - Maintain access to employee records required for verification and lending workflows.
• Approval & Rejection Tracking - Track verification outcomes and provide management visibility into pending, approved and rejected activity.
• Activity Reports - Review HR-related lending activity through a dedicated reporting area.
• Queue Management - Use an operational queue to prioritize applications waiting for HR action.
4. Application Operations & Administration
• Operations Dashboard - Monitor total applications, pending reviews, approvals and rejections from an administrative overview.
• Application Management - Review lending applications as they move through the approval pipeline.
• Employee Management - Maintain employee-related records required across lending operations.
• Recent Application Activity - See applicant, employer, requested amount and current stage information in one operational view.
• Pipeline Health - Monitor approval-rate and processing-velocity indicators to understand workflow performance.
• Search & Filtering - Locate employee or application information quickly through operational search and filtering tools.
5. Credit Assessment & Risk Review
• Credit Operations Dashboard - Provide credit teams with a dedicated view of assessments waiting in queue, high-risk cases and completed approvals.
• Credit Queue - Organize applications that require credit assessment and analyst action.
• Risk Reviews - Support structured review of borrower risk before final lending decisions are completed.
• Credit Score Visibility - Display applicant credit-score information within the assessment workflow where available.
• Risk Classification - Identify cases by risk level so high-priority or higher-risk applications remain visible.
• Assessment Workflow - Allow credit personnel to open and process prioritized assessments from their own workspace.
• Credit Policy Metrics - Provide credit-performance indicators such as average score and rejection rate for operational monitoring.
6. Finance, Payouts & Disbursement Control
• Finance Executive Dashboard - Give the finance team a dedicated view of pending payout value, total disbursed value and failed-payment activity.
• Payout Queue - Organize approved loans waiting for finance action and disbursement.
• Bank Detail Verification - Support finance checks of beneficiary and bank information before initiating payout.
• Batch Processing - Process grouped finance activity through a dedicated batch-processing workflow.
• Payout History - Maintain a history of finance and disbursement activity for review.
• Audit History - Provide access to finance-related audit history for operational accountability.
• Failed Payment Visibility - Keep unsuccessful or failed payment activity visible for follow-up.
7. Management Analytics & Portfolio Visibility
• Executive Insights - Present management with a high-level view of lending performance and portfolio activity.
• Analytics - Review performance indicators and trends through a dedicated analytics workspace.
• Reports - Access management reporting without requiring operational teams to share disconnected spreadsheets.
• Revenue Visibility - Monitor total lending-related revenue or configured financial performance measures.
• Portfolio Yield - Track portfolio-yield information to support management review of lending performance.
• Disbursement Trends - Visualize disbursement movement over time for portfolio monitoring.
• Application Status Distribution - Review how applications are distributed across stages such as submitted, HR pending, HR approved and credit pending.
• Active Portfolio Visibility - Monitor active customer or borrower portfolio information according to the organization’s configured lending model.
8. Recovery & Collections Management
• Recovery Performance Dashboard - Give recovery users a dedicated workspace for assigned accounts, arrears and collection performance.
• Recovery Cases - Manage accounts requiring collection or recovery follow-up from one structured module.
• Payment Tracking - Track repayment activity and collections against recovery cases.
• Portfolio Arrears - Monitor the value of accounts currently in arrears.
• Active Recovery Cases - Maintain visibility into the number of accounts requiring ongoing recovery action.
• Collection Efficiency - Measure recovery performance over a defined period.
• Portfolio Aging - Segment overdue accounts into aging bands to support collection prioritization.
• Priority Collections - Surface borrowers and outstanding balances that require focused recovery action.
9. Role-Based Portals

The software supports separate User/Employee, HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery workspaces. Each role can be restricted to the information and actions required for its responsibilities.
User / Employee Portal - Loan Self-Service
• Personal Loan Overview - Review active loan status, balance, deductions, eligibility, statements and recent activity.
• Self-Service Requests - Apply for loans, check status and access letters or documents without requiring full administrative access.
HR Portal - Verification Control
• Employee Verification - Review employment-related eligibility and move applications through the HR verification stage.
• HR Reporting - Access employee, queue and activity information relevant to HR responsibilities.
Admin Portal - Operational Control
• Application Oversight - Manage applications, employees and pipeline activity across the lending process.
• Operational Monitoring - Track application volumes, pending reviews, stages and workflow health.
Credit Portal - Risk & Assessment
• Credit Decision Support - Review credit queues, scores, risk classifications and prioritized assessments.
Finance Portal - Disbursement Control
• Payout Management - Control approved disbursements, batch processing, history and bank-verification activity.
Management Portal - Executive Intelligence
• Portfolio Analytics - Review financial, application and portfolio performance from a management-focused dashboard.
Recovery Portal - Collections Control
• Collections Management - Manage overdue accounts, payment tracking, aging and recovery performance from a dedicated workspace.
10. How It Can Help Your Lending Operations Grow
• Manage the Full Loan Lifecycle in One System - Centralizing application, verification, credit, finance and recovery activity reduces dependence on separate spreadsheets and disconnected tools.
• Improve Processing Visibility - Role-specific queues and dashboards make it easier to see where each application is currently waiting and which team needs to act next.
• Deliver Better Borrower Self-Service - Employees can apply, track status, review balances, access statements and request letters from their own portal.
• Strengthen Credit Control - Dedicated credit queues, risk reviews and score visibility help keep assessment activity structured and traceable.
• Improve Finance Accountability - Payout queues, bank-detail checks, batch processing and audit history give finance teams clearer operational control.
• Support Faster Management Decisions - Executive analytics, portfolio yield, application distribution and trend reporting provide a clearer view of lending performance.
• Improve Recovery Prioritization - Arrears, aging, active cases and priority collections help recovery teams focus on accounts that need attention.
• Scale Across Teams - Separate HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery workspaces allow the platform to support more structured operations as lending volume grows.
11. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements

The software can be adapted around your lending products, employee or borrower journey, approval structure, credit policy, finance process, repayment model, recovery strategy and internal operating procedures.
• Branding - Logo, software name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
• Roles & Permissions - User, HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery access can be modified, and additional roles can be developed where required.
• Loan Products - Application fields, loan types, eligibility rules, limits, instalment structures and product-specific workflows can be configured according to project requirements.
• Approval Workflow - HR verification, administrative review, credit assessment, management approvals and finance gatekeeping stages can be adjusted to match your operating model.
• Credit & Risk Rules - Risk categories, score thresholds, review steps and credit-policy controls can be tailored around the organization’s lending policy.
• Repayment & Payroll - Deduction schedules, repayment visibility and payroll-linked processes can be adapted according to the selected implementation model.
• Finance & Disbursement - Payout approvals, banking checks, batch processing, finance history and related controls can be configured.
• Recovery - Aging bands, collection stages, assignment rules, payment tracking and recovery reporting can be customized.
• Dashboards & Reports - KPIs, analytics, filters, exports and management reports can be adjusted around the information your business needs.
• Integrations - Suitable payroll, banking, payment, identity, credit-data, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
12. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your lending operations instead of forcing every organization into one fixed workflow.
• Role-Based Architecture - Dedicated workspaces keep borrowers and operational teams focused on the information relevant to their responsibilities.
• End-to-End Process Coverage - The platform can support the lending journey from application and verification through assessment, finance and recovery.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout customization and implementation.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The system can evolve with new loan products, policies, roles, reports, workflows and integrations as the organization expands.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
13. FAQ
Can employees apply for a loan from their own portal?
Yes. The User/Employee portal includes an Apply Loan workflow together with loan-status, statement, document and profile access.
Can the system show loan balance and repayment information?
Yes. The borrower dashboard can present current balance, loan status, upcoming deduction information, eligibility and recent activity.
Does the software include HR verification?
Yes. The HR workspace includes verification queues, employee access and activity reporting for employment or eligibility checks.
Can credit teams review risk before approval?
Yes. The Credit workspace includes a credit queue, risk reviews, assessment actions, score visibility and risk-level information where configured.
Can finance manage disbursements?
Yes. Finance users can work with payout queues, bank-detail verification, batch processing, payout history and audit history.
Does the system support management reporting?
Yes. The Management workspace includes analytics, reports, performance indicators, disbursement trends and application-status visibility.
Can overdue accounts be managed?
Yes. Recovery users can work with recovery cases, payment tracking, arrears, aging and priority collections.
Can different departments have different access?
Yes. The platform is structured around separate User, HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery roles, and permissions can be customized.
Can the loan workflow be customized?
Yes. Application fields, products, eligibility rules, approval stages, credit controls, finance workflows, repayment processes and recovery stages can be tailored to project requirements.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
14. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a lending-management platform around your applicants, employees, approvals, credit policy, finance operations, repayments, portfolio analytics and recovery processes.
See the software in action, discuss the roles, workflows and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your lending operation.
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements.

blocks.text: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
INTELLIGENT LOAN MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Manage the Complete Lending Journey from Application to Recovery

A centralized, role-based lending operations platform for employee loan applications, eligibility verification, credit assessment, approvals, disbursements, payroll-linked repayments, management analytics and recovery workflows.
1. Overview
Intelligent Loan Management Software is a centralized, role-based platform designed to help organizations manage the full lending lifecycle from one connected workspace.

It brings borrower self-service, HR verification, application processing, credit assessment, finance operations, portfolio analytics and recovery management together so each team can work within a dedicated portal while management maintains visibility across the complete loan pipeline.
2. Complete Loan Application & Borrower Management
Borrower Dashboard - Give employees or borrowers a clear view of their loan status, current balance, upcoming deduction, eligibility and recent account activity.
Apply New Loan - Provide a structured self-service workflow for submitting new loan applications.
Application Status - Allow users to review the progress and current state of their loan requests from their own portal.
Statements - Keep borrower statements accessible from a dedicated account area.
Letters & Documents - Provide secure access to loan-related letters and documents from the borrower portal.
Settlement & Paid-Up Requests - Support borrower requests for settlement letters, paid-up letters and other configured loan correspondence.
Borrower Profile - Maintain user profile information required for loan servicing and account management.
Recent Activity - Present payment, disbursement and other account activity in a structured history view.
Payroll-Linked Repayment Visibility - Show upcoming payroll deduction information where repayment is connected to the employee payroll process.
3. HR Verification & Employee Eligibility
HR Verification Hub - Give the HR team a dedicated workspace for reviewing verification queues and employee eligibility.
Pending Verification Queue - Keep submitted and HR-pending applications visible so required checks can be completed in an organized sequence.
Employee Directory - Maintain access to employee records required for verification and lending workflows.
Approval & Rejection Tracking - Track verification outcomes and provide management visibility into pending, approved and rejected activity.
Activity Reports - Review HR-related lending activity through a dedicated reporting area.
Queue Management - Use an operational queue to prioritize applications waiting for HR action.
4. Application Operations & Administration
Operations Dashboard - Monitor total applications, pending reviews, approvals and rejections from an administrative overview.
Application Management - Review lending applications as they move through the approval pipeline.
Employee Management - Maintain employee-related records required across lending operations.
Recent Application Activity - See applicant, employer, requested amount and current stage information in one operational view.
Pipeline Health - Monitor approval-rate and processing-velocity indicators to understand workflow performance.
Search & Filtering - Locate employee or application information quickly through operational search and filtering tools.
5. Credit Assessment & Risk Review
Credit Operations Dashboard - Provide credit teams with a dedicated view of assessments waiting in queue, high-risk cases and completed approvals.
Credit Queue - Organize applications that require credit assessment and analyst action.
Risk Reviews - Support structured review of borrower risk before final lending decisions are completed.
Credit Score Visibility - Display applicant credit-score information within the assessment workflow where available.
Risk Classification - Identify cases by risk level so high-priority or higher-risk applications remain visible.
Assessment Workflow - Allow credit personnel to open and process prioritized assessments from their own workspace.
Credit Policy Metrics - Provide credit-performance indicators such as average score and rejection rate for operational monitoring.
6. Finance, Payouts & Disbursement Control
Finance Executive Dashboard - Give the finance team a dedicated view of pending payout value, total disbursed value and failed-payment activity.
Payout Queue - Organize approved loans waiting for finance action and disbursement.
Bank Detail Verification - Support finance checks of beneficiary and bank information before initiating payout.
Batch Processing - Process grouped finance activity through a dedicated batch-processing workflow.
Payout History - Maintain a history of finance and disbursement activity for review.
Audit History - Provide access to finance-related audit history for operational accountability.
Failed Payment Visibility - Keep unsuccessful or failed payment activity visible for follow-up.
7. Management Analytics & Portfolio Visibility
Executive Insights - Present management with a high-level view of lending performance and portfolio activity.
Analytics - Review performance indicators and trends through a dedicated analytics workspace.
Reports - Access management reporting without requiring operational teams to share disconnected spreadsheets.
Revenue Visibility - Monitor total lending-related revenue or configured financial performance measures.
Portfolio Yield - Track portfolio-yield information to support management review of lending performance.
Disbursement Trends - Visualize disbursement movement over time for portfolio monitoring.
Application Status Distribution - Review how applications are distributed across stages such as submitted, HR pending, HR approved and credit pending.
Active Portfolio Visibility - Monitor active customer or borrower portfolio information according to the organization’s configured lending model.
8. Recovery & Collections Management
Recovery Performance Dashboard - Give recovery users a dedicated workspace for assigned accounts, arrears and collection performance.
Recovery Cases - Manage accounts requiring collection or recovery follow-up from one structured module.
Payment Tracking - Track repayment activity and collections against recovery cases.
Portfolio Arrears - Monitor the value of accounts currently in arrears.
Active Recovery Cases - Maintain visibility into the number of accounts requiring ongoing recovery action.
Collection Efficiency - Measure recovery performance over a defined period.
Portfolio Aging - Segment overdue accounts into aging bands to support collection prioritization.
Priority Collections - Surface borrowers and outstanding balances that require focused recovery action.
9. Role-Based Portals

The software supports separate User/Employee, HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery workspaces. Each role can be restricted to the information and actions required for its responsibilities.
User / Employee Portal - Loan Self-Service
Personal Loan Overview - Review active loan status, balance, deductions, eligibility, statements and recent activity.
Self-Service Requests - Apply for loans, check status and access letters or documents without requiring full administrative access.
HR Portal - Verification Control
Employee Verification - Review employment-related eligibility and move applications through the HR verification stage.
HR Reporting - Access employee, queue and activity information relevant to HR responsibilities.
Admin Portal - Operational Control
Application Oversight - Manage applications, employees and pipeline activity across the lending process.
Operational Monitoring - Track application volumes, pending reviews, stages and workflow health.
Credit Portal - Risk & Assessment
Credit Decision Support - Review credit queues, scores, risk classifications and prioritized assessments.
Finance Portal - Disbursement Control
Payout Management - Control approved disbursements, batch processing, history and bank-verification activity.
Management Portal - Executive Intelligence
Portfolio Analytics - Review financial, application and portfolio performance from a management-focused dashboard.
Recovery Portal - Collections Control
Collections Management - Manage overdue accounts, payment tracking, aging and recovery performance from a dedicated workspace.
10. How It Can Help Your Lending Operations Grow
Manage the Full Loan Lifecycle in One System - Centralizing application, verification, credit, finance and recovery activity reduces dependence on separate spreadsheets and disconnected tools.
Improve Processing Visibility - Role-specific queues and dashboards make it easier to see where each application is currently waiting and which team needs to act next.
Deliver Better Borrower Self-Service - Employees can apply, track status, review balances, access statements and request letters from their own portal.
Strengthen Credit Control - Dedicated credit queues, risk reviews and score visibility help keep assessment activity structured and traceable.
Improve Finance Accountability - Payout queues, bank-detail checks, batch processing and audit history give finance teams clearer operational control.
Support Faster Management Decisions - Executive analytics, portfolio yield, application distribution and trend reporting provide a clearer view of lending performance.
Improve Recovery Prioritization - Arrears, aging, active cases and priority collections help recovery teams focus on accounts that need attention.
Scale Across Teams - Separate HR, Admin, Credit, Finance, Management and Recovery workspaces allow the platform to support more structured operations as lending volume grows.

Repayment & Payroll - Deduction schedules, repayment visibility and payroll-linked processes can be adapted according to the selected implementation model.
Finance & Disbursement - Payout approvals, banking checks, batch processing, finance history and related controls can be configured.
Recovery - Aging bands, collection stages, assignment rules, payment tracking and recovery reporting can be customized.
Dashboards & Reports - KPIs, analytics, filters, exports and management reports can be adjusted around the information your business needs.
Integrations - Suitable payroll, banking, payment, identity, credit-data, communication and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.

12. Why Choose Kiaan Technology

Role-Based Architecture - Dedicated workspaces keep borrowers and operational teams focused on the information relevant to their responsibilities.

Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.

Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.

Yes. The borrower dashboard can present current balance, loan status, upcoming deduction information, eligibility and recent activity.

Yes. The HR workspace includes verification queues, employee access and activity reporting for employment or eligibility checks.
Can credit teams review risk before approval?
Yes. The Credit workspace includes a credit queue, risk reviews, assessment actions, score visibility and risk-level information where configured.
Can finance manage disbursements?
Yes. Finance users can work with payout queues, bank-detail verification, batch processing, payout history and audit history.
Does the system support management reporting?
Yes. The Management workspace includes analytics, reports, performance indicators, disbursement trends and application-status visibility.

Yes. Recovery users can work with recovery cases, payment tracking, arrears, aging and priority collections.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
CONTRACTOR PROJECT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
Unified Project, Design, Supply & Site Installation Platform
A role-based platform that connects project managers, CAD designers, material suppliers and site installers in one coordinated workflow—from project planning to final installation.
1. What We Provide
A centralized contractor project management solution designed to improve visibility, coordination and control across projects, design approvals, material procurement, shipping and site installation.
4 User Roles: Senior Project Manager / Admin, Lead Joinery CAD Designer, Material Supplier & Site Operations Lead / Installer
Project Management: All projects, project creation, project timeline, tasks and activities
Design & Drawing Control: All drawings, drawing uploads, revision history and approval status
Supplier & Material Coordination: Suppliers, material orders, supplier status and purchase requests
Purchase & Shipping: Purchase orders, shipment tracking and delivery status
Installation Management: Installation schedule, installation tasks, site progress, final inspection, issues and notes
Site Updates: Photo uploads, daily notes, progress updates and issue reporting
Client Management: Client list, client projects and project visibility
Reports & Cost Control: Project reports, cost tracking and progress reports
Documents & Communication: Project documents, installation drawings, site instructions, comments and messages
Administration & Access: Users & roles, permissions and system settings
Responsive Access: Designed for Desktop, Laptop, Tablet and Mobile devices
Mobile App Availability: Android & iOS versions can be provided according to the selected package and requirements
2. Technology Stack
React.js + Vite — Modern, fast and responsive frontend
Tailwind CSS — Responsive, consistent and modern interface styling
Node.js + Express — Backend APIs and application logic
MySQL — Reliable relational database management
Prisma ORM — Structured and efficient database interaction
3. Role-Based Access
Senior Project Manager / Admin → Complete operational control across projects, drawings, suppliers, purchase orders, shipping, installation, clients, reports, costs, users, permissions and settings.
Lead Joinery CAD Designer → Focused access to assigned projects, tasks, timelines, drawings, uploads, revisions, approval status, project documents, comments and messages.

Material Supplier → Dedicated supplier portal for purchase requests, purchase orders, order history, production status, ready-for-dispatch updates, shipping, delivery, invoices, shipping documents and messages.

Site Operations Lead / Installer → Field-focused access to assigned projects, installation schedules and tasks, final inspection, site photos, daily notes, progress updates, issue reporting, installation drawings and site instructions.
4. Source Code

Source code availability is based on the selected package or license. If source code is included, Kiaan Technology will clearly confirm the applicable package terms before the project or software package is finalized.
5. Customization & Expansion
The software can be tailored to match your company workflow, branding and operational process.
Logo • Branding • UI • Roles • Permissions • Modules • Fields • Reports • Workflows • Integrations
Additional modules, approval flows, project stages, reports, integrations and automation can be developed as your requirements grow.
6. FAQ
Can we customize the software?
Yes. Modules, workflows, fields, reports and features can be customized according to your business requirements.
Is the software mobile and tablet responsive?
Yes. The web system is responsive for desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile screens.
Are Android and iOS app versions available?
Yes. Android and iOS app versions can be provided based on the selected package and requirements.
How are passwords, data and user access secured?

Passwords are protected using secure authentication and password hashing, while role-based permissions restrict every user to authorized modules and actions. Application and database access can also be configured according to deployment security requirements.
Can third-party APIs and AI automation be integrated?
Yes. Third-party APIs, notifications, payment services, AI features and workflow automations can be integrated as required.
Is source code included?
Yes, where included in the selected package/license.
Can we add our branding?
Yes. Logo, name, colors and UI can be customized.
Which technologies are used?
React.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MySQL and Prisma ORM.
Does Kiaan Technology provide technical support?
Yes. Kiaan Technology can provide technical support for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
Can a different technology stack be used?
Yes. We work across full-stack technologies including React Native, WordPress, TypeScript, Java, Python and others based on project requirements.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
ENTERPRISE MANUFACTURING ERP SOFTWARE
Production, Inventory, Warehouse & Quality Management

A centralized manufacturing ERP platform designed to help businesses manage production schedules, batches, recipes, raw materials, finished goods, stock movement, suppliers, purchase orders, sales orders, quality control and warehouse operations from one connected system.
Dedicated Admin, Production Operator and Warehouse Operator workspaces keep day-to-day responsibilities organized while management maintains broader operational visibility.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage
Production Planning & Scheduling - Manage production schedules, planned work and active production activity from a structured manufacturing workflow.
Production Batches - Create and monitor production batches, batch progress, current processing phases and production history.
Recipes & Instructions - Maintain production recipes and give operators access to the instructions required for scheduled batches.
Raw Materials & Inventory - Track raw material SKUs, current stock, low-stock conditions and stock movement across operations.
Finished Goods - Maintain finished-product inventory with quantity, storage location and expiry-date visibility where recorded.
Warehouse & Dispatch - Receive materials, manage finished goods, prepare dispatch orders and record stock adjustments from the warehouse workflow.
Procurement & Sales - Manage suppliers, purchase orders and sales orders within the connected ERP environment.
Quality Control - Support quality checklists and pending QA tasks so production checks remain visible to responsible users.
Reports & Operational Visibility - Review production, stock, orders and business activity through dashboards, reports and available export tools.
Role-Based Access - Admin, Production Operator and Warehouse Operator users work from dedicated dashboards and menus aligned with their responsibilities.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides dedicated workspaces for key manufacturing roles, helping each user focus on the information and actions required for their day-to-day work.
Admin - Complete Manufacturing Oversight
Designed for broad control of production, inventory, procurement, sales, quality and system administration.
Operations Dashboard - Monitor today's production, current orders, low-stock items and inventory value from one management view.
Production Control - Access production schedules, production batches, recipes and manufacturing activity.
Inventory & Products - Manage raw materials, finished products and stock movements across the operation.
Purchasing & Sales - Maintain suppliers, purchase orders and sales orders from the ERP workspace.
Quality & Reporting - Access quality control, reports and operational performance information.
User & System Administration - Manage users, settings and other administrative configuration available within the platform.
Quick Actions - Create production batches, add materials and generate reports directly from the dashboard.
Production Operator - Shop-Floor Production Control
A focused workspace for operators to follow assigned production work, batches and quality tasks during their shift.
Shift Dashboard - View scheduled batches, active production line information and the current shift window.
Running Batch Visibility - Monitor the active batch, batch progress and the current processing phase.
Today's Production - Review production planned for the current working day.
Recipe Instructions - Access recipe and production instructions needed for assigned batches.
Quality Checklist - Complete or review quality-related checks associated with production activity.
Production History - Review historical production activity relevant to the operator workflow.
Warehouse Operator - Inventory & Dispatch Control
A dedicated warehouse workspace for material receipt, stock visibility, finished goods and dispatch preparation.
Receive Materials - Record incoming raw materials into the warehouse workflow.
Inventory Stock - Review tracked raw-material stock and current inventory availability.
Low-Stock Visibility - Identify materials that require replenishment or procurement follow-up.
Finished Goods - Review finished-goods quantities, locations and expiry information where maintained.
Dispatch Orders - Track pending dispatch orders and prepare goods for shipment.
Stock Adjustment - Record authorized inventory adjustments to keep stock information aligned with operations.
3. How It Helps Your Manufacturing Business
Centralize Daily Operations - Bring production, materials, finished goods, purchasing, sales, quality and warehouse activity into one organized system.
Improve Production Visibility - Production schedules, batch progress and active processing phases help teams understand what is planned, running and awaiting action.
Strengthen Inventory Control - Raw-material stock, low-stock alerts, finished-goods quantities and stock movements provide clearer inventory visibility.
Reduce Production Delays - Early visibility of low-stock items and pending quality tasks can help teams identify issues that may affect production continuity.
Improve Warehouse Coordination - Receiving, inventory, finished goods, dispatch orders and adjustments are organized within a dedicated warehouse workflow.
Support Quality Processes - Quality checklists and QA task visibility help keep production checks connected to daily manufacturing activity.
Improve Team Accountability - Role-based workspaces help Admin, Production and Warehouse teams focus on the tasks and information relevant to their responsibilities.
Support Business Growth - A structured ERP workflow can scale with additional products, materials, orders, users, processes and reporting requirements as operations grow.
4. Technology Stack
React.js - Modern responsive user interface for desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile-friendly access.
Vite - Fast frontend development and optimized application build tooling.
Node.js + Express - Backend services and APIs for manufacturing, inventory, warehouse and business workflows.
MySQL - Structured relational database management for operational and business data.
Prisma ORM - Database interaction layer for structured and maintainable application data access.
Alternative technology stacks can also be discussed based on project requirements, integration needs and deployment architecture.
5. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be adapted around the way your manufacturing business operates, allowing the platform to match your branding, production workflow, inventory structure and internal responsibilities.
Branding - Logo, software name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
Modules & Features - Existing modules can be adjusted and additional manufacturing or business modules can be developed based on project requirements.
Roles & Permissions - Admin, Production, Warehouse and additional user roles can be adapted with controlled module and data access.
Production Workflows - Batch stages, production schedules, processing phases, recipe structures and quality workflows can be modified to suit the required process.
Inventory & Warehouse - Material fields, stock rules, warehouse locations, adjustments, finished-goods workflows and dispatch processes can be tailored.
Procurement & Sales - Supplier, purchase-order and sales-order fields and processes can be adjusted to match the business workflow.
Forms, Fields & Reports - Forms, data fields, dashboard KPIs, reports and exports can be modified or extended as required.
Integrations - Suitable accounting, logistics, messaging, payment or other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Automation - Automated alerts, workflow actions and other business automations can be developed around the agreed use case.
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
6. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
Built Around Your Requirements - The platform can be adapted around your actual manufacturing workflow instead of forcing the business into a fixed one-size-fits-all process.
Role-Based Product Structure - Dedicated Admin, Production Operator and Warehouse Operator experiences keep responsibilities organized and access controlled.
Business-Focused Development - The system is designed to make production, inventory and warehouse operations easier to manage while improving management visibility.
Scalable Customization - Start from the existing ERP and expand modules, workflows, reports, roles and integrations as requirements evolve.
