Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization, with regular progress updates.
Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
7. FAQ
Can the software manage production, inventory and warehouse operations in one system?

Yes. The platform brings production schedules, batches, raw materials, finished goods, stock movement, warehouse activity, purchasing, sales and quality-related workflows into one connected ERP environment.
Can different teams have separate access?
Yes. The demonstrated system includes dedicated Admin, Production Operator and Warehouse Operator workspaces, and role permissions can be adapted according to the required organizational structure.

Yes. The warehouse workflow provides visibility into raw-material stock, low-stock alerts, finished-goods quantities, storage locations, expiry information where recorded, and pending dispatch orders.
Can the software be customized for our manufacturing process?
Yes. Branding, modules, roles, permissions, production workflows, inventory fields, forms, reports and other processes can be customized according to project requirements.
Is the data secure?

Kiaan Technology develops the software with authenticated login, role-based access and secure password handling so users can access only the information and functions appropriate to their role. Additional hosting, backup, audit, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Can third-party systems be integrated?
Suitable accounting, logistics, payment, messaging and other services can be integrated where required and supported by the selected providers.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where it is included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. Kiaan Technology maintains transparent communication and provides regular progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
BUSINESS ACCOUNTING, INVENTORY &GST MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Billing, Stock, Accounts, GST & SaaS Company Management in One Platform
A complete business-management solution for inventory, POS billing, invoicing, accounting, GST reporting, audit logs and multi-company SaaS administration.
1. Overview

Business Accounting, Inventory & GST Management Software is a centralized digital platform designed for companies that want to manage billing, stock, accounts, purchase and sales activity, GST reporting and day-to-day financial operations from one secure workspace.

The platform combines company-level business operations with a separate Super Admin SaaS console for company onboarding, subscriptions and global settings, making it suitable for both individual businesses and scalable multi-company software deployments.
2. Core Business Management Features
• Inventory Management - Track stock, batches and low-stock conditions while keeping inventory activity organized for day-to-day operations.
• POS Billing - Support fast billing workflows with barcode-scanning and thermal-printing capabilities shown in the product feature set.
• Bill Book - Maintain sales and purchase invoice history in one structured billing area.
• Accounts Management - Track double-entry ledgers and daily cash-balance activity for clearer financial control.
• Account Summary - View consolidated account information across cash, bank and overall balances.
• Inventory Summary - Review inventory from category, brand and item-level summary views.
• Final Accounts - Access final-account reporting, including Trading and Profit & Loss-related financial views.
• GST Reports - Support GST reporting workflows with GSTR summary and filing-oriented report access, including GSTR-1, GSTR-2 and GSTR-3B references shown in the platform.
• Audit Logs - Maintain visibility of user activity and audited entries for stronger operational traceability.
• Multi-Language Support - Provide access in English, Hindi and other regional-language configurations where supported.
• Day Book Summary - View daily transaction summaries covering business activity such as sales and expenses.
• Expiry Report - Track stock-expiry information and alerts for items that require timely attention.
3. Company Admin Workspace
The Company Admin portal is the main operating workspace for a registered business and brings key financial, stock and billing information into one dashboard.
• Today's Sale - See current-day sales activity from the dashboard and move quickly into related details.
• Today Purchase - Monitor current-day purchase activity.
• Current Stock Status - View the current inventory position from the dashboard.
• Today's Expenses - Track current-day business expenses.
• Customer Outstanding - Monitor amounts receivable from customers.
• Company Outstanding - Track outstanding amounts associated with company-side obligations or balances.
• All Accounts Balance - View a consolidated account-balance indicator.
• Recycle Bin - Access deleted or recoverable records through a dedicated recycle-bin area.
• Sales Trend - Review sales performance over selectable periods such as 30 days or 12 months.
• Masters - Maintain the master data required for business operations.
• Inventory - Manage stock and inventory records.
• POS Billing - Run point-of-sale billing workflows.
• Bill Book - Access sales and purchase invoice history.
• Account, Account Summary & Final Accounts - Work with day-to-day accounting, account summaries and final financial reporting.
• GSTR's Summary - Access GST-related reporting and summary workflows.
• Tools, Audit Logs & Settings - Use operational tools, review activity logs and configure company settings.
4. Productivity Shortcuts for Faster Daily Work
The company workspace includes keyboard-driven shortcuts designed to reduce repetitive navigation during regular accounting and billing work.
• Global Search - Quickly search across the application.
• Credit Invoice - Open credit-invoice workflows directly.
• Cash Invoice - Launch cash-invoice entry with a shortcut.
• Purchase Invoice - Open purchase-invoice entry quickly.
• Stock Details - Jump directly to stock information.
• Expense & Income Ledgers - Open expense-ledger and income-ledger views from dedicated shortcuts.
• Customer & Company Ledgers - Access customer and company ledger information quickly.
• Complaint Details - Open complaint-detail workflows directly where required.
5. Super Admin SaaS Management
A separate Super Admin console provides platform-level control for managing companies, subscriptions and SaaS-wide settings.
• SaaS Dashboard - Monitor total active companies, monthly recurring revenue, active subscriptions and inactive subscriptions.
• Companies - Manage registered business companies from one platform-level area.
• Subscriptions - Manage company subscription access and plan status.
• Recently Onboarded Companies - Review newly registered companies from the Super Admin dashboard.
• Global Settings - Maintain platform-wide configuration separate from individual company settings.
• Company Registration - Allow new businesses to create a company account with administrator details.
• Role-Based Login - Provide separate Company Admin and Super Admin login paths for controlled access.
• Plan-Based SaaS Model - Support different subscription-plan structures for businesses of different sizes, with plan customization available at the SaaS level.
6. How It Can Help Your Business Grow
• Reduce Manual Accounting Work - Bring sales, purchases, expenses, ledgers, billing and summaries into one system instead of maintaining disconnected records.
• Improve Inventory Control - Stock summaries, low-stock visibility, batches and expiry reporting help teams understand inventory conditions faster.
• Speed Up Billing - POS billing, invoice shortcuts and barcode-ready workflows can reduce time spent on repetitive billing tasks.
• Improve Cash-Flow Visibility - Customer outstanding, company outstanding, account balances and day-book summaries provide clearer day-to-day financial visibility.
• Support GST Compliance Workflows - GST summaries and GSTR-oriented reporting keep compliance-related information organized in the same platform as operational accounting.
• Improve Business Decision-Making - Account summaries, final accounts, sales trends and inventory summaries give management a clearer view of performance.
• Keep Business Data Organized - Centralized invoices, ledgers, inventory records, GST reports and audit logs reduce scattered data and make information easier to review.
• Support Multi-Company SaaS Growth - The Super Admin console allows the platform to onboard companies, manage subscriptions and scale a recurring SaaS business model.
• Offer Flexible Plans - Plan-based access lets the software be positioned for startups, growing businesses and enterprise customers.
7. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be customized around your business type, accounting process, inventory structure, GST workflow, billing process and SaaS subscription model.
• Branding - Logo, software name, colors and interface styling can be customized.
• Company Structure - Company profiles, branches, business fields and onboarding information can be adjusted according to requirements.
• Billing & Invoice Workflow - Invoice fields, billing steps, print formats and payment-related workflows can be tailored.
• Inventory - Item fields, stock categories, batches, reorder rules, expiry logic and reporting can be customized.
• Accounts & Ledgers - Accounting fields, ledger structures, chart of accounts and financial summaries can be adapted to the business process.
• GST & Tax Reports - GST-related reports, fields and tax settings can be configured according to applicable project requirements.
• Roles & Permissions - User access, company administration and additional roles can be configured according to the team structure.
• SaaS Plans & Subscriptions - Plan limits, company access and subscription structures can be tailored for the commercial model.
• Reports & Dashboards - KPIs, summaries, exports and management reports can be modified around the information your business needs.
• Integrations - Suitable payment, accounting, communication, barcode, tax or other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance and further development.
8. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual accounting, inventory, billing and business workflows instead of forcing every company into the same fixed setup.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates so you can see what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The platform can evolve with new companies, modules, reports, roles, subscription plans and integrations as your business grows.
• Business & SaaS in One Solution - The system combines company-level accounting operations with global SaaS administration for broader commercial flexibility.
• Organized & Controlled Access - Company-level and Super Admin access help separate daily business operations from platform-wide administration.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
9. Frequently Asked Questions
Can the software manage inventory and billing together?
Yes. The platform includes Inventory, POS Billing, Bill Book and inventory-summary workflows in one system.
Does it support GST reporting?
Yes. GST reporting is part of the platform through GSTR summary and GST-reporting workflows.
Can we manage sales, purchases and expenses?
Yes. The Company Admin dashboard includes sales, purchase and expense visibility, supported by billing, ledger and accounting modules.
Can we track customer outstanding balances?
Yes. Customer Outstanding and account-related views are included in the company dashboard and accounting workflow.
Does the software include final accounts?
Yes. Final Accounts is available as a dedicated module, along with account summaries and related financial reporting.
Can stock expiry be tracked?
Yes. The product feature set includes an Expiry Report for tracking upcoming stock-expiry conditions.
Does it support audit logs?
Yes. A dedicated Audit Logs module is included for user-activity and audited-entry visibility.
Can this be offered as SaaS to multiple companies?
Yes. The Super Admin console includes company management, subscriptions, recurring-revenue visibility and global settings.
Can subscription plans be customized?
Yes. The SaaS structure supports plan-based access, and plan configuration can be customized according to the commercial model.
Can the software be customized?
Yes. Branding, modules, workflows, reports, roles, inventory fields, billing processes and SaaS plans can be customized according to project requirements.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. We maintain transparent communication and provide regular project progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
10. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a business accounting and inventory platform around your billing process, GST requirements, stock workflow, financial reporting and SaaS growth model.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your business.
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
ENTERPRISE BUSINESS ERP SOFTWARE
Sales, Inventory, Purchase, Accounting & Operations Management

A centralized enterprise ERP platform designed to help businesses manage sales orders, customers, invoices, products, stock movement, purchasing, vendors, accounting, payments, taxes, packing, shipping, marketplace synchronization and operational reporting from one connected system.

Dedicated Super Admin, Sales Manager, Inventory Manager, Purchase Manager, Accountant and Operations Staff workspaces keep responsibilities organized while management maintains broader business visibility.

Sales Orders & Customers - Create and monitor sales orders, maintain customer records and review order activity from a structured sales workflow.
Invoices & Revenue Visibility - Track invoices, unpaid amounts, monthly revenue and other sales-related financial activity.
Products & Inventory - Maintain products and SKUs, review active stock levels and monitor current inventory availability.
Stock Movement & Low Stock - Track stock movements, minimum required quantities and low-stock or critical-stock conditions.
Purchasing & Vendors - Manage purchase orders, vendors, vendor bills and procurement activity from one connected purchasing workflow.
Accounting & Finance - Maintain chart of accounts, payments, taxes, reconciliation and profit-related reporting within the ERP environment.
Packing & Shipping - Organize packing queues, shipping queues, delivery issues and fulfillment-related operational activity.
Marketplace & Connector Sync - Support connected commerce workflows with marketplace synchronization such as Amazon SP-API, Mercado Libre and WooCommerce where configured.
Reports & Export Tools - Review sales, inventory, profit and operational information through dashboards, reports and available export actions.
Role-Based Access - Different business teams work from dedicated dashboards and menus aligned with their responsibilities.

Super Admin - Complete Enterprise Oversight
Designed for broad control of sales, inventory, purchasing, accounting, operations, reports, connectors and user access.
Operations Center - Monitor today's orders, pending deliveries, active stock items and unpaid invoices from one management view.
Sales & Customer Control - Access sales orders, customer records and invoice-related workflows.
Inventory Management - Manage products, stock moves and low-stock conditions across the organization.
Purchase Management - Access purchase orders, vendors and vendor bills.
Accounting & Reporting - Review accounting areas, reports and profit-related business information.
Connectors & Users - Manage connector settings, users, roles and other available administrative configuration.
Quick Actions & Sync - Use available actions for product creation, order creation, synchronization and report downloads.
Sales Manager - Sales Performance & Order Management
A focused sales workspace for monitoring orders, customers, revenue, delivery activity and conversion performance.
Sales Dashboard - Review today's orders, month-to-date revenue, pending deliveries and conversion rate.
Recent Orders - Monitor order IDs, customers, sales channels, totals and order statuses.
Top Customers - Identify high-value customers and review order contribution.
Order Creation & Export - Create new orders and export available sales information.
Inventory Manager - Stock & Warehouse Visibility
A dedicated inventory workspace for product stock, movements, low-stock alerts and shipment visibility.
Inventory Dashboard - Review total products, low-stock items, pending shipments and warehouse utilization.
Active Stock Levels - Monitor SKU, product, current stock, minimum required quantity and stock status.
Recent Movements - Review stock additions and deductions recorded against products.
Inventory Actions - Access products, stock moves, low-stock views, exports and product creation.
Purchase Manager - Vendor & Procurement Control
A purchasing workspace focused on suppliers, purchase orders, vendor bills and procurement performance.
Purchase Dashboard - Review active vendors, open purchase orders, pending bills and monthly procurement.
Recent Purchase Orders - Monitor vendors, purchase totals, status and order dates.
Vendor Bills - Track due-soon, pending and overdue supplier bills.
Purchase Actions - Create purchase orders, maintain vendors and export available purchasing information.
Accountant - Finance, Payments & Reconciliation
A finance workspace for revenue, payment, tax and reconciliation visibility.
Finance Dashboard - Review month-to-date revenue, outstanding payments, tax liability and reconciliation percentage.
Accounting Structure - Access chart of accounts, payments, taxes and reconciliation.
Recent Payments - Review customer and vendor payments together with amount and status.
Unpaid Invoices - Monitor pending and overdue customer invoices.
Financial Export - Export available profit-and-loss information for management review.
Operations Staff - Packing, Shipping & Fulfillment
A fulfillment workspace for daily packing, shipping and delivery-related activity.
Operations Dashboard - Review orders to pack, orders to ship, delivery issues and failed synchronization alerts.
Packing Queue - Prioritize orders waiting to be packed, including priority visibility.
Shipping Queue - Review orders prepared for carriers and shipment status information.
Order Alerts - Keep operational issues visible so fulfillment teams can follow up quickly.
3. How It Helps Your Business
Centralize Daily Operations - Bring sales, inventory, purchasing, finance, fulfillment and reporting into one organized ERP environment.
Improve Sales Visibility - Order totals, revenue, conversion rate, customer performance and delivery status provide clearer commercial visibility.
Strengthen Inventory Control - Stock levels, minimum quantities, low-stock alerts and movement history help teams monitor product availability.
Improve Procurement Control - Vendor, purchase-order and vendor-bill visibility helps purchasing teams coordinate supply activity.
Improve Financial Visibility - Revenue, outstanding payments, tax liability, reconciliation and unpaid invoices give finance teams a clearer operational view.
Streamline Fulfillment - Packing and shipping queues help operations staff organize orders awaiting dispatch.
Support Multi-Channel Commerce - Marketplace connectors can help synchronize order-related activity across connected sales channels.
Improve Team Accountability - Role-based dashboards help each team focus on the tasks and information relevant to its responsibilities.
Support Business Growth - A structured ERP workflow can expand with additional products, users, channels, reports, automations and integrations as the business grows.

React.js - Modern responsive frontend interface for desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile-friendly access.
Vite - Fast frontend development and optimized application build tooling.
Node.js + Express - Backend services and APIs for sales, inventory, purchasing, accounting and operational workflows.
MySQL - Structured relational database management for operational and business data.
Prisma ORM - Database interaction layer for structured and maintainable application data access.

AI & Automation - AI-assisted features, intelligent workflows, automated alerts, data assistance and other business automations can be developed around the agreed use case.

238.subtitle: Enterprise Operations, Role-Based Access, Workflow Automation & Real-Time Analytics
rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
IMMIGRATION CASE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Enterprise Operations, Role-Based Access, Workflow Automation & Real-Time Analytics

A comprehensive, enterprise-grade Immigration Case Management Software engineered for scalable operations, role-based workflows, automated administration, and real-time visibility in Legal / Case / Compliance Software.

Specialized legal platform for immigration attorneys and visa consultants managing EB-2 NIW, work permits, petition dossiers, and USCIS milestones. The platform combines modern responsive interfaces with high-performance backend infrastructure to streamline workflows, eliminate manual overhead, and accelerate operational growth.
1. Core Platform Modules & Functional Capabilities
The platform delivers a centralized operational architecture configured for modern enterprise requirements:
• EB-2 NIW & Visa Petition Stages: Automated operational workflow engine designed for high throughput, data consistency, and streamlined team execution.
• Client Evidence & Document Vault: Automated operational workflow engine designed for high throughput, data consistency, and streamlined team execution.
• USCIS Receipt & Deadline Tracking: Automated operational workflow engine designed for high throughput, data consistency, and streamlined team execution.
• Petition Workflow & Milestones: Step-by-step case tracking from preliminary evaluation and labor certification to USCIS filing and final green card adjudication.
• Role-Based Security & Permissions: Fine-grained access control ensuring data isolation, role authorization, and complete administrative audit logs.
• Automated Document & Receipt Generation: One-click export of GST-compliant invoices, confirmation slips, operational vouchers, and branded PDF summaries.
• Real-Time Notification Engine: Instant status alerts and milestone updates dispatched via WhatsApp, SMS, and transactional email gateways.
• Search, Filter & Bulk Operations: Advanced multi-criteria indexing, rapid data retrieval, batch updates, and custom export routines in Excel/CSV.
• Comprehensive BI Analytics & Reporting: Executive dashboards visualizing key performance metrics, operational trends, and revenue attribution.
2. Technology Stack & Enterprise Architecture
• Frontend Architecture: React, Tailwind CSS — Ultra-fast, component-driven client interface with responsive styling and fluid animations.
• Backend Engine: Node.js — Scalable RESTful API services handling business logic, queues, validation, and concurrent processing.
• Database Layer: MongoDB — High-availability relational and document storage with automated indexing, ACID integrity, and daily snapshots.
• Cloud Infrastructure: AWS — Containerized hosting with automated SSL encryption, global CDN delivery, and 99.9% uptime SLA.
• Ecosystem Integrations: Payment Gateway, WhatsApp API — Seamless webhooks, payment processing, third-party logistics, and omnichannel communications.
3. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
• Super Admin / Executive: Unrestricted system governance, organizational settings, user provisioning, revenue dashboards, and audit logs.
• Operations Manager: Workflow oversight, shift and roster scheduling, approval queues, inventory allocations, and department reporting.
• Front-Line Staff / Specialist: Daily operational task execution, transaction logging, customer service, and status updates.
• Customer / Client Portal: Self-service portal for appointment booking, order tracking, invoice downloads, and direct inquiry messaging.
4. Source Code & Intellectual Property

Full proprietary source code ownership is delivered with applicable enterprise licensing, empowering private cloud hosting, strict compliance audits, independent customization, and continuous internal evolution.
5. Customization & White-Label Capabilities
Tailor every element of the software to reflect your organizational identity:
• Brand Customization: Corporate logos, tailored color palettes, custom typography, and custom domain mapping.
• Workflow Customization: Custom intake fields, configurable approval stages, dynamic forms, and event automation rules.
• Integration Customization: Direct connections with existing ERPs, legacy CRMs, biometric hardware, and specialized third-party APIs.
• Custom Reporting & BI: Tailored executive KPI dashboards, automated financial statements, and custom scheduled data exports.
6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Can the software workflows and fields be modified to match our business?
Yes. The platform is modularly architected, allowing custom fields, operational stages, user permissions, and document layouts to be tailored to your requirements.
Is the platform fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens?
Yes. The web application is engineered with a mobile-first responsive layout, delivering an intuitive user experience across smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers.
Are native Android and iOS mobile applications available?
Yes. Dedicated Android and iOS mobile applications can be deployed alongside the platform according to your package and project specifications.
How is sensitive organizational and customer data protected?
The software implements bank-grade security protocols including TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, AES-256 encryption at rest, role-based authorization, and automated daily backups.
Can we migrate our existing customer data and transaction history?
Yes. We provide automated bulk migration tools and custom ETL scripts to securely transfer existing records from Excel, CSV, or legacy SQL databases.
What ongoing technical support and maintenance SLA is provided?
Enterprise plans include regular version updates, continuous security monitoring, cloud database management, and responsive technical helpdesk support.
7. Operational Implementation & How It Works

Can the software workflows and fields be modified to match our business?

Is the platform fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens?

Are native Android and iOS mobile applications available?
Yes. Dedicated Android and iOS mobile applications can be deployed alongside the platform according to your package and project specifications.

The software implements bank-grade security protocols including TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, AES-256 encryption at rest, role-based authorization, and automated daily backups.

Enterprise plans include regular version updates, continuous security monitoring, cloud database management, and responsive technical helpdesk support.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
STUDENT VISA MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Student Recruitment, Inquiry, Applications, Visa Processing & Counselor Management in One Platform

A complete digital solution for education consultants, student-recruitment teams and visa-processing businesses to manage inquiries, students, applications, follow-ups, payments and visa workflows from one centralized system.
1. Overview

Student Visa Management Software is a centralized platform designed to organize the complete student recruitment and visa-processing journey from the first inquiry through application and visa follow-up. It helps education consultants and recruitment teams keep student information, counselor activity, application progress, communication, payments and operational tasks in one structured workspace.

The platform supports a detailed inquiry profile, dashboard analytics, lead and student management, application workflows, task management, role-based access, payments and invoices, and a dedicated visa-processing list. It can also be customized around the organization's countries, branches, counselors, intakes, services and internal processes.
2. Core Student Recruitment & Visa Management Features
• Dashboard & Analytics - Monitor total leads, total students, counselors, universities, tasks and inquiries from one management dashboard.
• Lead & Inquiry Management - Capture inquiries, convert qualified prospects into leads, assign responsibility and track progress through the recruitment funnel.
• Student Management - Maintain structured student profiles, academic history, program interests, contact details and ongoing recruitment status.
• Applications - Organize student applications and track their progress through institution and internal processing stages.
• Visa Processing List - Maintain a dedicated operational view for students moving through visa-related processing and follow-up stages.
• Task Management - Create and track follow-up tasks so counselors and operations staff can manage pending actions and deadlines.
• Roles & Permissions - Control access according to user responsibility so counselors, managers, finance users and administrators see the appropriate information.
• Payments & Invoices - Maintain payment and invoice workflows related to student services, application processing or consulting fees according to the configured business process.
• University & Program Tracking - Organize the countries, universities, programs, study levels, fields and intakes used during counseling and application processing.
• Search & Filters - Filter operational data by date, country, counselor, status, intake and lead source for faster review and reporting.
3. Detailed Inquiry & Student Profile Management
The inquiry form can collect detailed student information at the beginning of the recruitment process so counselors do not need to maintain disconnected spreadsheets, forms or chat notes.
• Inquiry Classification - Record inquiry type, source, branch and priority for structured lead handling.
• Personal Information - Capture full name, phone number, email address, interested country, city, date of birth and gender.
• Academic Background - Maintain highest education level, board or university name and medium of instruction.
• Course & Program Information - Record the interested course or program, preferred study level, study field, intake and estimated first-year budget.
• English Proficiency - Maintain the selected English-language test type and related information according to project requirements.
• Work History - Record company name, job title, duration and study-gap information where relevant to the student profile.
• Visa History - Capture whether a previous visa was refused and record the reason where applicable.
• Address Information - Maintain permanent and present address details in the same student record.
• Inquiry Notes & Consent - Record inquiry date, additional counselor notes and confirmation/consent information.
4. Application & Visa Processing Workflow
• Inquiry to Lead - Create a structured inquiry, assign a counselor and move suitable prospects into the active lead pipeline.
• Lead to Student - Convert qualified leads into student records while retaining their recruitment history and key information.
• Counseling & Program Selection - Track preferred countries, universities, courses, study levels, intakes and budget requirements.
• Application Management - Organize application activity and maintain visibility of current application status and pending actions.
• Document Follow-Up - Use tasks, notes and configurable document workflows to keep required student or application documents organized.
• Visa Processing - Move students into a dedicated visa-processing workflow and track the operational status until completion.
• Payment & Invoice Follow-Up - Record applicable fees, invoice activity and payment status within the same business system.
• History & Traceability - Keep activity, task and status information centralized so management can review progress without relying on separate records.
5. Dashboard, Analytics & Reporting
• Conversion Funnel - View the movement from inquiries to leads, students and applicants for clearer conversion visibility.
• Lead Conversion Growth - Compare current and previous conversion performance to monitor recruitment effectiveness.
• Top Performing Counselors - Review counselor performance using conversion-oriented statistics and management reporting.
• Country Distribution - Analyze student or lead distribution by destination country.
• Inquiry Heatmap / Timeline - Review inquiry volume across days or selected time periods to understand lead activity patterns.
• Advanced Filters - Filter dashboard information by date range, country, counselor, status, intake and lead source.
• Custom Reports - Additional management, counselor, application, payment and visa reports can be developed according to client requirements.
6. Role-Based Access & Team Productivity
• Platform / System Admin - Manage global configuration, users, permissions, modules and platform-level settings.
• Counselor Access - Allow counselors to work with assigned inquiries, leads, students, follow-ups and applications according to permissions.
• Manager Access - Provide management visibility across teams, counselor performance, applications, tasks and operational reports.
• Finance Access - Restrict payment and invoice information to authorized users where the business requires financial separation.
• Custom Roles - Additional roles and permission levels can be configured based on branches, departments and actual staff responsibilities.
7. AI & Third-Party API Integration
The platform can be extended with suitable AI features and external services according to the selected project scope and provider availability.
• AI Lead Assistance - AI can be integrated for inquiry classification, lead scoring, counselor suggestions or follow-up prioritization where required.
• AI Chat or Assistant - An AI-assisted help or counseling interface can be added for common student questions, internal staff support or knowledge-based responses.
• Document Assistance - AI can be used for document summarization, checklist assistance or data-extraction workflows where technically suitable and approved.
• Communication APIs - Email, SMS, WhatsApp or other communication services can be integrated for notifications and follow-up workflows.
• Payment Gateways - Suitable payment providers can be integrated for online fee or invoice payments based on the selected country and provider.
• Other Third-Party Systems - CRM, accounting, identity, document, calendar or other supported APIs can be connected where required by the project architecture.
8. Technical Stack, Mobile Apps & Development Options
Our primary full-stack development approach for this type of platform uses modern web technologies that support scalable frontend, backend and database development.
• Frontend - React.js for responsive, component-based web application interfaces.
• Backend - Node.js with Express.js for API development and business logic.
• ORM - Prisma ORM for structured database access and maintainable data models.
• Database - MySQL for relational data storage and operational reporting.
• Full-Stack Development - Frontend, backend, database, authentication, role-based permissions, integrations and deployment can be handled as one coordinated development scope.
• Android & iOS Applications - Mobile applications can be developed as an add-on for Android and iOS according to the required user journeys and project scope.
• Alternative Technologies - When client requirements call for a different technology, development can also be planned using React Native, Java, Python or other suitable technologies.
9. Security & Secure Data Handling

The system is designed to keep business and student information organized behind authenticated access and role-based permissions. Sensitive operational information can be restricted according to user responsibilities, helping prevent unnecessary access across teams.
• Authenticated Access - Login-based access can be used to control entry into the platform.
• Role-Based Permissions - Users can be limited to the modules and actions required for their role.
• Secure Data Architecture - Database access, API permissions and deployment architecture can be configured to support secure handling of student and business records.

• Additional Security Controls - Hosting, backups, audit logs, encryption, monitoring and deployment-level controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture and hosting environment.
10. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements
The software can be adapted around your actual student recruitment, counseling, admissions and visa-processing workflow instead of forcing your organization into one fixed operating model.
• Branding - Software name, logo, interface text and visual identity can be customized for your business.
• Inquiry Fields - Inquiry forms, student fields, source lists, priorities, branches and required information can be modified.
• Countries, Universities & Programs - Destination countries, institutions, courses, study levels and intakes can be configured according to your market.
• Lead & Student Workflows - Statuses, stages, conversion rules, assignments and follow-up processes can be customized.
• Application & Visa Stages - Application stages, document checkpoints, visa-processing statuses and internal approvals can be adapted to your process.
• Roles & Permissions - Counselor, branch manager, finance, application, visa and admin roles can be configured according to your team structure.
• Payments & Invoices - Fee types, invoice formats, payment workflows and financial permissions can be tailored.
• Reports & Dashboards - KPIs, filters, reports and management views can be changed according to the information your business needs.
• Mobile & Integrations - Android/iOS applications, AI functions and suitable third-party APIs can be added where required.
Source code options are available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
11. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
• Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual student-recruitment and visa-processing workflow rather than forcing every consultancy into the same fixed process.
• Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
• Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates showing what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
• Full-Stack Capability - Frontend, backend, database, APIs, authentication, permissions and deployment can be handled within one coordinated development process.
• Growth-Focused Customization - The platform can evolve with new branches, countries, counselors, roles, application stages, reports, AI functions and integrations as the business grows.
• Organized & Controlled Access - Role-based permissions help keep student, application and financial information available to the appropriate team members.
• Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
• Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
12. Technical Support & Future Enhancements

Kiaan Technology can provide technical assistance according to the selected package, including deployment support, troubleshooting, maintenance, bug fixes, version updates and future feature development. As business requirements change, new modules, reports, workflows, AI features, mobile applications and integrations can be planned as additional development scope.
13. FAQ
Can this software manage the complete student inquiry-to-visa workflow?
Yes. The platform can manage inquiries, leads, student profiles, applications, tasks, payments and a dedicated visa-processing workflow in one centralized system.
Can the software be customized?

Yes. Branding, fields, countries, universities, courses, statuses, application stages, visa workflows, roles, reports, payments, mobile apps and integrations can be customized according to project requirements.
Is the data secure?

The current system uses authenticated login and role-based access. Additional hosting, backup, audit, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Can third-party systems be integrated?
Suitable payment gateways, messaging, email, CRM, accounting, document, identity and other services can be integrated where required and supported by the selected providers.
Can Android and iOS applications be developed?
Yes. Android and iOS applications can be developed as part of the project scope, including cross-platform development where appropriate.
Is source code included?
Source code is available where it is included in the selected package or license.
Will we receive regular project updates?
Yes. Kiaan Technology maintains transparent communication and provides regular progress updates during development and customization work.
Does Kiaan Technology provide support after delivery?
Support can be provided for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
14. Book a Demo / Get a Quote
Build a Student Visa Management Platform around your counselors, students, destination countries, applications, visa-processing workflow and reporting requirements.
See the software in action, discuss the modules and customizations you need, and receive a project-specific proposal for your education consultancy or student-recruitment business.
Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your requirements.

A centralized construction management system designed to simplify project execution, site operations, workforce coordination, documentation and financial administration.

Project Operations: Projects/jobs, tasks, team collaboration and project communication

Site Documentation: Drawings, photos, equipment records and RFI management

Responsive Access: Optimized for Desktop, Laptop, Tablet and Mobile

Node.js + Express — Backend APIs and business logic
MySQL — Reliable relational database management
Prisma ORM — Structured and efficient database access

Yes. The web system is responsive for desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile screens.

Passwords are protected using secure authentication and password hashing, while role-based permissions restrict every user to authorized modules and actions. Application and database access can also be configured according to deployment security requirements.
Can third-party APIs and AI automation be integrated?
Yes. Third-party APIs, notifications, payment services, AI features and workflow automations can be integrated as required.

Yes, where included in the selected package/license.

Yes. Logo, name, colors and UI can be customized.

React.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MySQL and Prisma ORM.

Can a different technology stack be used?
Yes. We work across full-stack technologies including React Native, WordPress, TypeScript, Java, Python and others based on project requirements.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
TYRE SHOP & SERVICE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Enterprise Operations, Role-Based Access, Workflow Automation & Real-Time Analytics

A comprehensive, enterprise-grade Tyre Shop & Service Management Software engineered for scalable operations, role-based workflows, automated administration, and real-time visibility in Construction / Workshop / Maintenance.

Specialized tyre dealership and fitment center software for tyre size catalogs, wheel alignment job cards, and manufacturer warranty tracking. The platform combines modern responsive interfaces with high-performance backend infrastructure to streamline workflows, eliminate manual overhead, and accelerate operational growth.
1. Core Platform Modules & Functional Capabilities
The platform delivers a centralized operational architecture configured for modern enterprise requirements:
• Tyre Size & Tread Inventory Matrix: Automated operational workflow engine designed for high throughput, data consistency, and streamlined team execution.
• Wheel Alignment & Balancing Job Cards: Automated operational workflow engine designed for high throughput, data consistency, and streamlined team execution.
• DOT Serial & Warranty Registration: Automated operational workflow engine designed for high throughput, data consistency, and streamlined team execution.
• Tyre Size & Brand Inventory Matrix: Filter inventory by width, aspect ratio, rim diameter, speed index, tread pattern, and brands like Michelin, Goodyear, MRF.
• Role-Based Security & Permissions: Fine-grained access control ensuring data isolation, role authorization, and complete administrative audit logs.
• Automated Document & Receipt Generation: One-click export of GST-compliant invoices, confirmation slips, operational vouchers, and branded PDF summaries.
• Real-Time Notification Engine: Instant status alerts and milestone updates dispatched via WhatsApp, SMS, and transactional email gateways.
• Search, Filter & Bulk Operations: Advanced multi-criteria indexing, rapid data retrieval, batch updates, and custom export routines in Excel/CSV.
• Comprehensive BI Analytics & Reporting: Executive dashboards visualizing key performance metrics, operational trends, and revenue attribution.
2. Technology Stack & Enterprise Architecture
• Frontend Architecture: React, Tailwind CSS — Ultra-fast, component-driven client interface with responsive styling and fluid animations.
• Backend Engine: Node.js — Scalable RESTful API services handling business logic, queues, validation, and concurrent processing.
• Database Layer: MongoDB — High-availability relational and document storage with automated indexing, ACID integrity, and daily snapshots.
• Cloud Infrastructure: AWS — Containerized hosting with automated SSL encryption, global CDN delivery, and 99.9% uptime SLA.
• Ecosystem Integrations: Payment Gateway, WhatsApp API — Seamless webhooks, payment processing, third-party logistics, and omnichannel communications.
3. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
• Super Admin / Executive: Unrestricted system governance, organizational settings, user provisioning, revenue dashboards, and audit logs.
• Operations Manager: Workflow oversight, shift and roster scheduling, approval queues, inventory allocations, and department reporting.
• Front-Line Staff / Specialist: Daily operational task execution, transaction logging, customer service, and status updates.
• Customer / Client Portal: Self-service portal for appointment booking, order tracking, invoice downloads, and direct inquiry messaging.
4. Source Code & Intellectual Property

Full proprietary source code ownership is delivered with applicable enterprise licensing, empowering private cloud hosting, strict compliance audits, independent customization, and continuous internal evolution.
5. Customization & White-Label Capabilities
Tailor every element of the software to reflect your organizational identity:
• Brand Customization: Corporate logos, tailored color palettes, custom typography, and custom domain mapping.
• Workflow Customization: Custom intake fields, configurable approval stages, dynamic forms, and event automation rules.
• Integration Customization: Direct connections with existing ERPs, legacy CRMs, biometric hardware, and specialized third-party APIs.
• Custom Reporting & BI: Tailored executive KPI dashboards, automated financial statements, and custom scheduled data exports.
6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Can the software workflows and fields be modified to match our business?
Yes. The platform is modularly architected, allowing custom fields, operational stages, user permissions, and document layouts to be tailored to your requirements.
Is the platform fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens?
Yes. The web application is engineered with a mobile-first responsive layout, delivering an intuitive user experience across smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers.
Are native Android and iOS mobile applications available?
Yes. Dedicated Android and iOS mobile applications can be deployed alongside the platform according to your package and project specifications.
How is sensitive organizational and customer data protected?
The software implements bank-grade security protocols including TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, AES-256 encryption at rest, role-based authorization, and automated daily backups.
Can we migrate our existing customer data and transaction history?
Yes. We provide automated bulk migration tools and custom ETL scripts to securely transfer existing records from Excel, CSV, or legacy SQL databases.
What ongoing technical support and maintenance SLA is provided?
Enterprise plans include regular version updates, continuous security monitoring, cloud database management, and responsive technical helpdesk support.
7. Operational Implementation & How It Works

TOY RENTAL & SWAP MARKETPLACE SOFTWARE
Multi-Role Toy Rental, Subscription, Swap & Marketplace Management

A centralized toy rental and marketplace platform designed to help businesses manage toy listings, owners, renters, rentals, swaps, subscriptions, payments, moderation, analytics and day-to-day marketplace operations from one connected system. Dedicated Owner, User and Admin experiences keep each role focused while management retains platform-wide visibility and control.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage

Toy Marketplace — Present toys in organized categories so customers can discover rental options across educational toys, STEM learning toys, action figures, remote-control cars, ride-on toys, outdoor play, musical toys, board games and puzzles.
Toy Rental Operations — Support a complete browse, select, rent and return journey with rental visibility for customers and owners.
Swap Requests — Manage toy-swap requests as an additional marketplace workflow alongside rentals.
Owner Listings — Allow toy owners to maintain their toy inventory and monitor marketplace availability, estimated rental value and rental activity.
Customer Accounts — Give renters access to their rentals, cart, order tracking, subscriptions and wishlist from one account area.
Subscriptions & Repeat Rentals — Support recurring customer engagement through subscription and repeat-rental experiences.
Payments & Platform Revenue — Track rental payments and platform-level financial activity from the administrative workspace.
Moderation & Listing Control — Review toy listings and marketplace activity before or during publication based on the configured approval workflow.
Reports & Platform Analytics — Provide operational and marketplace reporting for inventory, rentals, payments and overall platform performance.
Role-Based Access — Owner, User and Admin accounts work from dedicated interfaces with access aligned to their responsibilities.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides three dedicated user experiences so toy owners, renters and administrators can work from focused dashboards without unnecessary access to other areas of the system.
Owner — Toy Portfolio & Rental Performance
Designed for individuals or businesses that list toys and monitor their rental performance on the marketplace.
Owner Dashboard & KPIs — View total revenue, active rentals and the number of toys in the owner portfolio.
My Toys — Maintain toy listings and monitor their current marketplace availability.
Marketplace Status — Review listed toys, availability and estimated rental value from one operational view.
Activity Pulse — Follow rental, return and approval-related marketplace activity.
Analytics — Review toy-fleet performance and rental trends for better portfolio decisions.
Settings — Maintain relevant owner account and marketplace preferences.
User / Renter — Browse, Rent, Track & Repeat
A customer-facing experience for families and renters to discover toys and manage their ongoing rental activity.
Browse by Category — Explore toys across educational, STEM, action, remote-control, ride-on, outdoor, musical and board-game categories.
My Rentals — Review current and previous rental activity from the customer account.
My Cart — Keep selected toys organized before completing the rental journey.
Order Tracking — Follow the status of rental orders after confirmation.
Subscriptions — Access subscription-based rental options where enabled.
Wishlist — Save preferred toys for future rental consideration.
Account Access — Secure sign-in and account management for returning customers.
Admin — Complete Marketplace Control
Built for platform-wide control over users, owners, inventory, rental transactions, moderation and marketplace reporting.
Admin Dashboard — Monitor total inventory, live rentals, platform share and toys currently in maintenance.
Users & Owners — Manage marketplace customer accounts and toy-owner accounts from dedicated administrative areas.
Toy Listings — Review and manage marketplace inventory and listing records.
Rental Orders — Monitor and manage rental transactions across the platform.
Swap Requests — Review and process toy-swap activity where enabled.
Payments — Maintain visibility into platform payment activity.
Moderation Queue — Review listings or marketplace items requiring administrative attention.
Reports & Platform Analytics — Access reports and performance insights for operational decision-making.
System Status & Settings — Monitor operational status and maintain platform configuration.

• Cloud Infrastructure: AWS — Containerized hosting with automated SSL encryption, global CDN delivery, and 99.9% uptime SLA.
• Ecosystem Integrations: Payment Gateway, WhatsApp API — Seamless webhooks, payment processing, third-party logistics, and omnichannel communications.

• Operations Manager: Workflow oversight, shift and roster scheduling, approval queues, inventory allocations, and department reporting.
• Front-Line Staff / Specialist: Daily operational task execution, transaction logging, customer service, and status updates.
• Customer / Client Portal: Self-service portal for appointment booking, order tracking, invoice downloads, and direct inquiry messaging.
4. Source Code & Intellectual Property

Full proprietary source code ownership is delivered with applicable enterprise licensing, empowering private cloud hosting, strict compliance audits, independent customization, and continuous internal evolution.
5. Customization & White-Label Capabilities
Tailor every element of the software to reflect your organizational identity:
• Brand Customization: Corporate logos, tailored color palettes, custom typography, and custom domain mapping.
• Workflow Customization: Custom intake fields, configurable approval stages, dynamic forms, and event automation rules.
• Integration Customization: Direct connections with existing ERPs, legacy CRMs, biometric hardware, and specialized third-party APIs.
• Custom Reporting & BI: Tailored executive KPI dashboards, automated financial statements, and custom scheduled data exports.

Can the software workflows and fields be modified to match our business?
Yes. The platform is modularly architected, allowing custom fields, operational stages, user permissions, and document layouts to be tailored to your requirements.
Is the platform fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens?
Yes. The web application is engineered with a mobile-first responsive layout, delivering an intuitive user experience across smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers.
Are native Android and iOS mobile applications available?
Yes. Dedicated Android and iOS mobile applications can be deployed alongside the platform according to your package and project specifications.
How is sensitive organizational and customer data protected?
The software implements bank-grade security protocols including TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, AES-256 encryption at rest, role-based authorization, and automated daily backups.
Can we migrate our existing customer data and transaction history?
Yes. We provide automated bulk migration tools and custom ETL scripts to securely transfer existing records from Excel, CSV, or legacy SQL databases.
What ongoing technical support and maintenance SLA is provided?
Enterprise plans include regular version updates, continuous security monitoring, cloud database management, and responsive technical helpdesk support.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
EVENT TICKETING & EVENT MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE
Online Ticket Sales, QR Entry, Organiser Operations & Platform Administration

A centralized event ticketing and management platform designed to help organisers create events, sell tickets, issue QR-based e-tickets, scan attendees at entry, monitor sales, manage payouts and operate events from one connected system.

Dedicated public attendee experiences, Organiser workspaces and Admin controls keep ticket sales, event operations, attendee entry and platform oversight organized while management maintains broader performance visibility.
1. What the Software Helps You Manage
Event Discovery - Publish upcoming events and allow visitors to browse by event, artist, city and category.
Event Categories - Organize events across categories such as music, sports, business, festivals, comedy, workshops, fundraisers, school events and community events.
Online Ticket Sales - Sell tickets online with event pages, pricing, ticket selection and purchase workflows.
QR Code E-Tickets - Issue QR-based digital tickets for fast attendee verification and entry.
Entry Scanning - Use the QR scanner to validate tickets and manage event entry more efficiently.
Attendee Management - Track ticket holders, recent sales, admissions and attendance-related activity.
Organiser Dashboard - Review total events, tickets sold, net payout, platform fees, recent sales and top-performing events.
Event Creation & Management - Create events, maintain event listings, manage active events and update event-related information.
Sales & Payout Visibility - Monitor ticket sales, organiser earnings, fees and payout-related performance information.
Reports & Analytics - Review event performance and ticketing information through reports and dashboard metrics.
Event Moderation - Support admin review and moderation of events before or during platform publication workflows.
User & Organiser Management - Maintain users, organisers, organiser requests, review history and system-level settings.
Content & Support - Manage blog content, legal/help information, support content and public-facing event information.
Role-Based Access - Organiser and Admin users work from dedicated dashboards and menus aligned with their responsibilities.
2. Role-Based Portals
The platform provides separate experiences for attendees, event organisers and platform administrators, helping each user focus on the actions relevant to their role.
Public Attendee / Ticket Buyer - Event Discovery & Ticket Purchase
A public-facing experience for discovering events, selecting tickets and receiving digital entry access.
Browse Events - Search upcoming events and explore event categories.
Event Details - Review event information, venue-related details, ticket availability and pricing.
Ticket Purchase - Select available tickets and complete the supported purchase process.
Instant E-Tickets - Receive digital ticket confirmation with QR-based access for event entry.
Mobile-Friendly Event Pages - Access event pages and ticket details from desktop, tablet or mobile-friendly interfaces.
Organiser - Event Creation, Sales & Entry Management
A dedicated workspace for organisers to create events, sell tickets, scan attendees and review event performance.
Organiser Dashboard - Review total events, tickets sold, net payout and platform fees.
Create Event - Create and publish event information through the organiser workflow.
My Events - Review and manage the organiser's active and historical events.
Recent Sales - See recent ticket buyers and admission status.
Top Events - Compare events by tickets sold and available payout information.
QR Scanner - Scan and validate QR tickets at the venue gate.
Reports - Review event and ticket-sales performance through available reports.
Settings - Manage available organiser account and event configuration.
Admin - Platform Operations & Moderation
A platform-wide administration workspace for overseeing events, users, organisers, moderation, content and revenue.
Operational Overview - Review gross volume, total events, tickets sold, platform revenue and real-time operational indicators.
Event Moderation - Review and moderate event listings according to platform rules.
User Management - Manage platform users and account-related activity.
Organisers - Review and manage organiser accounts.
Organiser Requests - Process pending organiser-related requests or approvals.
Review History - Maintain visibility into previous moderation or review actions.
Blog Management - Manage public platform content and event-related articles.
Legal & Help - Maintain support, legal and help-related content.
Settings - Manage available system-level configuration.
3. How It Helps Your Event Business
Centralize Event Operations - Bring event creation, ticket sales, attendee entry, reports, organisers and admin controls into one organized platform.
Sell Tickets More Efficiently - Online ticketing reduces manual booking effort and gives attendees a convenient purchase experience.
Speed Up Event Entry - QR-based e-tickets and scanning help reduce manual ticket checks and simplify gate verification.
Improve Organiser Visibility - Sales totals, tickets sold, payouts and platform fees help organisers understand event performance.
Improve Attendee Experience - Mobile-friendly event pages, digital ticket confirmation and streamlined entry support a smoother customer journey.
Improve Platform Oversight - Admin moderation, organiser management, user management and system-wide metrics provide broader operational control.
Support Multiple Event Types - The platform can support music, sports, conferences, festivals, workshops, community events and other event categories.
Improve Reporting & Accountability - Event, ticket and payout visibility helps organisers and platform managers make better operational decisions.
Support Business Growth - A structured ticketing platform can scale with more organisers, events, ticket types, attendees, reports, integrations and automation.
4. Technology Stack
React.js - Modern responsive frontend interface for public event pages, organiser dashboards and admin workspaces.
Vite - Fast frontend development and optimized application build tooling.
Node.js + Express - Backend services and APIs for events, ticketing, users, payments, reporting and platform operations.
MySQL - Structured relational database management for event, ticket, attendee and business data.
Prisma ORM - Database interaction layer for structured and maintainable application data access.

Alternative technology stacks can also be discussed according to client requirements, integration needs and deployment architecture. Kiaan Technology can work with technologies such as React Native, Java, Python and other suitable frontend, mobile or backend technologies where required.

Android & iOS Applications - Dedicated attendee, organiser or event-staff applications can be developed for Android and iOS using React Native or other suitable native or cross-platform technologies according to project requirements.

AI & Automation - AI-assisted event recommendations, support automation, content assistance, attendee insights, fraud/risk assistance and other approved event workflows can be developed around the agreed use case.
5. Fully Customizable to Your Requirements

The software can be adapted around the way your event business operates, allowing the platform to match your branding, ticketing model, organiser workflow, attendee experience, moderation rules and commercial structure.
Branding - Logo, software name, interface styling and public event-page presentation can be customized.
Modules & Features - Existing modules can be adjusted and additional ticketing, event, membership or operational modules can be developed.
Roles & Permissions - Admin, Organiser, Staff and additional roles can be adapted with controlled module and data access.
Event Workflows - Event creation fields, approval stages, publishing rules, categories and event statuses can be tailored.
Ticket Types & Pricing - Free, paid, tiered, promotional, early-bird, VIP or other ticket structures can be developed according to requirements.
Ticketing & Entry - QR ticket design, check-in rules, scanner workflows, re-entry handling and attendance logic can be customized.
Organiser Payouts & Fees - Platform fees, organiser payouts, commission structures and commercial rules can be adapted to the selected business model.
Forms, Fields & Reports - Event forms, custom fields, dashboard KPIs, reports and export formats can be modified or extended.

Third-Party API Integrations - Suitable payment gateways, email, SMS, maps, CRM, accounting, marketing and other third-party services can be integrated based on project requirements and provider availability.
AI & Automation - AI features and automated workflows can be developed for approved use cases such as event discovery, support, content assistance or operational alerts.
Mobile Applications - Android and iOS applications can be added where included in the project scope.
Multi-Language Support - Additional interface languages can be discussed and developed according to client requirements.
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license, supporting future maintenance, expansion and further development.
6. Why Choose Kiaan Technology
Requirement-Based Development - We adapt the software around your actual event and ticketing workflow instead of forcing every business into one fixed process.
Role-Based Product Structure - Dedicated attendee, organiser and admin experiences help keep responsibilities organized and access controlled.
Business-Focused Development - The platform is designed to make event creation, ticket sales, attendee entry and organiser operations easier to manage while improving management visibility.
Scalable Customization - Start from the existing platform and expand ticket types, event workflows, reports, mobile apps, AI features and integrations as requirements evolve.

Security-Focused Development - Kiaan Technology develops software with authenticated access, role-based permissions, controlled data visibility and secure password handling. Additional hosting, backup, audit, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Transparent Communication - Project scope, requested changes, dependencies and delivery expectations are communicated clearly throughout development and customization.
Regular Project Updates - You receive regular progress updates showing what has been completed, what is in progress and what is planned next.
Source Code Options - Applicable packages can include source code for future maintenance, expansion and ownership flexibility.
Technical Support - Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
7. FAQ
Can organisers create events and sell tickets from the same platform?
Yes. The Organiser workspace includes event creation, event management, ticket-sales visibility, QR scanning, reports and organiser performance information.
Does the platform support QR code tickets and entry scanning?
Yes. The demonstrated platform includes instant QR e-tickets and a QR Scanner workflow for validating attendee entry.
Can the platform support both free and paid events?
Yes. The public platform presents both free and paid event listings, and ticketing rules can be customized according to the required event model.
Can admins moderate events and manage organisers?
Yes. The Admin workspace includes Event Moderation, User Management, Organisers, Organiser Requests and Review History.
Can the software be customized for our event business?
Yes. Branding, event workflows, ticket types, fees, payouts, roles, reports, mobile apps, AI and integrations can be customized according to project requirements.
Is the data secure?

The software uses authenticated access, role-based permissions and controlled data visibility. Additional hosting, backup, audit, encryption and deployment controls can be configured according to the agreed project architecture.
Can payment gateways, email, SMS and other APIs be integrated?
Yes. Suitable payment, email, SMS, CRM, accounting, marketing and other third-party services can be integrated where required and supported by the selected providers.
Is source code included and can Android / iOS apps be developed?
Source code is available where included in the selected package or license. Android and iOS applications can also be developed using React Native or other suitable technologies.
Will we receive regular project updates and technical support?

Yes. Kiaan Technology maintains transparent communication and provides regular progress updates. Setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements can be provided according to the selected package.
BOOK A DEMO • GET A QUOTE

Contact Kiaan Technology to discuss your event types, ticketing model, organiser workflow, mobile app requirements, payment integrations and platform requirements, and receive a project-specific proposal.

Enterprise Operations, Role-Based Access, Workflow Automation & Real-Time Analytics

A comprehensive, enterprise-grade Travel Agency Management Software engineered for scalable operations, role-based workflows, automated administration, and real-time visibility in Event / Travel / Entertainment.

All-in-one travel agency platform for customized tour itinerary design, multi-vendor bookings, voucher generation, and travel CRM. The platform combines modern responsive interfaces with high-performance backend infrastructure to streamline workflows, eliminate manual overhead, and accelerate operational growth.
1. Core Platform Modules & Functional Capabilities
The platform delivers a centralized operational architecture configured for modern enterprise requirements:
• Day-Wise Tour Itinerary Builder: Automated operational workflow engine designed for high throughput, data consistency, and streamlined team execution.
• Hotel, Flight & Cab Booking Hub: Automated operational workflow engine designed for high throughput, data consistency, and streamlined team execution.
• Traveler Vouchers & Payment Ledgers: Automated operational workflow engine designed for high throughput, data consistency, and streamlined team execution.
• Custom Tour & Itinerary Builder: Craft multi-day tour packages with flight timings, sightseeing schedules, hotel vouchers, and automated pricing calculations.
• Role-Based Security & Permissions: Fine-grained access control ensuring data isolation, role authorization, and complete administrative audit logs.
• Automated Document & Receipt Generation: One-click export of GST-compliant invoices, confirmation slips, operational vouchers, and branded PDF summaries.
• Real-Time Notification Engine: Instant status alerts and milestone updates dispatched via WhatsApp, SMS, and transactional email gateways.
• Search, Filter & Bulk Operations: Advanced multi-criteria indexing, rapid data retrieval, batch updates, and custom export routines in Excel/CSV.

• Frontend Architecture: React, Tailwind CSS — Ultra-fast, component-driven client interface with responsive styling and fluid animations.
• Backend Engine: Node.js — Scalable RESTful API services handling business logic, queues, validation, and concurrent processing.
• Database Layer: MongoDB — High-availability relational and document storage with automated indexing, ACID integrity, and daily snapshots.
• Cloud Infrastructure: AWS — Containerized hosting with automated SSL encryption, global CDN delivery, and 99.9% uptime SLA.
• Ecosystem Integrations: Payment Gateway, WhatsApp API — Seamless webhooks, payment processing, third-party logistics, and omnichannel communications.

• Super Admin / Executive: Unrestricted system governance, organizational settings, user provisioning, revenue dashboards, and audit logs.

• Front-Line Staff / Specialist: Daily operational task execution, transaction logging, customer service, and status updates.
• Customer / Client Portal: Self-service portal for appointment booking, order tracking, invoice downloads, and direct inquiry messaging.

Full proprietary source code ownership is delivered with applicable enterprise licensing, empowering private cloud hosting, strict compliance audits, independent customization, and continuous internal evolution.

rawLines: KIAAN TECHNOLOGY
SPORTMATRIX

Smart Sports Facility & Tournament ManagementA complete role-based sports facility management platform for turf bookings, tournaments, payments and day-to-day sports operations — all from one centralized system.
1. What We Provide
A complete sports facility platform for turf operations, tournaments, payments and customer bookings from one centralized system.
5 User Roles: Super Admin, Admin, Staff, Umpire & Customer
Turf Management: Listings, rates, availability, calendar & bookings
Tournaments: Registrations, fixtures, matches, sponsors & reports
CRM & Advertising: Leads, broadcasts, offers, commissions & analytics
Billing & Facility Ops: POS, payments, wallet, inventory, maintenance & staff
Umpire Operations: Assigned matches, toss, live scoring, payment QR & leaderboard
Customer Portal: Bookings, teams, matches, tournaments, wallet & profile
Responsive Access: Desktop, laptop, tablet & mobile; Android & iOS apps available
2. Technology Stack
React.js + Vite — Modern & responsive web interface
Node.js + Express — Backend APIs
MySQL — Reliable database management
Prisma ORM — Efficient database interaction
3. Role-Based Access
Super Admin → Owners, users, subscriptions, global CRM, ads, commissions, logs & disputes
Admin → CRM, ads, tournaments, turf rates/calendar, bookings, POS, wallet & operations
Staff → Ads, tournament operations, bookings/refunds, maintenance & equipment
Umpire → Assigned matches, live scoring, history, payment QR & leaderboard
Customer → Bookings, teams, matches, tournaments, leaderboards, wallet & profile
4. Source Code
Source code is available with the applicable package, allowing the software to be maintained, modified and customized according to the applicable license terms.
5. Customization
Make the software yours.
Logo • Branding • UI • Modules • Fields • Reports • Features
Custom development can also be provided based on your requirements.
6. FAQ
Can we customize the software?
Yes, the software can be customized according to your requirements.
Is source code included?
Yes, where included in the selected package/license.
Is the software mobile and tablet responsive?
Yes. The web platform is responsive for desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile screens.
Are Android and iOS app versions available?
Yes. Android and iOS app versions are available.
Can third-party APIs be integrated?
Yes. Third-party APIs can be integrated according to project requirements.How are passwords, data and user access secured?

Passwords are protected using secure authentication and password hashing, while role-based permissions restrict every user to authorized modules and actions. Application and database access can also be configured according to deployment security requirements.
Can AI automation be added or customized?
Yes. AI automation and workflows can be added and customized according to your requirements.Does Kiaan Technology provide technical support?
Yes. Kiaan Technology can provide technical support for setup, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates and future enhancements based on the selected package.
Which technologies are used?
React.js, Vite, Node.js, Express, MySQL and Prisma ORM.Can a different technology stack be used?
Yes. We work across full-stack technologies including React Native, WordPress, TypeScript, Java, Python and others based on project requirements.
